local function drawProfile()
    local f = card("ProfileManager", 330)
    text(
        f,
        "Title",
        "JSON PROFILES / NO CODE EXECUTION",
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 21),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8),
        11,
        palette.cyan
    )
    local info = text(
        f,
        "Info",
        "Export, copy or paste a validated profile. Slots stay in this session only. No files, uploads or external loaders.",
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 38),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 32),
        9,
        palette.muted
    )
    ;
    info.TextWrapped = true
    local box = input(
        f,
        "VisualProfileJSON",
        draft,
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 124),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 77)
    )
    ;
    box.MultiLine = true
    ;
    box.TextWrapped = true
    ;
    box.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    ;
    box.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    ;
    box.TextSize = 9
    on(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
        draft = box.Text
    end)
    button(f, "ExportVisualProfile", "EXPORT", UDim2.new(0.31, -4, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 210), function()
        local ok, result = pcall(visual.export)
        ;
        if ok then
            box.Text = result
        else
            message("JSON export unavailable")
        end
    end)
    button(f, "CopyVisualProfile", "COPY", UDim2.new(0.31, -4, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0.33, 4, 0, 210), function()
        if RedEnv.SetClipboard(box.Text) then
            message("Profile JSON copied")
        else
            message("Clipboard unavailable; select/copy JSON manually")
        end
    end)
    button(f, "ImportVisualProfile", "IMPORT", UDim2.new(0.31, -4, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0.66, 0, 0, 210), function()
        local ok, reason = visual.import(box.Text)
        ;
        message(ok and (visual.enabled and "Profile applied" or "Profile staged; turn shaders ON to preview") or reason)
    end)
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local x = (i - 1) * 0.33
        button(f, "SaveVisualSlot" .. i, "SAVE " .. i, UDim2.new(0.31, -4, 0, 25), UDim2.new(x, 8, 0, 253), function()
            visual.saveSlot(i)
            ;
            message("Session slot " .. i .. " saved")
        end)
        button(f, "LoadVisualSlot" .. i, "LOAD " .. i, UDim2.new(0.31, -4, 0, 25), UDim2.new(x, 8, 0, 286), function()
            local ok, reason = visual.loadSlot(i)
            ;
            message(ok and ("Session slot " .. i .. (visual.enabled and " applied" or " staged")) or reason)
        end)
    end
end
redraw = function()
    clearList()
    ;
    bucket = viewConnections
    ;
    heading.Text = mode == "Aim" and "AIMBOT / CAMERA ASSIST" or mode == "ESP" and "ESP & FIXED SHAPE" or category:upper()
    sidebar.Visible = mode ~= "ESP" and mode ~= "Aim"
    search.Visible = mode ~= "ESP" and mode ~= "Aim"
    content.Size = (
        mode == "ESP" or mode == "Aim") and UDim2.new(1,
        0,
        1,
        0) or UDim2.new(1,
        -124,
        1,
        0
    )
    content.Position = (
        mode == "ESP" or mode == "Aim") and UDim2.new() or UDim2.new(0,
        124,
        0,
        0
    )
    heading.Size = (
        mode == "ESP" or mode == "Aim") and UDim2.new(1,
        -24,
        0,
        23) or UDim2.new(1,
        -191,
        0,
        23
    )
    shadersTab.BackgroundColor3 = mode == "Shaders" and Color3.fromRGB(147, 52, 107) or palette.card
    settingsTab.BackgroundColor3 = mode == "Settings" and Color3.fromRGB(48, 95, 135) or palette.card
    espTab.BackgroundColor3 = mode == "ESP" and Color3.fromRGB(48, 110, 108) or palette.card
    aimTab.BackgroundColor3 = mode == "Aim" and Color3.fromRGB(66, 105, 86) or palette.card
    for name, b in pairs(sideButtons) do
        b.BackgroundColor3 = name == category and Color3.fromRGB(52, 66, 100) or palette.card
        ;
        b.TextColor3 = name == category and palette.cyan or palette.muted
    end
    if mode == "Settings" then
        sectionInfo.Text = "PRECISE VALUES / RGB + HEX / TOUCH SLIDERS"
        local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        ;
        layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
        ;
        layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        ;
        layout.Parent = list
        local actions = card("SectionActions", 34)
        button(actions, "ResetVisualSection", "RESET SHADER", UDim2.new(0.35, -8, 0, 25), UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4), function()
            local ok, why = visual.resetShader()
            ;
            message(ok and "Full selected shader restored" or why)
            ;
            redraw()
        end)
        button(actions, "ResetOnlyVisualSection", "SECTION", UDim2.new(0.26, -8, 0, 25), UDim2.new(0.35, 2, 0, 4), function()
            visual.resetGroup(category)
            ;
            message("Section restored to look baseline")
            ;
            redraw()
        end)
        button(actions, "RestoreGameVisuals", "RESTORE GAME", UDim2.new(0.39, -8, 0, 25), UDim2.new(0.61, 1, 0, 4), function()
            visual.original()
            ;
            redraw()
        end, Color3.fromRGB(104, 47, 79))
        if category == "Profiles" then
            drawProfile()
        elseif category == "Diagnostics" then
            diagnosticPanel()
        else
            for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
                if d.group == category and matches(d.label .. " " .. d.id) then
                    fieldCard(d)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif mode == "ESP" then
        drawESP()
    elseif mode == "Aim" then
        drawAim()
    else
        sectionInfo.Text = category == "Weather" and "ATMOSPHERIC LOOKS / NO WEATHER SCRIPTS" or "PSHADE ULTIMATE / INSPECTED PRESET DATA"
        local layout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
        layout.CellSize = UDim2.new(
            0.5,
            -6,
            0,
            148
        )
        layout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(
            0,
            10,
            0,
            10
        )
        layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        layout.Parent = list
        -- Original PShade photographs, above their shader names, never gradient-only substitutes.
        -- Image loading is independent of shader activation and never blocks the GUI.
        local function presetCard(
            name,
            sub,
            callback,
            tint,
            clock,
            photoUri,
            selectedName
        )
            if not matches(name .. " " .. sub) then
                return 
            end
            local b = button(
                list,
                "ShaderCard_" .. name,
                "",
                UDim2.new(),
                nil,
                callback
            )
            cardOrder = cardOrder + 1
            b.LayoutOrder = cardOrder
            b.Position = UDim2.new()
            b.BackgroundColor3 = palette.card
            b.ClipsDescendants = true
            round(b, 10)
            local photoFrame = frame(
                b,
                "PreviewFrame",
                UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 88),
                UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6),
                palette.field
            )
            photoFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
            round(photoFrame, 8)
            local fallback = text(
                photoFrame,
                "PreviewStatus",
                "LOADING ORIGINAL PHOTO...",
                UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0),
                UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0),
                9,
                palette.muted
            )
            fallback.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            fallback.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            fallback.TextWrapped = true
            local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            image.Name = "OriginalPreviewImage"
            image.Size = UDim2.new(
                1,
                0,
                1,
                0
            )
            image.Position = UDim2.new()
            image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            image.BorderSizePixel = 0
            image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            image.ImageTransparency = 0
            image.Active = false
            image.Image = photoUri or VisualPresetData.defaultImage
            image.Parent = photoFrame
            round(image, 8)
            local originalUri = image.Image
            local assetId = originalUri:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)")
            local generation = viewGeneration
            local attempts = 0
            local nextRetry = 0
            local retry
            local function validPreview()
                return not visual.closed and viewGeneration == generation and b.Parent == list and image.Parent == photoFrame
            end
            local function refreshPhoto()
                if not validPreview() then
                    return 
                end
                local loaded = image.IsLoaded == true
                fallback.Visible = not loaded
                if loaded then
                    retry.Visible = false
                end
            end
            local function checkLater()
                task.delay(10, function()
                    if not validPreview() or image.IsLoaded then
                        return 
                    end
                    fallback.Text = "PHOTO NOT READY / RETRY"
                    retry.Visible = true
                end)
            end
            retry = button(photoFrame, "RetryPreview_" .. name, "RETRY", UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 20), UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, -25), function()
                if not validPreview() or os.clock() < nextRetry then
                    return 
                end
                nextRetry = os.clock() + 2
                attempts = attempts + 1
                retry.Visible = false
                fallback.Text = "LOADING ORIGINAL PHOTO..."
                fallback.Visible = true
                image.Image = ""
                task.defer(function()
                    if not validPreview() then
                        return 
                    end
                    -- Both URIs reference the same original asset; no replacement photograph.
                    if assetId and attempts % 2 == 1 then
                        image.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. assetId .. "&w=420&h=420"
                    else
                        image.Image = originalUri
                    end
                    refreshPhoto()
                    checkLater()
                end)
            end, Color3.fromRGB(53, 74, 104))
            retry.TextSize = 8
            retry.Visible = false
            local badge = text(
                photoFrame,
                "PhotoBadge",
                clock and string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(clock) % 24, math.floor(clock % 1 * 60)) or "PSHADE",
                UDim2.new(0, 62, 0, 18),
                UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4),
                9,
                palette.white
            )
            badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            badge.BackgroundColor3 = palette.field
            badge.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            round(badge, 5)
            local label = text(
                b,
                "Name",
                name:upper(),
                UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 23),
                UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 98),
                14,
                palette.white
            )
            label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            local subtitle = text(
                b,
                "Sub",
                sub,
                UDim2.new(1, -75, 0, 16),
                UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 123),
                8,
                palette.cyan
            )
            subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            subtitle.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            local action = text(
                b,
                "Action",
                "APPLY >",
                UDim2.new(0, 59, 0, 17),
                UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 122),
                9,
                palette.gold
            )
            action.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            action.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            local stroke = RedUI.Stroke(
                b,
                Color3.fromRGB(73, 84, 115),
                1
            )
            table.insert(presetCards, {
                name = selectedName or name,
                stroke = stroke,
                action = action,
                photo = image,
            })
            on(image:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsLoaded"), refreshPhoto)
            refreshPhoto()
            checkLater()
        end
        presetCard("Game Original", "RESTORE / SHADERS OFF", function()
            visual.original()
        end, nil, nil, VisualPresetData.defaultImage, "GAME ORIGINAL")
        if category == "Skyboxes" then
            for _, sky in ipairs(VisualPresetData.skies) do
                presetCard(sky.name, "SKY PACK / SAMPLE PHOTO", function()
                    visual.sky(sky.name)
                end, Color3.fromRGB(38, 79, 119), nil, sky.image, "SKY / " .. sky.name)
            end
        else
            for _, preset in ipairs(VisualPresetData.presets) do
                if preset.category == category then
                    presetCard(preset.name, preset.category:upper() .. " / PSHADE", function()
                        visual.preset(preset.id)
                    end, preset.values["Color.TintColor"] or palette.card, preset.values["Lighting.ClockTime"], preset.image, preset.name)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, refresh in ipairs(refreshers) do
        refresh()
    end
    bucket = uiConnections
end

    for _, c in ipairs(sideConnections) do
        c:Disconnect()
    end
    ;
    sideConnections = {
    }
    ;
    bucket = sideConnections
    for _, b in pairs(sideButtons) do
        b:Destroy()
    end
    ;

    }

        bucket = uiConnections

        return 
    end

            search.Text = ""

end
on(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
    redraw()
end)
on(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(inputEvent)
    if not drag then
        return 
    end
    local pointer = drag.input
    if (pointer.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and inputEvent == pointer) or (pointer.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        drag.slide(inputEvent.Position.X, inputEvent.Position.Y)
    end
end)
on(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(inputEvent)
    if drag and (inputEvent == drag.input or inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        cancelDrag()
    end
end)
on(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, cancelDrag)
on(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
    if not page.Visible then
        cancelDrag()
    end
end)
on(MainWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
    if not MainWindow.Visible then
        cancelDrag()
    end
end)
local function refreshStudio()
    if visual.closed then
        return 
    end
    if mode == "Aim" then
        master.Text = aim.values.Enabled and "AIM ON" or "AIM OFF"
        master.BackgroundColor3 = aim.values.Enabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 112, 119) or palette.card
        status.Text = aim.values.AimlockEnabled and "AIMLOCK ON" or aim.values.Enabled and "HOLD E / TOUCH" or "AIM OFF"
        status.TextColor3 = (aim.values.Enabled or aim.values.AimlockEnabled) and palette.cyan or palette.gold
        footer.Text = aim.runtimeWarning and ("AIM NOTICE: " .. aim.runtimeWarning) or "CAMERA ONLY / ASSIST CHANCE IS NOT A BULLET HIT RATE"
        for _, refresh in ipairs(refreshers) do
            refresh()
        end
        return 
    end
    if mode == "ESP" then
        master.Text = esp.values.Enabled and "ESP ON" or "ESP OFF"
        master.BackgroundColor3 = esp.values.Enabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 112, 119) or palette.card
        status.Text = esp.values.Enabled and (tostring(esp.stats.visible or 0) .. " CONTACTS") or esp.values.ExpanderEnabled and (tostring(esp.stats.expanded or 0) .. " EXPANDED") or esp.values.MarkerEnabled and "SHAPE ON / ESP OFF" or "ESP / SHAPE OFF"
        status.TextColor3 = esp.values.Enabled and palette.cyan or palette.gold
        footer.Text = esp.runtimeWarning and ("ESP NOTICE: " .. esp.runtimeWarning) or "LOCAL EXPANDER / SERVER HIT VALIDATION AND DAMAGE ARE NOT GUARANTEED"
        for _, refresh in ipairs(refreshers) do
            refresh()
        end
        return 
    end
    master.Text = visual.enabled and "SHADERS ON" or "SHADERS OFF"
    master.BackgroundColor3 = visual.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(40, 112, 119) or palette.card
    status.Text = visual.enabled and "LIVE SYNC" or "OFF / STAGED"
    status.TextColor3 = visual.enabled and palette.cyan or palette.gold
    local edits = visual.dirtyCount > 0 and (" / " .. visual.dirtyCount .. " EDITS") or ""
    footer.Text = visual.runtimeWarning and ("CLIENT NOTICE: " .. visual.runtimeWarning) or ("PSHADE | " .. visual.baseName:upper() .. edits .. (visual.enabled and " | LIVE SYNC" or " | STAGED / TURN ON"))
    for _, refresh in ipairs(refreshers) do
        refresh()
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(presetCards) do
        local selected = visual.baseName == p.name or p.name:sub(1, 6) == "SKY / " and visual.skyName == p.name:sub(7)
        p.stroke.Color = selected and palette.pink or Color3.fromRGB(
            73,
            84,
            115
        )
        p.stroke.Thickness = selected and 2 or 1
        p.action.Text = selected and (visual.dirtyCount > 0 and "EDITED" or visual.enabled and "LIVE" or "READY") or "APPLY >"
        p.action.TextColor3 = selected and palette.pink or palette.gold
    end
end
table.insert(uiConnections, visual.subscribe(function()
    refreshStudio()
end))
table.insert(uiConnections, esp.subscribe(function()
    refreshStudio()
end))
table.insert(uiConnections, aim.subscribe(function()
    refreshStudio()
end))
local elapsed = 0
on(RunService.Heartbeat, function(delta)
    if not page.Visible or not MainWindow.Visible then
        return 
    end
    elapsed = elapsed + (delta or 0.016)
    if elapsed < 0.15 then
        return 
    end
    elapsed = 0
    refreshStudio()
end)
on(MainGui.Destroying, function()
    visual.close()
    ;
    aim.close()
    ;
    esp.close()
    ;
    cancelDrag()
    ;
    for _, c in ipairs(uiConnections) do
        c:Disconnect()
    end
    ;
    for _, c in ipairs(viewConnections) do
        c:Disconnect()
    end
    ;
    for _, c in ipairs(sideConnections) do
        c:Disconnect()
    end
end)
drawSide()
;
redraw()
;
refreshStudio()
end)()
end

local function MakeAboutBox(title, val, sub, order, clickAction)
    local c = Instance.new(clickAction and "TextButton" or "Frame")
    c.Size = UDim2.new(0.488, 0, 0, 68)
    c.BackgroundColor3 = RedTheme.Get("CardBase")
    c.BorderSizePixel = 0
    c.ZIndex = 22
    c.LayoutOrder = order or 1
    if clickAction then
        c.AutoButtonColor = false
        c.Text = ""
    end
    c.Parent = aboutGrid
    RedUI.Corner(c, 14)
    local s = RedUI.Stroke(c, RedTheme.Get("CardStroke"), 1.2)
    RedTheme.Bind(c, "BackgroundColor3", "CardBase")
    RedTheme.Bind(s, "Color", "CardStroke")

    local tl = RedUI.Label(c, string.upper(title), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 9, RedTheme.Get("TextMuted"))
    tl.ZIndex = 23
    local vl = RedUI.Label(c, val, UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 22), Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 13, RedTheme.Get("TextPrimary"))
    vl.ZIndex = 23
    local sl = RedUI.Label(c, "- " .. sub, UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 46), Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 9, RedTheme.Get("TextSecondary"))
    sl.ZIndex = 23

    if clickAction then
        c.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            RedTween.Play(c, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = RedTheme.Get("CardHover") })
        end)
        c.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            RedTween.Play(c, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = RedTheme.Get("CardBase") })
        end)
        c.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            RedAudio.Play("Click")
            clickAction(vl, sl)
        end)
    end

    return vl, sl, c
end

task.spawn(function()
    while AboutModal and AboutModal.Parent do
        pcall(function()
            local pos = RedTelemetry.CharPosition
            local vel = RedTelemetry.CharVelocity
            local speed = math.floor(vel.Magnitude)

            boxCoordVal.Text = string.format("X: %.1f | Y: %.1f | Z: %.1f", pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
            boxVelVal.Text = string.format("X: %.1f | Y: %.1f | Z: %.1f", vel.X, vel.Y, vel.Z)
            boxSpeedVal.Text = string.format("%d studs/sec", speed)

            local valRbx = RedTelemetry.ExactAvatarValue or RedTelemetry.EstimatedAvatarValue or 0
            boxAvatarVal.Text = tostring(valRbx) .. " R$ (estimate)"
            boxAvatarSub.Text = "- " .. (RedTelemetry.AvatarValuationStatus or "Supplied outfit-value logic")

            boxFriVal.Text = tostring(RedTelemetry.TotalFriendsCount) .. " Friends Online"
            boxAgeVal.Text = RedTelemetry.AccountAgeText
            boxAgeSub.Text = "- Joined (UTC): " .. RedTelemetry.AccountCreationDate
        end)
        task.wait(0.25)
    end
end)

local function MakeMetric(title, val, sub, col)
    local c = Instance.new("Frame")
    c.Size = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 1, 0)
    c.BackgroundColor3 = RedTheme.Get("CardBase")
    c.BorderSizePixel = 0
    c.Parent = TelemetryGrid
    RedUI.Corner(c, 14)
    local s = RedUI.Stroke(c, RedTheme.Get("CardStroke"), 1.2)
    RedTheme.Bind(c, "BackgroundColor3", "CardBase")
    RedTheme.Bind(s, "Color", "CardStroke")

    RedUI.Label(c, string.upper(title), UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 9, RedTheme.Get("TextMuted"))
    local vl = RedUI.Label(c, val, UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 22), Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 16, col or RedTheme.Get("TextPrimary"))
    local sl = RedUI.Label(c, "- " .. sub, UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 44), Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 9, RedTheme.Get("TextSecondary"))
    return vl, sl
end

local fpsVal, fpsSub = MakeMetric("Performance", "60 FPS", "144Hz+ Smooth", RedTheme.Get("TextPrimary"))
local pingVal, pingSub = MakeMetric("Latency", "50ms", "Direct Gateway", Color3.fromRGB(255, 183, 3))
local envVal, envSub = MakeMetric("Environment", RedEnv.ExecutorName, "Active Engine", RedTheme.Get("Accent"))

task.spawn(function()
    while TelemetryGrid and TelemetryGrid.Parent do
        local fps = RedTelemetry.CurrentFPS
        fpsVal.Text = fps .. " FPS"
        fpsSub.Text = fps >= 55 and "- 144Hz+ Smooth" or (fps >= 30 and "- Moderate" or "- Throttled")

        local ping = RedTelemetry.CurrentPing
        pingVal.Text = ping .. "ms"
        pingSub.Text = ping < 100 and "- Direct Gateway" or (ping < 200 and "- Normal" or "- High Latency")
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

local themeItems = {}
local function AddThemeItem(name, p)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Text = ""
    b.BackgroundColor3 = p.CardBase
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.Parent = themeGrid
    RedUI.Corner(b, 12)
    local st = RedUI.Stroke(b, RedTheme.CurrentThemeName == name and p.Accent or p.CardStroke, 1.2)

    local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = p.Accent
    dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dot.Parent = b
    RedUI.Corner(dot, 8)

    RedUI.Label(b, name, UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 16), UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 10), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 9, p.TextPrimary)
    local stat = RedUI.Label(b, RedTheme.CurrentThemeName == name and "ACTIVE" or "SELECT", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38), Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 8, RedTheme.CurrentThemeName == name and p.Accent or p.TextMuted)

    themeItems[name] = { Stroke = st, Stat = stat, Palette = p }

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if RedTheme.CurrentThemeName == name then return end
        RedTheme.SetTheme(name)
        for n, it in pairs(themeItems) do
            it.Stroke.Color = (n == name and it.Palette.Accent or it.Palette.CardStroke)
            it.Stat.Text = (n == name and "ACTIVE" or "SELECT")
            it.Stat.TextColor3 = (n == name and it.Palette.Accent or it.Palette.TextMuted)
        end
        ShowToast("Theme Changed", name, "Success")
    end)
end

local function getPlayerColor(userId)
    local colors = {
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 87, 87),
        Color3.fromRGB(78, 205, 196),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 11),
        Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247),
        Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
        Color3.fromRGB(244, 114, 182),
        Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153),
        Color3.fromRGB(251, 146, 60)
    }
    local num = tonumber(userId) or 1
    local idx = (num % #colors) + 1
    return colors[idx]
end

local friendsCard = RedUI.Card(PageFriends, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 240))
local friendsStatus = RedUI.Label(friendsCard, "LOADING FRIENDS...", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 10, RedTheme.Get("TextSecondary"))
local friendsScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
friendsScroll.Name = "FriendCarousel"

friendsScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30)

local universeCache, nameCache = {}, {}
local function positiveNumber(value)
    local n = tonumber(value)
    return n and n > 0 and n or nil
end
local function friendPlace(f)
    local id = positiveNumber(f.PlaceId or f.placeId)
    local location = f.LastLocation or f.lastLocation
    if not id and type(location) == "string" then
        id = positiveNumber(location:match("/games/(%d+)"))
    end
    return id
end
local function friendUniverse(placeId)
    if not placeId then return nil end
    if placeId == game.PlaceId then return game.GameId end
    if universeCache[placeId] then return universeCache[placeId] end
    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet("https://apis.roblox.com/universes/v1/places/" .. placeId .. "/universe"))
    end)
    local id = ok and type(data) == "table" and positiveNumber(data.universeId) or nil
    if id then universeCache[placeId] = id end
    return id
end
local function friendGameName(f, placeId, universeId)
    if placeId and nameCache[placeId] then return nameCache[placeId] end
    local name = f.GameName or f.PlaceName or f.Location or f.LastLocation or f.lastLocation
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or name == "Website" or name == "Online" or name == "Offline" or name == "In Game" or name:find("://") then name = nil end
    if not name and universeId then
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games?universeIds=" .. universeId))
        end)
        if ok and type(data) == "table" and data.data and data.data[1] then name = data.data[1].name end
    end
    if not name and placeId then
        local ok, info = pcall(function() return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(placeId) end)
        if ok and info then name = info.Name end
    end
    if name and placeId then nameCache[placeId] = name end
    return name or (placeId and ("Place " .. placeId) or "Online")
end
local function cardLabel(parent, text, size, pos, font, textSize, color)
    local l = RedUI.Label(parent, text, size, pos, font, textSize, color)
    l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    return l
end
local function drawFriend(f, order)
    local userId = positiveNumber(f.VisitorId or f.UserId or f.Id)
    local username = tostring(f.UserName or f.userName or f.Name or "Unknown")
    local displayName = tostring(f.DisplayName or f.displayName or username)
    local placeId = friendPlace(f)
    -- LocationType 1/4 can indicate a game even when its place ID is hidden.
    -- Unknown location without a place is treated as online, not confirmed in-game.
    local locationType = tonumber(f.LocationType or f.locationType)
    local inGame = placeId ~= nil or locationType == 1 or locationType == 4
    local card = Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Name = "FriendCard"
    card.Size = UDim2.new(0, 265, 1, -5)
    card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 23, 29)
    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
    card.LayoutOrder = order
    card.ClipsDescendants = true
    card.Parent = friendsScroll
    RedUI.Corner(card, 12)
    RedUI.Stroke(card, Color3.fromRGB(58, 49, 57), 1)
    local thumb = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    thumb.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    thumb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 15, 20)
    thumb.BorderSizePixel = 0
    thumb.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    thumb.Parent = card
    -- The monogram remains visible until an actual thumbnail reports loaded.
    -- If the thumbnail fails or the place is hidden, it remains as a fallback.
    local fallback = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    fallback.Name = "ExperienceFallbackR"
    fallback.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -35)
    fallback.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    fallback.Text = "R"
    fallback.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    fallback.TextSize = 105
    fallback.TextColor3 = inGame and Color3.fromRGB(242, 35, 67) or Color3.fromRGB(54, 151, 255)
    fallback.TextStrokeColor3 = inGame and Color3.fromRGB(98, 8, 25) or Color3.fromRGB(12, 55, 116)
    fallback.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
    fallback.Parent = thumb
    local function syncFallback()
        if fallback.Parent and thumb.Parent then
            fallback.Visible = not thumb.IsLoaded
        end
    end
    thumb:GetPropertyChangedSignal("IsLoaded"):Connect(syncFallback)
    local shade = Instance.new("Frame")
    shade.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 82)
    shade.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -82)
    shade.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    shade.BorderSizePixel = 0
    shade.Parent = card
    local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    gradient.Rotation = 90
    gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.18), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.05)})
    gradient.Parent = shade
    local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    avatar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
    avatar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -50)
    avatar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 20)
    avatar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    avatar.Parent = card
    RedUI.Corner(avatar, 21)
    RedUI.Stroke(avatar, Color3.fromRGB(236, 24, 70), 2)
    if userId then avatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. userId .. "&w=150&h=150" end
    -- Full-width game title: it remains visible even when the image fails.
    local title = cardLabel(card, inGame and (placeId and "Loading game..." or "Game unavailable") or "ONLINE", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20), UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -77), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 13, Color3.new(1,1,1))
    local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
    dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 60, 1, -23)
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(67, 224, 128)
    dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dot.Parent = card
    RedUI.Corner(dot, 5)
    cardLabel(card, displayName, UDim2.new(1, -155, 0, 16), UDim2.new(0, 71, 1, -28), Enum.Font.Gotham, 10, Color3.fromRGB(207,207,211))
    local join = Instance.new("TextButton")
    join.Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 32)
    join.Position = UDim2.new(1, -81, 1, -46)
    join.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 7, 9)
    join.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    join.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    join.TextSize = 11
    join.Text = "..."
    join.BorderSizePixel = 0
    join.AutoButtonColor = false
    join.Parent = card
    RedUI.Corner(join, 8)
    RedUI.Stroke(join, Color3.fromRGB(230, 22, 65), 1)
    local same = placeId == game.PlaceId
    local resolved = false
    join.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not resolved or not same or not placeId then return end
        -- GameId in GetFriendsOnline is a server instance UUID, NOT a universe ID.
        local jobId = f.GameId or f.gameId
        if type(jobId) ~= "string" or jobId == "" then
            ShowToast("Cannot join", "Friend's server ID is not available.", "Info")
            return
        end
        if RedTelemetry.SessionGuard then
            local allowed, reason = RedTelemetry.SessionGuard.canTeleport()
            if not allowed then ShowToast("Join stopped", reason, "Info"); return end
        end
        join.Text = "..."
        local ok, err = pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, LocalPlayer) end)
        if not ok then
            join.Text = "JOIN"
            ShowToast("Join failed", tostring(err), "Info")
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        local presenceName = f.GameName or f.PlaceName or f.Location or f.LastLocation or f.lastLocation
        if inGame and type(presenceName) == "string" and presenceName ~= "" and presenceName ~= "In Game" and presenceName ~= "Online" and presenceName ~= "Offline" and presenceName ~= "Website" and not presenceName:find("://") then
            title.Text = presenceName
        end
        local universeId = friendUniverse(placeId)
        local gameName = friendGameName(f, placeId, universeId)
        if not card.Parent then return end
        same = placeId ~= nil and (placeId == game.PlaceId or (universeId ~= nil and universeId == game.GameId))
        title.Text = inGame and (placeId and gameName or (gameName ~= "Online" and gameName or "Game unavailable")) or "ONLINE"
        if universeId then
            thumb.Image = "rbxthumb://type=GameIcon&id=" .. universeId .. "&w=150&h=150"
        elseif placeId then
            thumb.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. placeId .. "&w=420&h=420"
        end
        syncFallback()
        -- Preloading is asynchronous: do not block the title or join button.
        -- The fallback must disappear when the actual experience image loads.
        if thumb.Image ~= "" then
            task.spawn(function()
                local imageId = thumb.Image
                pcall(function()
                    game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({thumb}, function(_, status)
                        if thumb.Parent and fallback.Parent and thumb.Image == imageId and status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                            fallback.Visible = false
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                if thumb.Parent and fallback.Parent and thumb.Image == imageId and thumb.IsLoaded then
                    fallback.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end
        local job = f.GameId or f.gameId
        resolved = true
        if same and type(job) == "string" and job ~= "" then
            join.Text = "JOIN"
        else
            join.Text = same and "NO SERVER" or (inGame and "IN GAME" or "ONLINE")
            join.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 155)
        end
    end)
end
local function RenderFriends()
    local oldX = friendsScroll.CanvasPosition.X
    for _, child in ipairs(friendsScroll:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    local list = {}
    for _, f in ipairs(RedTelemetry.FriendsPresences) do table.insert(list, f) end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        local ap, bp = friendPlace(a), friendPlace(b)
        local as = ap == game.PlaceId or (ap and universeCache[ap] == game.GameId)
        local bs = bp == game.PlaceId or (bp and universeCache[bp] == game.GameId)
        if not not as ~= not not bs then return not not as end
        return tostring(a.UserName or a.Name or ""):lower() < tostring(b.UserName or b.Name or ""):lower()
    end)
    if RedTelemetry.FriendsError then
        friendsStatus.Text = "FRIENDS: FETCH FAILED - RETRYING IN 10S"
    else
        friendsStatus.Text = #list .. " FRIENDS ONLINE  |  SWIPE HORIZONTALLY  |  AUTO-REFRESH 10S"
    end
    if #list == 0 then
        local empty = Instance.new("Frame")
        empty.Name = "EmptyState"
        empty.Size = UDim2.new(0, 265, 1, -5)
        empty.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 21, 26)
        empty.BorderSizePixel = 0
        empty.Parent = friendsScroll
        RedUI.Corner(empty, 12)
        cardLabel(empty, RedTelemetry.FriendsError and "Unable to load friends" or "No friends online", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -14), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 12, Color3.fromRGB(190,190,195))
    else
        for i, f in ipairs(list) do drawFriend(f, i) end
    end
    task.defer(function()
        if friendsScroll.Parent then friendsScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(oldX, 0) end
    end)
end
task.spawn(function()
    while friendsCard and friendsCard.Parent do
        RenderFriends()
        task.wait(10)
    end
end)

-- V24 playback fix: native Animate is NEVER disabled, reparented, or rewritten.
-- Only tracks created by this controller may be stopped/destroyed. Native locomotion,
-- tools and emotes remain owned by their original scripts. Asset permissions still apply.
RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks = (function()
    local data = AnimationPackData
    local api = {
        closed = false,
        selected = nil,
        current = nil,
        partialMatch = nil,
        revision = 0,
        state = "INITIALIZING",
        rig = "WAITING",
        configured = 0,
        loaded = 0,
        slots = 0,
        coverage = 0,
        playing = "NO LIVE LOCOMOTION TRACK",
        warning = nil,
        lastError = nil,
        driverState = "NONE",
        recovery = false,
    }
    api.catalog = data
    local packs = {
    }
    ;
    for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
        packs[pack.name] = pack
    end
    local connections, listeners = {
    }, {
    }
    local ctx, removing
    local clock = 0
    local elapsed = 0
    local nextListener = 0
    local lastSignature = ""
    local busy = false
    local loops = {
        idle = true,
        walk = true,
        run = true,
        jump = false,
        fall = true,
        climb = true,
        swim = true,
        swimidle = true,
    }
    local blockedStates = {
    }
    for _, name in ipairs({
        "Dead",
        "Seated",
        "Physics",
        "PlatformStanding",
        "Ragdoll",
        "FallingDown",
    }) do
        blockedStates[Enum.HumanoidStateType[name]] = true
    end
    local function read(
        object,
        key
    )
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return object[key]
        end)
        if ok then
            return value, true
        end
        return nil, false
    end
    local function normalize(value)
        if type(value) ~= "string" then
            return nil
        end
        local id = value:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") or value:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or value:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
        if not id then
            return nil
        end
        id = id:gsub(
            "^0+",
            ""
        )
        ;
        return id ~= "" and id or nil
    end
    api.normalize = normalize
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn,
        bucket
    )
        local connection = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        table.insert(
            bucket or connections,
            connection
        )
        ;
        return connection
    end
    local function publish(force)
        local signature = table.concat({
            api.selected or "",
            api.current or "",
            api.partialMatch or "",
            api.state,
            api.rig,
            api.playing,
            api.warning or "",
            api.lastError or "",
            api.driverState,
            tostring(api.loaded),
            tostring(api.recovery),
            api.readbackSignature or "",
        }, "|")
        if not force and signature == lastSignature then
            return 
        end
        lastSignature = signature
        ;
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id = id,
                fn = fn,
            }
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[entry.id] == entry.fn then
                pcall(entry.fn)
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if api.closed or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        nextListener = nextListener + 1
        ;
        local id = nextListener
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        local subscription = {
            Connected = true,
        }
        function subscription:Disconnect()
            self.Connected = false
            ;
            listeners[id] = nil
        end
        return subscription
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function stopOwned(
        entry,
        fade
    )
        if entry and entry.track and entry.started then
            pcall(function()
                entry.track:Stop(fade or 0.12)
            end)
            entry.started = false
        end
    end
    local function dispose(entry)
        if not entry then
            return 
        end
        stopOwned(
            entry,
            0.08
        )
        drop(entry.track)
        ;
        drop(entry.animation)
    end
    local function clearTracks(context)
        if not context then
            return 
        end
        for _, entry in pairs(context.cache) do
            dispose(entry)
        end
        context.cache = {
        }
        ;
        context.active = nil
        ;
        context.failed = {
        }
        ;
        context.jumpFinished = false
        context.nativeMissingSince = nil
        ;
        context.lastWanted = nil
        ;
        context.recoverySession = false
    end
    local function release()
        if not ctx then
            return 
        end
        clearTracks(ctx)
        for _, connection in ipairs(ctx.connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        ctx = nil
    end
    local function obtain()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character == removing then
            character = nil
        end
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animate = character and character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        api.rig = humanoid and (humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and "R15" or "R6 / UNSUPPORTED") or "WAITING FOR CHARACTER"
        if ctx and (ctx.character ~= character or ctx.humanoid ~= humanoid or ctx.animator ~= animator or ctx.animate ~= animate or api.rig ~= "R15") then
            release()
        end
        if api.rig ~= "R15" or not humanoid or not animate then
            return nil
        end
        if not ctx then
            ctx = {
                character = character,
                humanoid = humanoid,
                animate = animate,
                animator = animator,
                connections = {
                },
                cache = {
                },
                failed = {
                },
                entries = {
                },
                original = {
                },
                lastSpeed = 0,
                jumpAt = -100,
                lastHumState = nil,
                lastWanted = nil,
                jumpFinished = false,
            }
            local context = ctx
            connect(humanoid.Running, function(speed)
                if ctx == context then
                    context.lastSpeed = tonumber(speed) or 0
                end
            end, context.connections)
            connect(humanoid.StateChanged, function(_, state)
                if ctx ~= context then
                    return 
                end
                if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                    context.jumpAt = clock
                    ;
                    context.jumpFinished = false
                end
                context.lastHumState = state
            end, context.connections)
        end
        return ctx
    end
    local function inspect(context)
        api.slots = 0
        ;
        api.coverage = 0
        ;
        api.partialMatch = nil
        ;
        api.current = nil
        api.readbackSignature = ""
        if not context then
            return 
        end
        local entries, seen, states, ids, signature = {
        }, {
        }, {
        }, {
        }, {
        }
        for _, route in ipairs(data.routes) do
            local folder = context.animate:FindFirstChild(route.category)
            local animation = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(route.child)
            if animation and animation:IsA("Animation") and not seen[animation] then
                local raw, ok = read(
                    animation,
                    "AnimationId"
                )
                if ok and type(raw) == "string" then
                    seen[animation] = true
                    ;
                    states[route.state] = true
                    entries[#entries + 1] = {
                        animation = animation,
                        state = route.state,
                        id = raw,
                    }
                    signature[#signature + 1] = route.state .. ":" .. raw
                    local id = normalize(raw)
                    if id and not ids[route.state] then
                        ids[route.state] = id
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        context.entries = entries
        ;
        context.original = ids
        api.slots = #entries
        ;
        for _ in pairs(states) do
            api.coverage = api.coverage + 1
        end
        api.readbackSignature = table.concat(
            signature,
            "|"
        )
        for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
            local matches = #entries > 0
            for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
                if normalize(entry.id) ~= pack.ids[entry.state] then
                    matches = false
                    ;
                    break
                end
            end
            if matches then
                if api.coverage == 8 then
                    api.current = pack.name
                else
                    api.partialMatch = pack.name
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end
    local function nativeEnabled(context)
        local enabled = read(
            context.animate,
            "Enabled"
        )
        if type(enabled) == "boolean" then
            return enabled
        end
        local disabled = read(
            context.animate,
            "Disabled"
        )
        return type(disabled) == "boolean" and not disabled
    end
    local function stateOf(context)
        local humanoid = context.humanoid
        if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.Sit then
            return nil, 0
        end
        local ok, state = pcall(function()
            return humanoid:GetState()
        end)
        if not ok or blockedStates[state] then
            return nil, 0
        end
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
            if context.lastHumState ~= state then
                context.jumpAt = clock
                ;
                context.jumpFinished = false
            end
            context.lastHumState = state
            return "jump", 1
        end
        context.lastHumState = state
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            if clock - context.jumpAt < 0.22 and not context.jumpFinished then
                return "jump", 1
            end
            return "fall", 1
        end
        local movement = humanoid.MoveDirection
        local moving = movement and movement.Magnitude > 0.03
        local root = context.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local velocity = root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local speed = velocity and math.sqrt(velocity.X * velocity.X + velocity.Z * velocity.Z) or 0
        if moving then
            speed = math.max(
                speed,
                context.lastSpeed,
                1
            )
        else
            speed = 0
        end
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
            local vertical = velocity and math.abs(velocity.Y) or 0
            return "climb", math.clamp(
                vertical / 5,
                0,
                2.5
            )
        end
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
            return moving and "swim" or "swimidle", moving and math.clamp(speed / 10, 0.25, 2.5) or 1
        end
        if moving then
            return speed > 16 and "run" or "walk", math.clamp(
                speed / (speed > 16 and 20 or 14),
                0.15,
                2.5
            )
        end
        return "idle", 1
    end
    local function nativeTracks(
        context,
        state
    )
        if not context.animator then
            return false, false
        end
        local ok, tracks = pcall(function()
            return context.animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
        end)
        if not ok or type(tracks) ~= "table" then
            return false, false
        end
        local nativePlaying = false
        local actionPlaying = false
        for _, track in ipairs(tracks) do
            local ours = false
            for _, entry in pairs(context.cache) do
                if entry.track == track then
                    ours = true
                    ;
                    break
                end
            end
            if not ours then
                pcall(function()
                    if not track.IsPlaying then
                        return 
                    end
                    local priority = track.Priority
                    if priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Action or priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2 or priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3 or priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4 then
                        actionPlaying = true
                    end
                    local animation = track.Animation
                    local id = animation and normalize(animation.AnimationId)
                    local locomotion = priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Core or priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
                    if not locomotion or not id then
                        return 
                    end
                    for _, entry in ipairs(context.entries) do
                        if normalize(entry.id) == id and (entry.state == state or (state == "run" and entry.state == "walk") or (state == "walk" and entry.state == "run")) then
                            nativePlaying = true
                            api.playing = "NATIVE " .. data.stateLabels[entry.state] .. " / " .. id
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        return nativePlaying, actionPlaying
    end
    local function getTrack(
        context,
        mode,
        state,
        id
    )
        local key = mode .. ":" .. state .. ":" .. id
        if context.failed[key] then
            return nil, context.failed[key]
        end
        local entry = context.cache[key]
        if entry then
            return entry
        end
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        animation.Name = "DEATH_NOTE_OWNED_" .. state
        animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return context.animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        end)
        if not ok or not track then
            drop(animation)
            context.failed[key] = "Animation load rejected / " .. state .. " / " .. id
            return nil, context.failed[key]
        end
        entry = {
            animation = animation,
            track = track,
            key = key,
            state = state,
            id = id,
            mode = mode,
            created = clock,
            started = false,
            done = false,
            lastPosition = nil,
            stalled = 0,
            restarts = 0,
            loaded = false,
        }
        local configured = pcall(function()
            track.Looped = loops[state] == true
            track.Priority = state == "idle" and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
        end)
        if not configured then
            dispose(entry)
            ;
            context.failed[key] = "Animation track configuration blocked / " .. state
            return nil, context.failed[key]
        end
        context.cache[key] = entry
        return entry
    end
    local function fadeActive(
        context,
        except
    )
        if context.active and context.active ~= except then
            stopOwned(
                context.active,
                0.12
            )
        end
        context.active = except
    end
    local function markFailed(
        context,
        entry,
        reason
    )
        context.failed[entry.key] = reason
        if context.active == entry then
            context.active = nil
        end
        context.cache[entry.key] = nil
        dispose(entry)
        return false, reason
    end
    local function play(
        context,
        mode,
        state,
        id,
        speed,
        dt
    )
        local entry, reason = getTrack(
            context,
            mode,
            state,
            id
        )
        if not entry then
            if context.active and context.active.mode == mode then
                fadeActive(
                    context,
                    nil
                )
            end
            ;
            return false, reason
        end
        local length = read(
            entry.track,
            "Length"
        )
        if type(length) ~= "number" or length <= 0 then
            if context.active and context.active.mode == mode then
                fadeActive(
                    context,
                    nil
                )
            end
            if clock - entry.created > 2 then
                return markFailed(
                    context,
                    entry,
                    "Asset did not load / " .. state .. " / native fallback"
                )
            end
            return false, "WAITING FOR ASSET / " .. state
        end
        entry.loaded = true
        if state == "jump" and context.jumpFinished then
            fadeActive(
                context,
                nil
            )
            ;
            return false, "JUMP FINISHED / WAITING FOR FALL OR LANDING"
        end
        if context.active ~= entry then
            fadeActive(
                context,
                entry
            )
            entry.done = false
            ;
            entry.stalled = 0
            ;
            entry.lastPosition = nil
        end
        local isPlaying = read(entry.track, "IsPlaying") == true
        if entry.started and not isPlaying then
            if state == "jump" then
                context.jumpFinished = true
                ;
                fadeActive(
                    context,
                    nil
                )
                ;
                return false, "JUMP FINISHED / NATIVE HANDOFF"
            end
            if clock - (entry.lastRestart or -100) < 0.75 then
                return markFailed(
                    context,
                    entry,
                    "Playback stopped repeatedly / " .. state .. " / native fallback"
                )
            end
            entry.started = false
            ;
            entry.restarts = entry.restarts + 1
            ;
            entry.lastRestart = clock
            if entry.restarts > 1 then
                return markFailed(
                    context,
                    entry,
                    "Playback could not stay active / " .. state
                )
            end
        end
        if not entry.started then
            local ok = pcall(function()
                entry.track:Play(
                    0.12,
                    1,
                    speed
                )
            end)
            if not ok then
                return markFailed(
                    context,
                    entry,
                    "Play rejected / " .. state .. " / native fallback"
                )
            end
            entry.started = true
            ;
            entry.stalled = 0
            ;
            entry.lastPosition = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            entry.track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
        end)
        if read(entry.track, "IsPlaying") ~= true then
            return false, "WAITING FOR PLAYBACK / " .. state
        end
        local position = read(
            entry.track,
            "TimePosition"
        )
        if type(position) == "number" and speed > 0.01 and loops[state] then
            if entry.lastPosition and math.abs(position - entry.lastPosition) < 0.0001 then
                entry.stalled = entry.stalled + dt
            else
                entry.stalled = 0
            end
            entry.lastPosition = position
            if entry.stalled > 1.25 then
                return markFailed(
                    context,
                    entry,
                    "Owned track stalled / " .. state .. " / native fallback"
                )
            end
        end
        api.current = mode == "pack" and api.selected or api.current
        api.recovery = mode == "original"
        api.playing = (mode == "original" and "RECOVERY " or "PACK ") .. data.stateLabels[state] .. " / " .. id
        api.driverState = state:upper()
        return true
    end
    local function drive(
        context,
        dt
    )
        api.playing = "NO LIVE LOCOMOTION TRACK"
        ;
        api.driverState = "NONE"
        ;
        api.recovery = false
        api.loaded = 0
        ;
        api.configured = 0
        if not context then
            api.state = api.rig == "R6 / UNSUPPORTED" and "R15 REQUIRED / R6 LEFT UNCHANGED" or "WAITING FOR ANIMATE"
            ;
            return 
        end
        if not context.animator then
            api.state = "WAITING FOR EXISTING ANIMATOR / NATIVE UNCHANGED"
            ;
            return 
        end
        local state, speed = stateOf(context)
        if not state then
            fadeActive(
                context,
                nil
            )
            ;
            context.nativeMissingSince = nil
            ;
            api.state = "PAUSED / HUMANOID STATE"
            ;
            return 
        end
        if context.lastWanted ~= state then
            if state == "jump" then
                context.jumpFinished = false
            end
            context.lastWanted = state
            context.nativeMissingSince = context.recoverySession and (clock - 1) or nil
            if context.active and context.active.mode == "original" and context.active.state ~= state then
                fadeActive(
                    context,
                    nil
                )
            end
        end
        local nativePlaying, actionPlaying = nativeTracks(
            context,
            state
        )
        local played = false
        local reason
        if api.selected then
            played, reason = play(
                context,
                "pack",
                state,
                packs[api.selected].ids[state],
                speed,
                dt
            )
            if not played then
                api.warning = reason
            end
        elseif context.active and context.active.mode == "pack" then
            fadeActive(
                context,
                nil
            )
        end
        if not played then
            -- Give an already-running native track, action, or intentionally disabled script
            -- ownership. Recovery starts only after a real gap, without toggling Animate.
            if nativePlaying or actionPlaying or not nativeEnabled(context) then
                context.nativeMissingSince = nil
                ;
                context.recoverySession = false
                if context.active and context.active.mode == "original" then
                    fadeActive(
                        context,
                        nil
                    )
                end
            else
                context.nativeMissingSince = context.nativeMissingSince or clock
                local id = context.original[state]
                if clock - context.nativeMissingSince >= 0.65 and id then
                    local recovered, recoveryWhy = play(
                        context,
                        "original",
                        state,
                        id,
                        speed,
                        dt
                    )
                    if recovered then
                        played = true
                        ;
                        context.recoverySession = true
                    elseif recoveryWhy then
                        api.warning = recoveryWhy
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            context.nativeMissingSince = nil
            ;
            context.recoverySession = false
            ;
            api.warning = nil
        end
        for _, entry in pairs(context.cache) do
            if entry.mode == "pack" and entry.loaded then
                api.loaded = api.loaded + 1
            end
        end
        api.configured = api.loaded
        if api.recovery then
            api.state = "ORIGINAL RECOVERY / NATIVE SCRIPT UNCHANGED"
        elseif played then
            api.state = "PACK PLAYBACK / " .. api.driverState
        elseif api.selected then
            api.state = "PACK NOT PLAYING / NATIVE FALLBACK"
        elseif nativePlaying then
            api.state = "ORIGINAL ANIMATE / RUNNING"
        elseif not nativeEnabled(context) then
            api.state = "ORIGINAL ANIMATE DISABLED BY GAME / LEFT UNCHANGED"
        else
            api.state = "ORIGINAL MODE / WATCHING FOR RECOVERY"
        end
    end
    local function pulse(
        dt,
        force
    )
        if api.closed or busy then
            return 
        end
        busy = true
        local ok, reason = pcall(function()
            local context = obtain()
            ;
            inspect(context)
            ;
            drive(
                context,
                dt or 0
            )
        end)
        busy = false
        if not ok then
            api.lastError = tostring(
                reason):sub(1,
                180
            )
            ;
            api.state = "PLAYBACK ERROR / NATIVE SCRIPT UNCHANGED"
            if ctx then
                fadeActive(
                    ctx,
                    nil
                )
            end
        end
        publish(force)
    end
    function api.refresh()
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        ;
        pulse(
            0,
            true
        )
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.select(name)
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Animation workspace closed"
        end
        if not packs[name] then
            return false, "Unknown animation pack"
        end
        if api.selected == name then
            return api.reset()
        end
        obtain()
        if api.rig == "R6 / UNSUPPORTED" then
            pulse(
                0,
                true
            )
            ;
            return false, "R15 character required; R6 was not changed"
        end
        if ctx then
            clearTracks(ctx)
        end
        api.selected = name
        ;
        api.warning = nil
        ;
        api.lastError = nil
        pulse(
            0,
            true
        )
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.reapply()
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Animation workspace closed"
        end
        if ctx then
            clearTracks(ctx)
        end
        api.warning = nil
        ;
        api.lastError = nil
        pulse(
            0,
            true
        )
        return true
    end
    function api.reset()
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Animation workspace closed"
        end
        api.selected = nil
        ;
        api.warning = nil
        ;
        api.lastError = nil
        if ctx then
            clearTracks(ctx)
        end
        pulse(
            0,
            true
        )
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.slotReport()
        local result = {
        }
        if ctx then
            for _, entry in ipairs(ctx.entries) do
                result[#result + 1] = {
                    state = entry.state,
                    name = entry.animation.Name,
                    id = entry.id,
                    owned = false,
                }
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    function api.coverageReport()
        local result = {
        }
        for _, state in ipairs(data.states) do
            local item = {
                state = state,
                label = data.stateLabels[state],
                slots = 0,
                matching = 0,
                owned = 0,
                ids = {
                },
                complete = false,
            }
            if ctx then
                for _, entry in ipairs(ctx.entries) do
                    if entry.state == state then
                        item.slots = item.slots + 1
                        ;
                        item.ids[#item.ids + 1] = normalize(entry.id) or entry.id
                    end
                end
            end
            item.available = item.slots > 0
            ;
            result[#result + 1] = item
        end
        return result
    end
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        api.closed = true
        ;
        api.selected = nil
        release()
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        connections = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        ;
        api.current = nil
        ;
        api.recovery = false
        ;
        api.state = "CLOSED"
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
        removing = character or LocalPlayer.Character
        ;
        release()
        ;
        api.current = nil
        ;
        api.state = "WAITING FOR RESPAWN"
        ;
        publish(true)
    end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        removing = nil
        ;
        pulse(
            0,
            true
        )
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        local delta = math.clamp(
            tonumber(dt) or 0,
            0,
            0.25
        )
        clock = clock + delta
        ;
        elapsed = elapsed + delta
        if elapsed >= 1 / 30 then
            local step = elapsed
            ;
            elapsed = 0
            ;
            pulse(step)
        end
    end)
    connect(MainGui.Destroying, function()
        api.close()
    end)
    pulse(
        0,
        true
    )
    return api
end)()

        local function match(
            pack,
            query
        )
            return query == "" or pack.name:lower(
                ):find(query,
                1,
                true) or pack.tag:lower():find(query,
                1,
                true
            )
        end
        local function clearRows()
            for _, c in ipairs(rowConnections) do
                c:Disconnect()
            end
            rowConnections = {
            }
            ;
            views = {
            }
            ;
            detailButtons = {
            }
            ;
            detailsPanel = nil
            ;
            livePanel = nil
            ;
            liveViews = {
            }
            for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
                if child ~= list and child ~= header and child ~= footer and child ~= usage then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
        -- Optional live readback inspector. It never writes animation properties.

        local function updateLive()
            if not inspectorOpen then
                return 
            end
            local report = controller.slotReport()
            if not livePanel or #liveViews ~= #report then
                drawLive()
            end
            for i, item in ipairs(controller.coverageReport()) do
                local value = liveCoverage[i]
                if value then
                    value.Text = item.available and (item.complete and "MATCHED" or tostring(item.slots) .. " SLOT(S)") or "MISSING"
                    value.TextColor3 = item.available and palette.green or palette.gold
                end
            end
            for i, item in ipairs(report) do
                local view = liveViews[i]
                if view then
                    view.title.Text = data.stateLabels[item.state] .. " / " .. item.name
                    view.value.Text = controller.normalize(item.id) or tostring(item.id)
                    view.ownership.Text = item.owned and "OWNED / RESTORE ON OFF" or "GAME VALUE / NOT FORCED"
                    view.ownership.TextColor3 = item.owned and palette.green or palette.muted
                end
            end
        end

                        5 + i * 4

                    color
                )
                bar.Rotation = -14
            end
        end
