        local function drawPack(
            parent,
            pack,
            column
        )
            local card = frame(
                parent,
                "AnimationPack_" .. pack.name,
                UDim2.new(
                    0.5,
                    -5,
                    1,
                    0
                ),
                UDim2.new(
                    column * 0.5,
                    column == 0 and 0 or 3,
                    0,
                    0
                ),
                palette.card
            )
            corner(
                card,
                11
            )
            local border = outline(
                card,
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    60,
                    67,
                    94
                ),
                1
            )
            local accent = frame(
                card,
                "PackAccent",
                UDim2.new(
                    0,
                    3,
                    1,
                    -18
                ),
                UDim2.new(
                    0,
                    0,
                    0,
                    9
                ),
                pack.accent
            )
            ;
            corner(
                accent,
                3
            )
            local title = text(
                card,
                "PackName",
                pack.name:upper(),
                UDim2.new(
                    1,
                    -92,
                    0,
                    25
                ),
                UDim2.new(
                    0,
                    12,
                    0,
                    8
                ),
                14,
                pack.accent
            )
            local tag = text(
                card,
                "PackTag",
                pack.tag .. " / R15",
                UDim2.new(
                    1,
                    -65,
                    0,
                    16
                ),
                UDim2.new(
                    0,
                    12,
                    0,
                    35
                ),
                8,
                palette.muted
            )
            local toggle = button(card, "AnimationToggle_" .. pack.name, "OFF", UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 27), UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 8), palette.field, function()
                toast(controller.select(pack.name))
            end, rowConnections)
            local meta = text(
                card,
                "PackState",
                "8 MOTION STATES",
                UDim2.new(
                    1,
                    -65,
                    0,
                    17
                ),
                UDim2.new(
                    0,
                    12,
                    0,
                    54
                ),
                8,
                palette.white
            )
            ornament(
                card,
                pack.accent
            )
            local detail = button(card, "AnimationDetails_" .. pack.name, "VIEW IDS", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 21), UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -29), palette.field, function()
                if selectedDetails == pack.name then
                    selectedDetails = nil
                else
                    selectedDetails = pack.name
                end
                if detailsPanel then
                    detailsPanel:Destroy()
                    ;
                    detailsPanel = nil
                end
                if selectedDetails then
                    for _, candidate in ipairs(data.packs) do
                        if candidate.name == selectedDetails then
                            detailsPanel = drawDetail(
                                candidate,
                                parent.LayoutOrder + 1
                            )
                        end
                    end
                end
                for name, b in pairs(detailButtons) do
                    b.Text = name == selectedDetails and "HIDE IDS" or "VIEW IDS"
                end
            end, rowConnections)
            detailButtons[pack.name] = detail
            views[pack.name] = {
                rowOrder = parent.LayoutOrder,
                frame = card,
                toggle = toggle,
                border = border,
                meta = meta,
                accent = pack.accent,
            }
        end
        local function buildRows()
            if not alive then
                return 
            end
            clearRows()
            local query = search.Text:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            local packs = {
            }
            for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
                if match(pack, query) then
                    packs[#packs + 1] = pack
                end
            end
            table.sort(packs, function(a, b)
                return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
            end)
            for i = 1, #packs, 2 do
                local row = frame(
                    scroll,
                    "AnimationPackRow" .. math.ceil(i / 2),
                    UDim2.new(
                        1,
                        -7,
                        0,
                        111
                    ),
                    UDim2.new(),
                    palette.background
                )
                row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                ;
                row.LayoutOrder = math.ceil(i / 2) * 2
                drawPack(
                    row,
                    packs[i],
                    0
                )
                if packs[i + 1] then
                    drawPack(
                        row,
                        packs[i + 1],
                        1
                    )
                end
            end
            if #packs == 0 then
                local empty = text(
                    scroll,
                    "AnimationNoResults",
                    "NO MATCHING PACKS / TRY ANOTHER NAME",
                    UDim2.new(
                        1,
                        -8,
                        0,
                        58
                    ),
                    UDim2.new(),
                    11,
                    palette.gold
                )
                empty.LayoutOrder = 1
                ;
                empty.TextWrapped = true
            end
            if selectedDetails then
                for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
                    if pack.name == selectedDetails and views[pack.name] then
                        detailsPanel = drawDetail(
                            pack,
                            views[pack.name].rowOrder + 1
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            for name, b in pairs(detailButtons) do
                b.Text = name == selectedDetails and "HIDE IDS" or "VIEW IDS"
            end
            scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
                0,
                0
            )
            if inspectorOpen then
                drawLive()
            end
            if refresh then
                refresh()
            end
        end
        refresh = function()
            if not alive then
                return 
            end
            updateLive()
            local name = controller.current
            currentName.Text = name and name:upper() or controller.partialMatch and (controller.partialMatch:upper() .. " / PARTIAL") or controller.slots > 0 and "CUSTOM / MIXED OR GAME DEFAULT" or "WAITING FOR R15 ANIMATE"
            currentName.TextSize = name and 19 or 13
            rigBadge.Text = controller.rig == "R15" and "R15 READY" or controller.rig == "R6 / UNSUPPORTED" and "R6 BLOCKED" or "WAITING"
            rigBadge.TextColor3 = controller.rig == "R15" and palette.green or palette.gold
            selectedLabel.Text = "SELECTED: " .. (controller.selected and controller.selected:upper() or "ORIGINAL MODE") .. " | DRIVER: " .. controller.driverState .. " | " .. tostring(controller.loaded) .. "/8 PACK STATES LOADED"
            playingLabel.Text = "PLAYING: " .. controller.playing
            stateLabel.Text = controller.lastError and ("ERROR: " .. controller.lastError) or controller.warning or controller.state
            stateLabel.TextColor3 = controller.lastError and palette.pink or controller.warning and palette.gold or palette.green
            footer.Text = controller.rig == "R6 / UNSUPPORTED" and "R15 PACKS REQUIRE AN R15 CHARACTER. NO FORCED RIG CONVERSION OR RESPAWN." or "NATIVE ANIMATE STAYS RUNNING / OFF STOPS ONLY PACK-OWNED TRACKS / ORIGINAL RECOVERY WATCHDOG"
            local activeAccent = palette.cyan
            for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
                if pack.name == name then
                    activeAccent = pack.accent
                    ;
                    break
                end
            end
            currentName.TextColor3 = name and activeAccent or palette.white
            stripe.BackgroundColor3 = activeAccent
            ;
            currentStroke.Color = activeAccent
            for packName, view in pairs(views) do
                local selected = controller.selected == packName
                local detected = controller.current == packName
                view.toggle.Text = selected and "ON" or "OFF"
                view.toggle.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(12, 29, 26) or palette.white
                view.toggle.BackgroundColor3 = selected and view.accent or palette.field
                view.border.Color = selected and view.accent or detected and Color3.fromRGB(
                    100,
                    125,
                    155) or Color3.fromRGB(60,
                    67,
                    94
                )
                view.border.Thickness = selected and 1.6 or 1
                view.meta.Text = selected and (detected and "PACK DRIVER ACTIVE" or "SELECTED / SEE STATUS") or detected and "CURRENT GAME PACK" or "8 MOTION STATES"
                view.meta.TextColor3 = selected and view.accent or palette.white
            end
        end
        connect(
            search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),
            buildRows
        )
        connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
            if page.Visible then
                controller.refresh()
                ;
                refresh()
            end
        end)
        connections[#connections + 1] = controller.subscribe(refresh)
        connect(MainGui.Destroying, function()
            if not alive then
                return 
            end
            alive = false
            for _, c in ipairs(rowConnections) do
                c:Disconnect()
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
                c:Disconnect()
            end
            rowConnections = {
            }
            ;
            connections = {
            }
            ;
            views = {
            }
            ;
            detailButtons = {
            }
        end)
        buildRows()
        ;
        refresh()
    end)()
end

end)()
end

local function AddDockBtn(shortCode, title, tabTarget)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Text = (title ~= "" and (shortCode .. " " .. title) or shortCode)
    b.Size = title == "ANIMATIONS" and UDim2.new(0, 116, 0, 26) or title ~= "" and UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 26) or UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 26)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = title ~= "" and RedTheme.Get("Accent") or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    b.BackgroundTransparency = title ~= "" and 0 or 1
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 10
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.LayoutOrder = title == "HOME" and 1 or title == "QUICK" and 2 or title == "VISUALS" and 3 or 4
    b.Parent = BottomDock
    if tabTarget then RedUI.DockButtons[tabTarget] = b end
    RedUI.Corner(b, 13)

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        RedAudio.Play("Click")
        if tabTarget and TabBtns[tabTarget] then
            RedUI.SelectPage(tabTarget)
        else
            ShowToast("Feature", "Module ready for custom scripts", "Info")
        end
    end)
end

-- Local overhead tags and opt-in shared presence relay. The relay does not verify identities.
local presenceState = RedUI.Label(BrandHeaderBar, "PRESENCE: NOT CONFIGURED", UDim2.new(0, 125, 0, 18), UDim2.new(1, -245, 0.5, -9), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 8, Color3.fromRGB(175, 165, 185))
local tagMap = {}
local activePresence = {[LocalPlayer.UserId] = true}
local lastPresenceSuccess = 0
local requestFunction = (syn and syn.request) or http_request or request or (http and http.request)
local function removeTag(player)
    if tagMap[player] then tagMap[player]:Destroy(); tagMap[player] = nil end
end
local movementBusy = false
local function goToTaggedPlayer(player)
    if movementBusy or player == LocalPlayer then return end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local otherCharacter = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRoot = otherCharacter and otherCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not targetRoot then ShowToast("Unavailable", "Player character not ready", "Info"); return end
    movementBusy = true
    local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
    flash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70)
    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
    flash.ZIndex = 50
    flash.Parent = MainGui
    RedAudio.Play("Notification")
    TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency=0.58}):Play()
    task.wait(0.2)
    if MainGui.Parent and root.Parent and targetRoot.Parent then
        local ok = pcall(function() root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(3,0,3) end)
        ShowToast(ok and "Moved" or "Move failed", ok and ("Near " .. player.Name) or "Movement blocked", "Info")
    end
    TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
    task.delay(0.4, function() if flash.Parent then flash:Destroy() end end)
    task.wait(0.6)
    movementBusy = false
end
local function syncTag(player)
    local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not activePresence[player.UserId] or not head then removeTag(player); return end
    if tagMap[player] and tagMap[player].Adornee == head then return end
    removeTag(player)
    local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    tag.Name = "DeathNotePresenceTag"
    tag.Adornee = head
    tag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(195,48)
    tag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.8,0)
    tag.AlwaysOnTop = true
    tag.MaxDistance = 100
    tag.Parent = MainGui
    tagMap[player] = tag
    local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
    panel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16,13,18)
    panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
    panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    panel.Parent = tag
    RedUI.Corner(panel,12)
    RedUI.Stroke(panel,Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70),1.2)
    local icon = Instance.new("TextButton")
    icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34,34)
    icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7,7)
    icon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9,9,11)
    icon.Text = "R"
    icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70)
    icon.TextSize = 25
    icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
    icon.Parent = panel
    RedUI.Corner(icon,8)
    RedUI.Stroke(icon,Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70),1)
    local name = RedUI.Label(panel, player.Name, UDim2.fromOffset(140,20), UDim2.fromOffset(49,5), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 12, Color3.fromRGB(245,243,247))
    name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    local role = string.lower(player.Name) == string.lower(OWNER_USERNAME) and "OWNER" or "USER"
    RedUI.Label(panel, role, UDim2.fromOffset(130,15), UDim2.fromOffset(49,25), Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 10, Color3.fromRGB(255,202,74))
    icon.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() goToTaggedPlayer(player) end)
end
local function syncAllTags()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do syncTag(player) end
    for player in pairs(tagMap) do if player.Parent ~= Players then removeTag(player) end end
end
local function updateSharedPresence()
    if os.clock() - lastPresenceSuccess > 50 then activePresence = {[LocalPlayer.UserId] = true} end
    if not SHARE_PRESENCE then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: OFF"; return end
    if PRESENCE_URL == "" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: SET BACKEND URL"; return end
    if not PRESENCE_URL:match("^https://") then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: HTTPS REQUIRED"; return end
    if type(requestFunction) ~= "function" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: HTTP UNAVAILABLE"; return end
    if game.JobId == "" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: NO SERVER ID"; return end
    local ok, response = pcall(requestFunction, {Url=PRESENCE_URL, Method="POST", Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"}, Body=HttpService:JSONEncode({userId=LocalPlayer.UserId, placeId=game.PlaceId, jobId=game.JobId})})
    if not MainGui.Parent then return end
    local status = ok and response and tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.Status)
    if not status or status < 200 or status >= 300 then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: CONNECTION FAILED"; return end
    local valid, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body) end)
    if not valid or type(data)~="table" or type(data.userIds)~="table" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: BAD RESPONSE"; return end
    lastPresenceSuccess = os.clock()
    activePresence = {[LocalPlayer.UserId] = true}
    for _, id in ipairs(data.userIds) do if type(id)=="number" then activePresence[id]=true end end
    presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: ONLINE (UNVERIFIED)"
end
task.spawn(function()
    while MainGui and MainGui.Parent do
        updateSharedPresence()
        syncAllTags()
        for _=1,15 do if not MainGui.Parent then return end; task.wait(1) end
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while MainGui and MainGui.Parent do syncAllTags(); task.wait(2) end
end)

    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then toggleWindow() end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- CORE ENGINE EXTENSION NODE 1: ADVANCED UTILITY SUBSYSTEM
-- Provides high-frequency event caching, reactive subscriptions, and math helpers.
-- ============================================================================
local DeathNoteSubsystem_1 = {}
do
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.NodeId = 1
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Active = true
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache = {}
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers = {}

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Register(key, value)
        DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache[key] = value
        local hList = DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key]
        if hList then
            for idx = 1, #hList do
                pcall(hList[idx], value)
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Get(key, fallback)
        local val = DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache[key]
        if val == nil then return fallback end
        return val
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Bind(key, fn)
        if not DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key] then
            DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key] = {}
        end
        table.insert(DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key], fn)
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Purge()
        table.clear(DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache)
        table.clear(DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers)
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.CheckIntegrity()
        local k = "NodeTest_" .. tostring(1)
        DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Register(k, os.time())
        return DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Get(k) ~= nil
    end
end

-- The GUI is already visible. Photo/game/creation metadata load independently.
RedTelemetry.AgeService.start()
RedTelemetry.AvatarService.startOwn()
task.spawn(function()
    if RedTelemetry.Closed then return end
    RedTelemetry.AgeService.refreshLocal(true)
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local function valid() return not RedTelemetry.Closed end
    if not valid() then return end
    local ok,image,ready=RedTelemetry.AvatarService.bounded(10,function()
        return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(LocalPlayer.UserId,Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size352x352)
    end,valid)
    if ok and ready~=false and type(image)=="string" and image~="" and valid() then
        RedTelemetry.PlayerThumbnail=image
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local function valid() return not RedTelemetry.Closed end
    if not valid() then return end
    local ok,info=RedTelemetry.AvatarService.bounded(10,function()
        return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
    end,valid)
    if not ok or type(info)~="table" or not valid() then return end
    if type(info.Name)=="string" and info.Name~="" then RedTelemetry.GameTitle=info.Name end
    if tonumber(info.IconImageAssetId) and tonumber(info.IconImageAssetId)>0 then
        RedTelemetry.GameThumbnail="rbxassetid://"..tostring(info.IconImageAssetId)
    elseif tonumber(game.GameId) and game.GameId>0 then
        RedTelemetry.GameThumbnail="rbxthumb://type=GameIcon&id="..tostring(game.GameId).."&w=150&h=150"
    end
end)

-- DEATH NOTE V31 / ADDITIVE 10K EMOTE EXTENSION / ORIGINAL V24 ABOVE PRESERVED
-- V30 ADDITIVE EXTENSION: the supplied last-working v24 above is unchanged.
-- Core hub finishes booting first. Emote code/data initialize only on category click.
-- Neither a catalog/UI error nor a missing optional capability may abort old features.
do
    (function()
        local extension = {
            closed = false,
            initialized = false,
            initializing = false,
            error = nil,
        }
        RedTelemetry.EmoteExtension = extension
        local links = {
        }
        local randomPanel, fourthTab
        local r6Panel, thirdTab
        local fifthTab, sixthTab, ucgPanel
        local panel, root, firstTab, secondTab, packList, liveButton, badge, firstGradient
        local firstSize, firstPosition, liveSize, livePosition, badgeVisible, firstColor
        local function connect(
            signal,
            fn
        )
            local c = signal:Connect(fn)
            ;
            links[#links + 1] = c
            ;
            return c
        end
        local function find(
            parent,
            name
        )
            if not parent then
                return nil
            end
            if parent.Name == name then
                return parent
            end
            for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                local found = find(
                    child,
                    name
                )
                ;
                if found then
                    return found
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function trace(why)
            local message = tostring(why)
            if debug and debug.traceback then
                local ok, result = pcall(
                    debug.traceback,
                    message,
                    2
                )
                ;
                if ok then
                    return result

    local api = {

    local queryDue

        signal,

        bucket
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        table.insert(
            bucket or connections,
            c
        )
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function disconnect(list)
        for _, c in ipairs(list) do
            c:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    local function publish(force)
        local signature = table.concat({
            tostring(api.enabled),
            tostring(api.browserOpen),
            tostring(api.browserMinimized),
            tostring(api.ready),
            tostring(api.loaded),
            tostring(api.page),
            tostring(api.resultRevision),
            tostring(api.filtering),
            tostring(api.filterProgress),
            api.query,
            tostring(api.favoritesOnly),
            tostring(api.thumbnails),
            tostring(api.favoriteCount),
            api.state,
            api.error or "",
            api.progress,
            api.nowId or "",
        }, "|")
        if not force and signature == lastSignature then
            return 
        end
        lastSignature = signature
        ;
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, pair in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[pair[1]] == pair[2] then

                if not ok then

                        warn("DeathNote emote UI: " .. tostring(why))

                end
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if api.closed or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        listenerId = listenerId + 1
        ;
        local id = listenerId
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        local handle = {
            Connected = true,
        }
        function handle:Disconnect()
            self.Connected = false
            ;
            listeners[id] = nil
        end
        return handle
    end
    local function characterInfo()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character == removing then
            character = nil
        end
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        return character, hum, animator
    end
    local function moving(hum)
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.PlatformStand or hum.Sit then
            return true
        end
        if hum.MoveDirection and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.03 then
            return true
        end
        local ok, state = pcall(function()
            return hum:GetState()
        end)
        if not ok then
            return true
        end
        return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    end
    local function disposeTrack(
        track,
        animation,
        native
    )
        -- Native Animate may retain its returned emote track in an internal cache.
        -- Match the source: stop it, but do not destroy that native cache object.

                track:Stop(0.12)
            end)
            ;
            if not native then
                drop(track)
            end
        end
        drop(animation)
    end

        end
        api.nowPlaying = nil
        ;
        api.nowId = nil
        if reason then
            api.state = reason
        end
        publish()
    end
    local function stow()
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if tool and tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character and backpack then
            pcall(function()
                tool.Parent = backpack
            end)
        end
    end
    local function loadFavorites()
        if favoritesLoaded then
            return 
        end
        favoritesLoaded = true
        if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
            return 
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            if not isfile(favoritesPath) then
                return nil
            end
            local raw = readfile(favoritesPath)
            if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 2000000 then
                return nil
            end
            return http:JSONDecode(raw)
        end)
        if ok and type(data) == "table" then
            for _, id in ipairs(data) do
                id = tostring(id)
                ;
                if id:match("^%d+$") and #id <= 16 then
                    favorites[id] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function saveFavorites()
        if not favoriteDirty then
            return 
        end
        favoriteDirty = false
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return 
        end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder("DeathNote") then
                makefolder("DeathNote")
            end
            local saved = {
            }
            ;
            for id in pairs(favorites) do
                saved[#saved + 1] = id
            end
            writefile(
                favoritesPath,
                http:JSONEncode(saved)
            )
        end)
        if not ok then
            api.error = "Favorites kept in memory; local file save unavailable"
        end
    end
    local function favoriteCount()
        local n = 0
        ;
        for id in pairs(favorites) do
            if byId[id] then
                n = n + 1
            end
        end
        ;
        api.favoriteCount = n
    end
    local function updatePages()
        api.pages = math.max(
            1,
            math.ceil(#results / api.pageSize)
        )
        ;
        api.page = math.clamp(
            api.page,
            1,
            api.pages
        )
        api.resultRevision = api.resultRevision + 1
    end
    local function startQuery()
        if not api.ready then
            return 
        end
        queryGeneration = queryGeneration + 1
        local words = {
        }
        for word in api.query:lower():gmatch("%S+") do
            if #words < 8 then
                words[#words + 1] = word
            end
        end
        if #words == 0 and not api.favoritesOnly then
            results = items
            ;
            queryJob = nil
            ;
            api.filtering = false
            ;
            api.filterProgress = 100
            ;
            api.page = 1
            ;
            updatePages()
            ;
            return 
        end
        queryJob = {
            generation = queryGeneration,
            index = 1,
            result = {
            },
            words = words,
            favorites = api.favoritesOnly,
        }
        api.filtering = true
        ;
        api.filterProgress = 0
    end
    function api.search(query)
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        local value = tostring(query or "")
        local valid, cut = pcall(function()
            return utf8.offset(
                value,
                101
            )
        end)
        if valid then
            if cut then
                value = value:sub(
                    1,
                    cut - 1
                )
            end
        else
            value = value:gsub(
                "[\128-\255]",
                ""):sub(1,
                100
            )
        end
        api.query = value
        queryGeneration = queryGeneration + 1
        ;
        queryJob = nil
        ;
        queryDue = clock + 0.18
        api.filtering = api.ready
        ;
        api.filterProgress = 0
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.toggleFavoritesOnly()
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        api.favoritesOnly = not api.favoritesOnly
        ;
        queryDue = nil
        ;
        startQuery()
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.favorite(id)
        id = tostring(id)
        ;
        return favorites[id] == true
    end
    function api.toggleFavorite(id)
        id = tostring(id)
        if not byId[id] or api.closed then
            return false
        end
        if favorites[id] then
            favorites[id] = nil
        else
            favorites[id] = true
        end
        favoriteCount()
        ;
        favoriteDirty = true
        ;
        favoriteDue = clock + 0.5
        if api.favoritesOnly then
            startQuery()
        end
        api.resultRevision = api.resultRevision + 1
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setThumbnails(value)
        if api.closed or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false
        end
        api.thumbnails = value
        ;
        api.resultRevision = api.resultRevision + 1
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.goToPage(number)
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        number = tonumber(number)
        if not number or number ~= number or math.abs(number) == math.huge then
            return false
        end
        api.page = math.clamp(
            math.floor(number),
            1,
            api.pages
        )
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.pageItems()
        local page = {
        }
        local start = (api.page - 1) * api.pageSize + 1
        for i = start, math.min(#results, start + api.pageSize - 1) do
            page[#page + 1] = results[i]
        end
        return page, #results
    end
    function api.load()
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        if api.ready then
            return true
        end
        api.loading = true
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        api.progress = "LOADING EMBEDDED CATALOG / 500 ITEMS PER BATCH"
        loadFavorites()
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function loadBatch()
        if not api.loading or api.ready or not api.enabled or not api.browserOpen or api.browserMinimized then
            return 
        end
        local encoded = EmoteCatalogData.chunks[loadIndex]
        if not encoded then
            api.loading = false
            ;
            api.error = "Embedded catalog chunk missing"
            ;
            return 
        end
        local ok, rows = pcall(function()
            return http:JSONDecode(encoded)
        end)
        if not ok or type(rows) ~= "table" then
            api.loading = false
            ;
            api.error = "Catalog decoding failed; reopen or reload the full script"
            ;
            return 
        end
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
            if type(row) == "table" and type(row[1]) == "string" and row[1]:match("^%d+$") and not byId[row[1]] then
                local name = tostring(row[2] or ("Emote " .. row[1]))
                local item = {
                    id = row[1],
                    name = name,
                    key = name:lower(),
                }
                byId[item.id] = item
                ;
                items[#items + 1] = item
            end
        end
        EmoteCatalogData.chunks[loadIndex] = nil
        ;
        loadIndex = loadIndex + 1
        api.loaded = #items
        ;
        api.progress = "CATALOG " .. tostring(api.loaded) .. " / " .. tostring(api.total)
        if loadIndex > chunkCount then
            api.loading = false
            ;
            api.ready = true
            ;
            EmoteCatalogData.chunks = {
            }
            favoriteCount()
            ;
            startQuery()
            api.progress = tostring(api.loaded) .. " EMOTES READY / ONLY 8 CARDS RENDERED"
            if api.loaded ~= api.total then
                api.error = "Catalog count differs from embedded snapshot"
            end
        end
    end
    local function queryBatch()
        local job = queryJob
        if not job or not api.enabled or not api.browserOpen or api.browserMinimized then
            return 
        end
        if job.generation ~= queryGeneration then
            queryJob = nil
            ;
            return 
        end
        local finish = math.min(
            #items,
            job.index + 1023
        )
        for i = job.index, finish do
            local item = items[i]
            local match = not job.favorites or favorites[item.id]
            if match then
                for _, word in ipairs(job.words) do
                    if not item.key:find(word, 1, true) then
                        match = false
                        ;
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if match then
                job.result[#job.result + 1] = item
            end
        end
        job.index = finish + 1
        ;
        api.filterProgress = math.floor(finish / math.max(1, #items) * 100)
        if job.index > #items then
            results = job.result
            ;
            queryJob = nil
            ;
            api.filtering = false
            ;
            api.filterProgress = 100
            ;
            api.page = 1
            ;
            updatePages()
        end
    end
    function api.setMinimized(value)
        if api.closed or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false
        end
        api.browserMinimized = value
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.closeBrowser()
        api.browserOpen = false
        ;
        api.browserMinimized = false
        ;
        api.stop(api.enabled and "R15 TOOL READY / TAP TO OPEN" or "R15 TOOL OFF")
        ;
        publish()
    end
    function api.open()
        if api.closed or not api.enabled then
            return false, "Turn R15 Tool ON first"
        end
        local _, hum = characterInfo()
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return false, "Waiting for a live character"
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return false, "R15 character required"
        end
        api.browserOpen = true
        ;
        api.browserMinimized = false
        ;
        stow()
        ;
        api.load()
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function removeTool()
        disconnect(toolConnections)
        ;
        toolConnections = {
        }
        local current = tool
        ;
        tool = nil
        ;
        api.tool = nil
        ;
        drop(current)
    end
    local function ensureTool()
        if api.closed or not api.enabled then
            return 
        end
        local character, hum = characterInfo()
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            api.state = "TOOL ON / WAITING FOR CHARACTER"
            ;
            return 
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            removeTool()
            ;
            api.state = "R15 REQUIRED / TOOL NOT GRANTED TO R6"
            ;
            return 
        end
        if tool and tool.Parent then
            return 
        end
        removeTool()
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not backpack then
            api.state = "TOOL ON / WAITING FOR BACKPACK"
            ;
            return 
        end
        tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        ;
        tool.Name = "R15 Tool"
        ;
        tool.ToolTip = "Death'Note / R15 Emotes"
        tool.RequiresHandle = false
        ;
        tool.CanBeDropped = false
        ;
        tool.Enabled = true
        pcall(function()
            tool:SetAttribute(
                "DeathNoteEmoteTool",
                true
            )
        end)
        api.tool = tool
        connect(tool.Equipped, function()
            if api.enabled and not api.closed then
                api.open()
                local current = tool
                task.defer(function()
                    if tool == current and api.enabled and not api.closed then
                        stow()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end, toolConnections)
        connect(tool.Activated, function()
            if api.enabled and not api.closed then
                api.open()
            end
        end, toolConnections)
        tool.Parent = backpack
        ;
        api.state = "R15 TOOL READY / EQUIP OR TAP TO OPEN"
    end
    function api.setEnabled(value)
        if api.closed or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false, "Use ON/OFF"
        end
        local _, hum = characterInfo()
        if value and hum and hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return false, "R15 character required; R6 was not changed"
        end
        api.enabled = value
        ;
        api.error = nil
        if value then
            ensureTool()
        else
            api.browserOpen = false
            ;
            api.stop("R15 TOOL OFF")
            ;
            removeTool()
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function validRequest(
        generation,
        character,
        hum
    )
        local current, currentHum = characterInfo()
        return not api.closed and api.enabled and generation == requestGeneration and current == character and currentHum == hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and not moving(hum)
    end
    -- Source flow: register an emote on the LIVE HumanoidDescription, then call
    -- PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById. Only the selected temporary key is ours.
    local function copyMap(value)
        local result = {
        }
        for key, list in pairs(value or {
        }) do
            local row = {
            }
            ;
            for i, id in ipairs(list) do
                row[i] = id
            end
            ;
            result[key] = row
        end
        return result
    end
    releaseRegistration = function()
        local entry = registration
        ;
        registration = nil
        if not entry then
            return 
        end
        pcall(function()
            local map = entry.description:GetEmotes()
            local value = map[entry.key]
            if type(value) ~= "table" or #value ~= 1 or tostring(value[1]) ~= entry.id then
                return 
            end
            local ok, equipped = pcall(function()
                return entry.description:GetEquippedEmotes()
            end)
            if ok and type(equipped) == "table" then
                local kept = {
                }
                for _, slot in ipairs(equipped) do
                    local name = type(slot) == "table" and slot.Name or slot
                    if name ~= entry.key then
                        kept[#kept + 1] = slot
                    elseif entry.replacedSlot then
                        local previous = entry.replacedSlot
                        local previousName = type(previous) == "table" and previous.Name or previous
                        if map[previousName] then
                            kept[#kept + 1] = previous
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    entry.description:SetEquippedEmotes(kept)
                end)
            end
            map = copyMap(map)
            ;
            map[entry.key] = nil
            ;
            entry.description:SetEmotes(map)
        end)
    end
    local function registerSelection(
        hum,
        item,
        generation
    )
        local description = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription") or hum:FindFirstChild("HumanoidDescription")
        if not description then
            return false, "Live HumanoidDescription not present"
        end
        local ok, why = pcall(function()
            local map = copyMap(description:GetEmotes())
            local key = "DeathNote Emote " .. tostring(generation)
            while map[key] do
                key = key .. "_"
            end
            map[key] = {
                tonumber(item.id),
            }
            -- Ledger precedes setters so partial failures can still be rolled back.
            registration = {
                description = description,
                key = key,
                id = item.id,
            }
            description:SetEmotes(map)
            local equippedOK, equipped = pcall(function()
                return description:GetEquippedEmotes()
            end)
            if equippedOK and type(equipped) == "table" then
                local used = {
                }
                ;
                local slots = {
                }
                for index, slot in ipairs(equipped) do
                    slots[#slots + 1] = slot
                    used[type(slot) == "table" and slot.Slot or index] = true
                end
                local added = false
                for slot = 1, 8 do
                    if not used[slot] then
                        slots[#slots + 1] = {
                            Name = key,
                            Slot = slot,
                        }
                        ;
                        added = true
                        ;
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not added then
                    for index, slot in ipairs(slots) do
                        local number = type(slot) == "table" and slot.Slot or index
                        if number == 8 then
                            registration.replacedSlot = slot
                            ;
                            slots[index] = {
                                Name = key,
                                Slot = 8,
                            }
                            ;
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    description:SetEquippedEmotes(slots)
                end)
            end
        end)
        return ok, tostring(why or "")
    end
    local function animationId(value)
        local text = tostring(value or "")
        local id = text:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$") or text:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or text:match("^(%d+)$")
        if id and tonumber(id) and tonumber(id) > 0 and tonumber(id) <= 9007199254740991 then
            return id
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function resolveClip(
        item,
        generation,
        character,
        hum
    )
        if clipCache[item.id] then
            return clipCache[item.id], "cached Animation.AnimationId"
        end
        local failure = "Asset did not expose an Animation object"
        for _, uri in ipairs({
            "rbxassetid://" .. item.id,
            "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. item.id,
        }) do
            if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                return nil, "Request cancelled"
            end
            local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects(uri)
            end)
            if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
                local found
                local inspected, why = pcall(function()
                    local queue = {
                    }
                    ;
                    for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
                        queue[#queue + 1] = object
                    end
                    local index = 1
                    while index <= #queue and index <= 2048 and not found do
                        local object = queue[index]
                        ;
                        index = index + 1
                        -- Never parent fetched models/scripts into the DataModel. Inspect data only.
                        if object:IsA("Animation") then
                            found = animationId(object.AnimationId)
                        end
                        if not found and #queue < 2048 then
                            for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
                                if #queue >= 2048 then
                                    break
                                end
                                queue[#queue + 1] = child
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                -- Destroy EVERY fetched root, including siblings after a successful match.
                for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
                    drop(object)
                end
                if not inspected then
                    failure = tostring(why)
                end
                if found and validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                    clipCache[item.id] = found
                    ;
                    clipOrder[#clipOrder + 1] = item.id
                    if #clipOrder > 128 then
                        clipCache[table.remove(clipOrder, 1)] = nil
                    end
                    return found, "resolved Animation.AnimationId"
                end
            elseif not ok then
                failure = tostring(objects)
            end
        end
        return nil, failure
    end
    local function beginPlay(item)
        if nativeBusy then
            api.stop("WAITING FOR PREVIOUS EMOTE REQUEST")
            ;
            return false, "Previous asset request is still finishing; tap again shortly"
        end
        local character, hum, animator = characterInfo()
        if not character or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return false, "Character unavailable"
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return false, "R15 character required"
        end
        if moving(hum) then
            return false, "Stand still first; movement or jumping cancels an emote"
        end
        if not animator then
            return false, "Waiting for the game's Animator"
        end
        if clock - lastClick < 0.25 then
            return false, "Wait briefly before selecting another emote"
        end
        lastClick = clock
        ;
        api.stop()
        ;
        api.error = nil
        local generation = requestGeneration
        stow()
        ;
        api.state = "REGISTERING / " .. item.name
        inflight = {
            generation = generation,
            character = character,
            hum = hum,
            started = clock,
        }
        ;
        publish()
        task.spawn(function()
            if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                return 
            end
            nativeBusy = true
            local before = {
            }
            local track, animation
            local trackDirect = false
            local staged = false
            local ok, why = pcall(function()
                local registered, registrationError = registerSelection(
                    hum,
                    item,
                    generation
                )
                local snapshotOK = pcall(function()
                    for _, existing in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        before[existing] = true
                    end
                end)
                local function asTrack(value)
                    local valid, isTrack = pcall(function()
                        return value:IsA("AnimationTrack")
                    end)
                    if valid and isTrack then
                        return value
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local nativeError = "Existing-track snapshot unavailable"
                if snapshotOK then
                    api.state = "NATIVE EMOTE / " .. item.name
                    ;
                    publish()
                    local played, first, second = pcall(function()
                        return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(tonumber(item.id))
                    end)
                    if played then
                        track = asTrack(first) or asTrack(second)
                        ;
                        nativeError = track and "" or "Native API returned no AnimationTrack"
                    else
                        nativeError = tostring(first)
                    end
                end
                if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                    return 
                end
                if track and before[track] then
                    releaseRegistration()
                    ;
                    api.state = "NATIVE EMOTE ALREADY PLAYING / GAME OWNED"
                    ;
                    publish()
                    ;
                    return 
                end
                local direct = false
                if not track then
                    api.state = "RESOLVING EMOTE CLIP / " .. item.name
                    ;
                    publish()
                    local clip, resolveError = resolveClip(
                        item,
                        generation,
                        character,
                        hum
                    )
                    if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                        return 
                    end
                    if not clip then
                        error("ID " .. item.id .. " / native: " .. nativeError .. " / resolver: " .. tostring(resolveError) .. (not registered and (" / registration: " .. registrationError) or ""))
                    end
                    animation = Instance.new("Animation")
                    ;
                    animation.Name = "DeathNote_SelectedEmote"
                    ;
                    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. clip
                    local loaded, returned = pcall(function()
                        return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
                    end)
                    track = loaded and asTrack(returned) or nil
                    if not track then
                        error("Resolved clip " .. clip .. " failed to load: " .. tostring(returned))
                    end
                    direct = true
                    ;
                    trackDirect = true
                end
                if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                    return 
                end
                -- Original source stops all tracks before playing. We instead give ONLY
                -- this new, selected emote Action priority, above the retained v24 gait.
                -- Never stop native/game locomotion, disable Animate or change a pack.
                track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                if direct then
                    track.Looped = true
                end
                local playing = false
                ;
                pcall(function()
                    playing = track.IsPlaying
                end)
                if direct or not playing then
                    -- Play BEFORE waiting for Length. Streaming tracks may remain at 0
                    -- until Play has been requested; the old Length-first gate deadlocked.
                    local started, startError = pcall(function()
                        track:Play(
                            0.12,
                            1,
                            1
                        )
                    end)
                    if not started then
                        error("Selected emote Play failed: " .. tostring(startError))
                    end
                end
                pending = {
                    generation = generation,
                    character = character,
                    hum = hum,
                    track = track,
                    animation = animation,
                    direct = direct,
                    item = item,
                    started = clock,
                    playAttempted = true,
                }
                staged = true
                api.state = "STARTING / " .. item.name
            end)
            nativeBusy = false
            if inflight and inflight.generation == generation then
                inflight = nil
            end
            if not staged then
                if track and not before[track] and track ~= ownedTrack and (not pending or pending.track ~= track) then
                    disposeTrack(
                        track,
                        animation,
                        not trackDirect
                    )
                else
                    drop(animation)
                end
                if generation == requestGeneration then
                    releaseRegistration()
                    if not ok then
                        api.state = "EMOTE UNAVAILABLE"
                        ;
                        api.error = tostring(
                            why):sub(1,
                            700
                        )
                        ;
                        publish()
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    function api.play(id)
        if api.closed or not api.enabled or not api.ready then
            return false, "Enable the Tool and wait for the catalog"
        end
        local item = byId[tostring(id)]
        if not item then
            return false, "Choose an emote from the embedded catalog"
        end
        return beginPlay(item)
    end
    function api.random()
        if not api.ready or #results == 0 then
            return false, "No loaded matching emotes"
        end
        return api.play(results[math.random(1, #results)].id)
    end
    local function playback()
        local character, hum = characterInfo()
        if inflight and (clock - inflight.started > 20 or character ~= inflight.character or hum ~= inflight.hum) then
            api.stop("EMOTE REQUEST CANCELLED / TIMEOUT OR CHARACTER CHANGE")
            ;
            return 
        end
        if ownedTrack and (character ~= ownedCharacter or hum ~= ownedHum or not hum or hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) then
            api.stop("EMOTE STOPPED / CHARACTER CHANGED")
            ;
            return 
        end
        if (ownedTrack or pending or inflight) and moving(hum) then
            api.stop("EMOTE STOPPED / MOVEMENT OR JUMP")
            ;
            return 
        end
        local job = pending
        if job then
            if not validRequest(job.generation, job.character, job.hum) then
                api.stop("EMOTE CANCELLED / CHARACTER CHANGED")
                ;
                return 
            end
            local ok, length = pcall(function()
                return job.track.Length
            end)
            local playing, position = false, 0
            pcall(function()
                playing = job.track.IsPlaying
                ;
                position = job.track.TimePosition
            end)
            if ok and playing and ((type(length) == "number" and length > 0) or (type(position) == "number" and position > 0)) then
                ownedTrack = job.track
                ;
                ownedAnimation = job.animation
                ;
                ownedCharacter = job.character
                ;
                ownedHum = job.hum
                ;
                ownedDirect = job.direct
                ;
                pending = nil
                api.nowPlaying = job.item.name
                ;
                api.nowId = job.item.id
                ;
                api.state = "PLAYING / " .. job.item.name
            elseif clock - job.started > 12 then
                local id = job.item.id
                api.stop("EMOTE NOT LOADED")
                api.error = "ID " .. id .. " did not become playable within 12 seconds. The asset may be restricted, unavailable, or interrupted by this game."
            elseif ok and type(length) == "number" and length > 0 and not playing and clock - job.started > 2 then
                api.stop("EMOTE INTERRUPTED")
                api.error = "The selected emote was not kept playing by this experience; native locomotion was left intact."
            end
        elseif ownedTrack then
            local ok, isPlaying = pcall(function()
                return ownedTrack.IsPlaying
            end)
            if not ok or not isPlaying then
                api.stop("EMOTE FINISHED / NATIVE PACK RESUMED")
            end
        end
    end
    function api.diagnostics()
        return {
            catalogCount = #items,
            resultCount = #results,
            pageSize = api.pageSize,
            tool = tool,
            ownedTrack = ownedTrack,
            pending = pending ~= nil,
            chunkIndex = loadIndex,
            chunkCount = chunkCount,
            filterJob = queryJob ~= nil,
            inflight = inflight ~= nil,
            nativeBusy = nativeBusy,
        }
    end
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        api.closed = true
        ;
        api.enabled = false
        ;
        api.browserOpen = false
        api.stop("CLOSED")
        ;
        removeTool()
        ;
        saveFavorites()
        disconnect(connections)
        ;
        connections = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        ;
        queryJob = nil
        items = {
        }
        ;
        byId = {
        }
        ;
        results = {
        }
        ;
        favorites = {
        }
        ;
        clipCache = {
        }
        ;
        clipOrder = {
        }
        ;
        EmoteCatalogData.chunks = {
        }
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
        removing = character or LocalPlayer.Character
        ;
        api.browserOpen = false
        ;
        api.stop("WAITING FOR RESPAWN")
        ;
        removeTool()
        ;
        publish()
    end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        removing = nil
        ;
        api.stop(api.enabled and "R15 TOOL ON / RESPAWN" or "R15 TOOL OFF")
        ;
        if api.enabled then
            ensureTool()
        end
        ;
        publish()
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if not processed and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                if ownedTrack or pending or inflight then
                    api.stop("EMOTE STOPPED / MOVEMENT INPUT")
                end
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F6 and api.enabled then
                if api.browserOpen then
                    api.closeBrowser()
                else
                    api.open()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        local delta = math.clamp(
            tonumber(dt) or 0,
            0,
            1
        )
        ;
        clock = clock + delta
        ;
        maintenance = maintenance + delta
        playback()
        if maintenance >= 0.25 then
            maintenance = 0
            ;
            if api.enabled then
                ensureTool()
            end
        end
        loadBatch()
        if queryDue and clock >= queryDue then
            queryDue = nil
            ;
            startQuery()
        end
        queryBatch()
        if favoriteDirty and clock >= favoriteDue then
            saveFavorites()
        end
        publish()
    end)
    connect(MainGui.Destroying, function()
        api.close()
    end)
    return api
end)()

    local function resize()
        if not root then

                360,

        local oldHeight = root.Size.Y.Offset
        local top = root.Position.Y.Scale * size.Y + root.Position.Y.Offset - oldHeight / 2
        if api.browserMinimized then
            height = 35

        root.Size = UDim2.new(

            width,
            0,
            height
        )
        root.Position = UDim2.new(
            root.Position.X.Scale,
            root.Position.X.Offset,
            0,
            math.clamp(
                top + height / 2,
                height / 2,

                    height / 2,
                    size.Y - height / 2

        if body then
            body.Visible = not api.browserMinimized

            if not drag or not root then

                            size.Y / 2
                        ),

                            size.Y - root.Size.Y.Offset / 2,
                            size.Y / 2
                        )
                    )
                )
            end
        end, guiConnections)
        on(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(inputEvent)
            if drag and (inputEvent == drag.input or inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                drag = nil
            end
        end, guiConnections)
        on(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
            drag = nil
        end, guiConnections)
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            on(
                camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"),
                resize,
                guiConnections

    end

-- Scoped R6 selection controller: one selected track, exact source replay flags.
-- No remote loader, Animate/physics edits, rig conversion or foreign-track stops.
RedTelemetry.R6Animations = (function()
    local api = {
        catalog = R6AnimationData,
        closed = false,
        selected = nil,
        rig = "CHECKING",
        state = "SELECT AN R6 ANIMATION",
        error = nil,
        revision = 0,
    }
    local links, listeners = {
    }, {
    }
    local current, context
    local generation = 0
    local clock = 0
    local listenerId = 0
    local lastSignature = ""
    local removing
    local byName = {
    }
    for _, row in ipairs(R6AnimationData) do
        byName[row[1]] = row
    end
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        links[#links + 1] = c
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function publish()
        local signature = tostring(api.selected) .. "|" .. api.rig .. "|" .. api.state .. "|" .. tostring(api.error)
        if signature == lastSignature then
            return 
        end
        lastSignature = signature
        ;
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for key, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                key,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, pair in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[pair[1]] == pair[2] then
                pcall(pair[2])
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        listenerId = listenerId + 1
        ;
        local key = listenerId
        ;
        listeners[key] = fn
        return {
            Disconnect = function()
                listeners[key] = nil
            end,
        }
    end
    local function characterInfo()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character == removing then
            character = nil
        end
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        return character, hum, animator
    end
    local function dispose(entry)
        if not entry then
            return 
        end
        pcall(function()
            entry.track:Stop(0)
            ;
            entry.track.TimePosition = 0
        end)
        pcall(function()
            entry.track:Destroy()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            entry.animation:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    function api.stop(reason)
        generation = generation + 1
        local old = current
        ;
        current = nil
        ;
        context = nil
        ;
        api.selected = nil
        dispose(old)
        ;
        api.state = reason or "R6 ANIMATION OFF"
        ;
        publish()
    end
    function api.select(name)
        if api.closed then
            return false, "R6 controller closed"
        end
        local row = byName[name]
        if not row then
            return false, "Choose one of the 33 source animations"
        end
        if api.selected == name then
            api.error = nil
            ;
            api.stop()
            ;
            return true
        end
        local character, hum, animator = characterInfo()
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return false, "Waiting for a live character"
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            return false, "R6 character required; R15 was not converted or changed"
        end
        if not animator then
            return false, "Waiting for the character's existing Animator"
        end
        api.stop()
        ;
        api.error = nil
        local token = generation
        api.state = "LOADING / " .. name
        ;
        publish()
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        ;
        animation.Name = "DeathNote_R6_" .. name
        ;
        animation.AnimationId = row[2]
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        end)
        local live, liveHum = characterInfo()
        if token ~= generation or api.closed or live ~= character or liveHum ~= hum or hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            if ok and track then
                dispose({
                    track = track,
                    animation = animation,
                })
            else
                pcall(function()
                    animation:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            return false, "R6 selection cancelled by a character or lifecycle change"
        end
        if not ok or not track then
            animation:Destroy()
            ;
            api.state = "R6 ASSET UNAVAILABLE"
            ;
            api.error = tostring(track)
            ;
            publish()
            ;
            return false, "Animation load failed or was not permitted"
        end
        current = {
            track = track,
            animation = animation,
            row = row,
            started = clock,
            lastPlay = clock,
            loaded = false,
        }
        context = {
            character = character,
            hum = hum,
        }
        ;
        api.selected = name
        -- As in the supplied source, do not replace the asset's Looped/Priority.
        -- The third data flag means replay when finished, NOT Looped=true.
        local played, why = pcall(function()
            track:Play(
                0.1,
                1,
                1
            )
        end)
        if not played then
            api.error = tostring(why)
            ;
            api.stop("R6 PLAY FAILED")
            ;
            return false, "Animation playback failed"
        end
        api.state = "STARTING / " .. name
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function pulse(dt)
        clock = clock + math.clamp(
            tonumber(dt) or 0,
            0,
            1
        )
        local character, hum = characterInfo()
        api.rig = not hum and "WAITING" or hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and "R6" or "R15 / UNSUPPORTED"
        if current then
            if not context or character ~= context.character or hum ~= context.hum or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
                api.stop("R6 STOPPED / CHARACTER CHANGED")
                ;
                return 
            end
            local entry = current
            local ok, playing, length, position = pcall(function()
                return entry.track.IsPlaying, entry.track.Length, entry.track.TimePosition
            end)
            if not ok then
                api.stop("R6 TRACK UNAVAILABLE")
                ;
                return 
            end
            if type(length) == "number" and length > 0 or type(position) == "number" and position > 0 then
                entry.loaded = true
            end
            if playing and entry.loaded then
                api.state = "PLAYING / " .. entry.row[1] .. (entry.row[3] and " / REPLAY ON" or " / SINGLE PLAY")
            elseif not entry.loaded and clock - entry.started > 12 then
                api.error = "This R6 asset did not load within 12 seconds; availability and permissions depend on the game."
                api.stop("R6 ASSET NOT LOADED")
                ;
                return 
            elseif not playing and entry.loaded then
                if entry.row[3] then
                    if clock - entry.lastPlay >= 0.05 then
                        entry.lastPlay = clock
                        local played, why = pcall(function()
                            entry.track:Play(
                                0.1,
                                1,
                                1
                            )
                        end)
                        if not played then
                            api.error = tostring(why)
                            ;
                            api.stop("R6 REPLAY FAILED")
                            ;
                            return 
                        end
                    end
                else
                    api.state = "FINISHED / " .. entry.row[1] .. " / TAP ON AGAIN TO TURN OFF"
                end
            end
        elseif hum and hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            api.state = "R6 ONLY / R15 LEFT UNCHANGED"
        elseif not hum then
            api.state = "WAITING FOR R6 CHARACTER"
        end
        publish()
    end
    function api.diagnostics()
        return {
            track = current and current.track,
            selected = api.selected,
            connections = #links,
            closed = api.closed,
        }
    end
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        api.closed = true
        ;
        api.stop("CLOSED")
        for _, c in ipairs(links) do
            c:Disconnect()
        end
        links = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        ;
        byName = {
        }
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
        removing = character or LocalPlayer.Character
        ;
        api.stop("WAITING FOR RESPAWN")
    end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        removing = nil
        ;
        api.stop("R6 ANIMATION OFF / RESPAWN")
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        if not api.closed then
            pulse(dt)
        end
    end)
    connect(
        MainGui.Destroying,
        api.close
    )
    pulse(0)
    return api
end)()
RedTelemetry.R6AnimationsUI = (function()
    local ui = {
    }
    local api = RedTelemetry.R6Animations
    local panel, status, selectedLabel
    local links = {
    }
    local views = {
    }
    local closed = false
    local red = Color3.fromRGB(
        224,
        39,
        73
    )
    local function corner(
        o,
        r
    )
        RedUI.Corner(
            o,
            r or 8
        )
    end
    local function label(
        parent,
        name,
        text,
        size,
        pos,
        fontSize,
        color
    )
        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        ;
        t.Name = name
        ;
        t.Text = text
        ;
        t.Size = size
        ;
        t.Position = pos
        ;
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ;
        t.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(
            252,
            239,
            244
        )
        ;
        t.TextSize = fontSize or 10
        ;
        t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        ;
        t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        ;
        t.Parent = parent
        ;
        return t
    end
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        links[#links + 1] = c
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function refresh()
        if closed or not panel then
            return 
        end
        status.Text = api.error or (api.rig .. " / " .. api.state)
        status.TextColor3 = api.error and red or Color3.fromRGB(
            182,
            154,
            166
        )
        selectedLabel.Text = api.selected and ("ACTIVE / " .. api.selected) or "ONE SELECTION / 33 ANIMATIONS"
        for name, view in pairs(views) do
            local active = api.selected == name
            view.toggle.Text = active and "ON" or "OFF"
            view.toggle.BackgroundColor3 = active and red or Color3.fromRGB(
                50,
                22,
                32
            )
            view.stroke.Color = active and red or Color3.fromRGB(
                80,
                27,
                44
            )
        end
    end
    local function select(name)
        local ok, why = api.select(name)
        if not ok then
            pcall(function()
                ShowToast(
                    "Death'Note / R6",
                    why or "Animation unavailable",
                    "Info"
                )
            end)
        end
    end

    function ui.close()
        if closed then
            return 
        end
        closed = true
        ;
        for _, c in ipairs(links) do
            c:Disconnect()
        end
        ;
        links = {
        }
        ;
        views = {
        }
        if panel then
            panel:Destroy()
            ;
            panel = nil
        end
    end
