-- Scoped inventory Tools and animation ownership. Nothing is fetched or executed here.
RedTelemetry.RandomAnimations = (function()
    local data = RandomAnimationData
    local api = {
        closed = false,
        enabled = {
            guest = false,
            fe = false,
            car = false,
        },
        windows = {
            guest = {
                open = false,
                minimized = false,
            },
            fe = {
                open = false,
                minimized = false,
            },
            car = {
                open = false,
                minimized = false,
            },
        },
        mode = nil,
        state = "TOOLS OFF",
        error = nil,
        revision = 0,
        guestChoice = {
            idle = 1,
            walk = 1,
            run = 1,
            punch = 1,
            block = 1,
        },
        guestSlot = "idle",
        guestPage = "ACTIONS",
        feSearch = "",
        feSpeeds = {
        },
        feSelected = {
        },
        mix = false,
        carIndex = 1,
        carPreview = true,
        carTilt = true,
        carCamera = true,
        carAutoResume = false,
        guestSpeed = true,
        guestJumpLock = false,
        guestSeatLock = false,
        guestDash = false,
        guestHead = false,
        guestFov = true,
        guestSounds = false,
        shift = false,
        sprint = false,
        stamina = 100,
        health = 0,
        maxHealth = 100,
    }
    api.data = data
    local kinds = {
        "guest",
        "fe",
        "car",
    }
    local labels = {
        guest = "FORSAKEN ANIMATION",
        fe = "FE ANIMATION NEW",
        car = "CAR ANIMATION",
    }
    local names = {
        guest = "Death'Note Forsaken",
        fe = "Death'Note FE New",
        car = "Death'Note Car",
    }
    local connections, listeners, toolLinks, tools = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local audio = {
    }
    local entries, versions, failed, ledger = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local context
    local clock, maintenance, uiElapsed = 0, 0, 0
    local generation = 0
    local listenerId = 0
    local removing
    local lastSignature = ""
    local packLease, packRestore
    local action, actionKind, actionStarted, comboIndex, lastPunch = nil, nil, 0, 1, -100
    local guestState
    local tilt, shiftLedger, seatLedger, dash
    local carLastPosition
    local yaw = 0
    local resumeCar = false
    local stopMotionEffects
    local motionStep
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn,
        bucket
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        table.insert(
            bucket or connections,
            c
        )
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function disconnect(list)
        for _, c in ipairs(list or {
        }) do
            c:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    local function read(
        object,
        key
    )
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return object[key]
        end)
        if ok then
            return value
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function write(
        object,
        key,
        value
    )
        return pcall(function()
            object[key] = value
        end)
    end
    local function signature()
        local bits = {
            api.mode or "",
            api.state,
            api.error or "",
            tostring(api.shift),
            tostring(api.sprint),
            tostring(api.mix),
            tostring(api.carIndex),
            api.guestPage,
            api.guestSlot,
            api.feSearch,
        }
        for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
            local window = api.windows[kind]
            bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(api.enabled[kind])
            ;
            bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(window.open)
            ;
            bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(window.minimized)
        end
        for _, key in ipairs({
            "guestSpeed",
            "guestJumpLock",
            "guestSeatLock",
            "guestDash",
            "guestHead",
            "guestFov",
            "guestSounds",
            "carPreview",
            "carTilt",
            "carCamera",
            "carAutoResume",
        }) do
            bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(api[key])
        end
        for _, key in ipairs({
            "idle",
            "walk",
            "run",
            "punch",
            "block",
        }) do
            bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(api.guestChoice[key])
        end
        local selected = {
        }
        ;
        for key in pairs(api.feSelected) do
            selected[#selected + 1] = tostring(key)
        end
        ;
        table.sort(selected)
        bits[#bits + 1] = table.concat(
            selected,
            ","
        )
        ;
        bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(math.floor(api.stamina))
        ;
        bits[#bits + 1] = tostring(math.floor(api.health))
        return table.concat(
            bits,
            "|"
        )
    end
    local function publish(force)
        local value = signature()
        if not force and value == lastSignature then
            return 
        end
        lastSignature = value
        ;
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, pair in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[pair[1]] == pair[2] then
                local ok, why = pcall(pair[2])
                ;
                if not ok then
                    pcall(function()
                        warn("DeathNote Random UI: " .. tostring(why))
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if api.closed or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        listenerId = listenerId + 1
        ;
        local id = listenerId
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        return {
            Disconnect = function()
                listeners[id] = nil
            end,
        }
    end
    local function characterInfo()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character == removing then
            character = nil
        end
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return character, hum, animator, root
    end
    local function liveContext()
        local character, hum, animator, root = characterInfo()
        if not character or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return nil, "Waiting for a live character"
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return nil, "R15 required; R6 was not changed"
        end
        if not animator or not root then
            return nil, "Waiting for the existing Animator and root"
        end
        return {
            character = character,
            hum = hum,
            animator = animator,
            root = root,
        }
    end
    local function sameContext(saved)
        local character, hum, animator = characterInfo()
        return not api.closed and saved and saved.character == character and saved.hum == hum and saved.animator == animator and hum.Health > 0 and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
    end
    local function setOwned(
        object,
        key,
        value
    )
        if not object then
            return false
        end
        local row = ledger[object]
        if not row then
            row = {
            }
            ;
            ledger[object] = row
        end
        local entry = row[key]
        local current = read(
            object,
            key
        )
        if not entry then
            entry = {
                before = current,
                last = current,
            }
            ;
            row[key] = entry
        end
        if entry.blocked then
            return false
        end
        if current ~= entry.last then
            entry.blocked = true
            ;
            return false
        end
        if current == value then
            entry.last = value
            ;
            return true
        end
        if write(object, key, value) then
            -- Roblox numeric properties may round Lua doubles to engine floats.
            -- Retain the actual stored value, not the unrounded request.
            local actual = read(
                object,
                key
            )
            local rounded = type(value) == "number" and type(actual) == "number" and math.abs(value - actual) <= math.max(1, math.abs(value)) * 1e-06
            if actual == value or rounded then
                entry.last = actual
                ;
                return true
            end
            -- A synchronous game override is not ours to restore or fight.
            entry.blocked = true
            ;
            return false
        end
        return false
    end
    local function restoreProperty(
        object,
        key
    )
        local row = ledger[object]
        ;
        local entry = row and row[key]
        if entry then
            if not entry.blocked and read(object, key) == entry.last then
                write(
                    object,
                    key,
                    entry.before
                )
            end
            row[key] = nil
            if next(row) == nil then
                ledger[object] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    local function restoreProperties()
        local objects = {
        }
        ;
        for object in pairs(ledger) do
            objects[#objects + 1] = object
        end
        for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
            local row = ledger[object]
            ;
            local keys = {
            }
            ;
            for key in pairs(row) do
                keys[#keys + 1] = key
            end
            for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
                restoreProperty(
                    object,
                    key
                )
            end
        end
    end
    local function dispose(entry)
        if not entry then
            return 
        end
        pcall(function()
            entry.track:Stop(0.12)
        end)
        ;
        drop(entry.track)
        ;
        drop(entry.animation)
    end
    local function clearEntry(key)
        versions[key] = (versions[key] or 0) + 1
        local entry = entries[key]
        ;
        entries[key] = nil
        ;
        dispose(entry)
    end
    local function clearEntries()
        local keys = {
        }
        ;
        for key in pairs(entries) do
            keys[#keys + 1] = key
        end
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            clearEntry(key)
        end
    end
    local function clearAction()
        clearEntry("guest:action")
        ;
        action = nil
        ;
        actionKind = nil
    end
    local function restorePack()
        local packs = RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks
        local wanted = packLease or packRestore
        ;
        packLease = nil
        ;
        packRestore = nil
        if wanted and packs and not packs.closed and not packs.selected then
            local ok = pcall(function()
                local selected = packs.select(wanted)
                ;
                if not selected then
                    packRestore = wanted
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                packRestore = wanted
            end
        end
    end
    local function acquirePack()
        local packs = RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks
        if packs and not packs.closed and packs.selected then
            packLease = packs.selected
            packs.reset()
        end
    end
    local function sound(which)
        if not api.guestSounds then
            return 
        end
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        ;
        s.Name = "DeathNoteRandomSound"
        ;
        s.SoundId = data.sound[which] or data.sound.click
        ;
        s.Volume = 0.3
        ;
        s.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
        ;
        audio[s] = true
        pcall(function()
            s:Play()
        end)
        task.delay(3, function()
            audio[s] = nil
            ;
            drop(s)
        end)
    end
    local function loadOwned(
        key,
        id,
        looped,
        priority,
        speed,
        weight
    )
        if not sameContext(context) then
            return nil, "Character changed"
        end
        if failed[id] then
            return nil, "Asset failed previously; use RETRY or choose another animation"
        end
        clearEntry(key)
        local saved = context
        ;
        local token = generation
        ;
        local version = versions[key]
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        ;
        animation.Name = "DeathNote_Random_" .. key
        ;
        animation.AnimationId = id
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return saved.animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        end)
        if token ~= generation or versions[key] ~= version or not sameContext(saved) then
            if ok and track then
                dispose({
                    track = track,
                    animation = animation,
                })
            else
                drop(animation)
            end
            return nil, "Cancelled stale animation request"
        end
        if not ok or not track then
            failed[id] = true
            ;
            drop(animation)
            ;
            return nil, tostring(track)
        end
        local entry = {
            track = track,
            animation = animation,
            id = id,
            started = clock,
            key = key,
            loaded = false,
            lastSpeed = speed or 1,
        }
        local played, why = pcall(function()
            track.Priority = priority or Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            track.Looped = looped == true
            -- Start before testing Length: streaming assets often report 0 until Play.
            track:Play(
                0.12,
                weight or 1,
                speed or 1
            )
        end)
        if not played then
            dispose(entry)
            ;
            failed[id] = true
            ;
            return nil, tostring(why)
        end
        entries[key] = entry
        ;
        return entry
    end
    function api.stop(
        reason,
        keepPack
    )
        generation = generation + 1
        clearEntries()
        ;
        for s in pairs(audio) do
            drop(s)
        end
        ;
        audio = {
        }
        ;
        api.feSelected = {
        }
        ;
        action = nil
        ;
        actionKind = nil
        ;
        guestState = nil
        if stopMotionEffects then
            stopMotionEffects()
        end
        restoreProperties()
        ;
        context = nil
        ;
        api.mode = nil
        ;
        api.sprint = false
        ;
        api.shift = false
        ;
        carLastPosition = nil
        api.state = reason or "ANIMATION STOPPED / TOOLS READY"
        if not keepPack then
            restorePack()
        else
            packLease = nil
        end
        publish()
    end
    local function begin(kind)
        if api.closed or not api.enabled[kind] then
            return false, "Turn this Tool ON first"
        end
        local current, why = liveContext()
        ;
        if not current then
            return false, why
        end
        if api.mode ~= kind then
            api.stop("SWITCHING ANIMATION TOOL")
        end
        context = current
        ;
        api.mode = kind
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        failed = {
        }
        if kind == "guest" and not packLease then
            acquirePack()
        end
        return true
    end
    function api.startGuest()
        if api.mode == "guest" then
            return true
        end
        local ok, why = begin("guest")
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, why
        end
        api.state = "FORSAKEN PROFILE ACTIVE"
        ;
        sound("open")
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.chooseGuest(
        slot,
        index
    )
        index = tonumber(index)
        local list = data.guest[slot]
        if not list or not index or index ~= math.floor(index) or not list[index] then
            return false, "Invalid customizer choice"
        end
        api.guestChoice[slot] = index
        ;
        api.guestSlot = slot
        ;
        failed = {
        }
        if slot == "idle" or slot == "walk" or slot == "run" then
            clearEntry("guest:gait")
            ;
            guestState = nil
        end
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setGuestPage(page)
        if page ~= "ACTIONS" and page ~= "CUSTOMIZER" and page ~= "EMOTES" and page ~= "SETTINGS" then
            return false
        end
        api.guestPage = page
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setGuestSlot(slot)
        if not data.guest[slot] then
            return false
        end
        api.guestSlot = slot
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setSetting(
        key,
        value
    )
        local allowed = {
            guestSpeed = true,
            guestJumpLock = true,
            guestSeatLock = true,
            guestDash = true,
            guestHead = true,
            guestFov = true,
            guestSounds = true,
            carPreview = true,
            carTilt = true,
            carCamera = true,
            carAutoResume = true,
        }
        if not allowed[key] or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false
        end
        api[key] = value
        if key == "guestHead" and not value then
            clearEntry("guest:head")
        end
        if key == "guestSpeed" and not value and context then
            restoreProperty(
                context.hum,
                "WalkSpeed"
            )
        end
        if key == "guestJumpLock" and not value and context then
            restoreProperty(
                context.hum,
                "JumpPower"
            )
            ;
            restoreProperty(
                context.hum,
                "JumpHeight"
            )
        end
        if key == "guestFov" and not value then
            local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
            ;
            if camera then
                restoreProperty(
                    camera,
                    "FieldOfView"
                )
            end
        end
        if key == "carCamera" and not value then
            local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
            ;
            if camera then
                restoreProperty(
                    camera,
                    "CameraSubject"
                )
            end
        end
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setSprint(value)
        if api.mode ~= "guest" then
            return false, "Start the Forsaken profile first"
        end
        api.sprint = value == true
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.toggleShift()
        if api.mode ~= "guest" and api.mode ~= "car" then
            return false, "Start Forsaken or Car first"
        end
        if not api.shift and UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            return false, "Another camera lock is active; release it before enabling this lock"
        end
        api.shift = not api.shift
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.guestEmote(index)
        local item = data.guestEmotes[tonumber(index) or 0]
        if not item then
            return false, "Choose a listed emote"
        end
        local ok, why = begin("guest")
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, why
        end
        clearAction()
        ;
        clearEntry("guest:gait")
        ;
        guestState = nil
        local entry, problem = loadOwned(
            "guest:action",
            item.id,
            true,
            Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3,
            1
        )
        if not entry then
            api.error = problem
            ;
            publish()
            ;
            return false, problem
        end
        action = entry
        ;
        actionKind = item.id == data.conga and "conga" or "emote"
        ;
        actionStarted = clock
        api.state = "GUEST EMOTE / " .. item.name
        ;
        sound("open")
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.stopGuestAction()
        if api.mode ~= "guest" then
            return false, "No active Forsaken action"
        end
        clearAction()
        ;
        api.state = "GUEST ACTION STOPPED / PROFILE READY"
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.punch()
        if actionKind == "emote" or actionKind == "conga" then
            return false, "Stop the current emote first"
        end
        local ok, why = begin("guest")
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, why
        end
        local selected = data.guest.punch[api.guestChoice.punch]
        if clock - lastPunch > 1.2 then
            comboIndex = 1
        end
        lastPunch = clock
        local id = selected.ids[comboIndex]
        ;
        comboIndex = comboIndex % #selected.ids + 1
        clearAction()
        ;
        clearEntry("guest:gait")
        ;
        guestState = nil
        local entry, problem = loadOwned(
            "guest:action",
            id,
            false,
            Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2,
            3.5
        )
        if not entry then
            api.error = problem
            ;
            publish()
            ;
            return false, problem
        end
        action = entry
        ;
        actionKind = "punch"
        ;
        actionStarted = clock
        api.state = "PUNCH / VISUAL ACTION / NO DAMAGE GUARANTEE"
        ;
        sound("click")
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.block()
        if actionKind == "emote" or actionKind == "conga" then
            return false, "Stop the current emote first"
        end
        local ok, why = begin("guest")
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, why
        end
        local item = data.guest.block[api.guestChoice.block]
        clearAction()
        ;
        clearEntry("guest:gait")
        ;
        guestState = nil
        local entry, problem = loadOwned(
            "guest:action",
            item.ids[1],
            false,
            Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2,
            3
        )
        if not entry then
            api.error = problem
            ;
            publish()
            ;
            return false, problem
        end
        action = entry
        ;
        actionKind = "block"
        ;
        actionStarted = clock
        api.state = "BLOCK / VISUAL ACTION / NO INVULNERABILITY"
        ;
        sound("click")
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setMix(value)
        if type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false
        end
        if not value and api.mix and next(api.feSelected) then
            api.stop("MIX OFF / OWNED FE TRACKS STOPPED")
        end
        api.mix = value
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.searchFE(query)
        local value = tostring(query or "")
        local ok, cut = pcall(function()
            return utf8.offset(
                value,
                81
            )
        end)
        if ok and cut then
            value = value:sub(
                1,
                cut - 1
            )
        elseif not ok then
            value = value:gsub(
                "[\128-\255]",
                ""):sub(1,
                80
            )
        end
        api.feSearch = value
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setFESpeed(
        index,
        value
    )
        index = tonumber(index)
        ;
        value = tonumber(value)
        if not index or not data.fe[index] or not value or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then
            return false, "Enter a finite animation speed"
        end
        value = math.clamp(
            value,
            -8,
            8
        )
        ;
        api.feSpeeds[index] = value
        local entry = entries["fe:" .. tostring(index)]
        if entry then
            pcall(function()
                entry.track:AdjustSpeed(value)
            end)
            ;
            entry.lastSpeed = value
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.toggleFE(index)
        index = tonumber(index)
        ;
        local item = index and data.fe[index]
        if not item then
            return false, "Choose a listed animation"
        end
        local key = "fe:" .. tostring(index)
        if api.feSelected[index] then
            clearEntry(key)
            ;
            api.feSelected[index] = nil
            ;
            publish()
            ;
            return true
        end
        local ok, why = begin("fe")
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, why
        end
        if not api.mix then
            local keys = {
            }
            ;
            for number in pairs(api.feSelected) do
                keys[#keys + 1] = number
            end
            for _, number in ipairs(keys) do
                clearEntry("fe:" .. tostring(number))
            end
            api.feSelected = {
            }
        end
        local entry, problem = loadOwned(
            key,
            item.id,
            true,
            Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
            api.feSpeeds[index] or 1
        )
        if not entry then
            api.error = problem
            ;
            publish()
            ;
            return false, problem
        end
        api.feSelected[index] = true
        ;
        api.state = "FE NEW / " .. item.name
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.selectCar(index)
        index = tonumber(index)
        if not index or index ~= math.floor(index) then
            return false, "Choose a car index"
        end
        api.carIndex = (index - 1) % #data.cars + 1
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.playCar()
        local ok, why = begin("car")
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, why
        end
        clearEntry("car:active")
        local item = data.cars[api.carIndex]
        local entry, problem = loadOwned(
            "car:active",
            item.id,
            true,
            Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
            0
        )
        if not entry then
            api.error = problem
            ;
            publish()
            ;
            return false, problem
        end
        carLastPosition = context.root.Position
        api.state = "CAR " .. tostring(api.carIndex) .. " / SPEED SYNC x" .. tostring(item.mult)
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.retry()
        failed = {
        }
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setWindow(
        kind,
        open
    )
        if not api.windows[kind] or api.closed then
            return false, "Unknown Tool window"
        end
        if open and not api.enabled[kind] then
            return false, "Turn this Tool ON first"
        end
        api.windows[kind].open = open == true
        if open then
            api.windows[kind].minimized = false
        end
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.minimize(kind)
        local window = api.windows[kind]
        ;
        if not window or not window.open then
            return false
        end
        window.minimized = not window.minimized
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function stow(kind)
        local tool = tools[kind]
        ;
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if tool and backpack and tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character then
            tool.Parent = backpack
        end
    end
    local function removeTool(kind)
        disconnect(toolLinks[kind])
        ;
        toolLinks[kind] = {
        }
        local tool = tools[kind]
        ;
        tools[kind] = nil
        ;
        drop(tool)
    end
    local function ensureTool(kind)
        if not api.enabled[kind] or api.closed then
            return 
        end
        local _, hum = characterInfo()
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return 
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            removeTool(kind)
            ;
            return 
        end
        if tools[kind] and tools[kind].Parent then
            return 
        end
        removeTool(kind)
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        ;
        if not backpack then
            return 
        end
        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        ;
        tool.Name = names[kind]
        ;
        tool.ToolTip = "Death'Note / " .. labels[kind]
        ;
        tool.RequiresHandle = false
        ;
        tool.CanBeDropped = false
        pcall(function()
            tool:SetAttribute(
                "DeathNoteRandomTool",
                kind
            )
        end)
        tools[kind] = tool
        ;
        toolLinks[kind] = {
        }
        connect(tool.Equipped, function()
            if api.enabled[kind] and not api.closed then
                api.setWindow(
                    kind,
                    true
                )
                ;
                stow(kind)
                local current = tool
                ;
                task.defer(function()
                    if current == tools[kind] then
                        stow(kind)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end, toolLinks[kind])
        connect(tool.Activated, function()
            api.setWindow(
                kind,
                true
            )
            ;
            stow(kind)
        end, toolLinks[kind])
        tool.Parent = backpack
    end
    function api.setEnabled(
        kind,
        value
    )
        if api.closed or api.enabled[kind] == nil or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false, "Use a listed Tool ON/OFF toggle"
        end
        local _, hum = characterInfo()
        if value and hum and hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return false, "This Tool requires R15; R6 was not changed"
        end
        api.enabled[kind] = value
        if value then
            ensureTool(kind)
        else
            if api.mode == kind then
                api.stop(labels[kind] .. " OFF")
            end
            api.windows[kind].open = false
            ;
            api.windows[kind].minimized = false
            ;
            removeTool(kind)
            if kind == "car" then
                resumeCar = false
            end
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.diagnostics()
        local count = 0
        ;
        for _ in pairs(entries) do
            count = count + 1
        end
        return {
            tools = tools,
            tracks = entries,
            trackCount = count,
            connections = #connections,
            context = context,
            packLease = packLease,
            closed = api.closed,
        }
    end
    -- Character and camera effects are scoped to the explicitly started Tool mode.
    -- Setters record the original value and stop fighting an external game write.
    local function stopDash()
        if dash then
            drop(dash.velocity)
            ;
            drop(dash.attachment)
            ;
            dash = nil
        end
    end
    local function stopTilt()
        if not tilt then
            return 
        end
        local old = tilt
        ;
        tilt = nil
        ;
        drop(old.align)
        ;
        drop(old.attachment)
        if old.hum then
            restoreProperty(
                old.hum,
                "AutoRotate"
            )
        end
    end
    local function stopShift()
        local saved = shiftLedger
        ;
        shiftLedger = nil
        if not saved then
            return 
        end
        restoreProperty(
            UserInputService,
            "MouseBehavior"
        )
        ;
        restoreProperty(
            UserInputService,
            "MouseIconEnabled"
        )
        if saved.hum then
            restoreProperty(
                saved.hum,
                "CameraOffset"
            )
            ;
            if not tilt then
                restoreProperty(
                    saved.hum,
                    "AutoRotate"
                )
            end
        end
    end
    local function restoreSeat()
        local saved = seatLedger
        ;
        seatLedger = nil
        if saved then
            pcall(function()
                if saved.hum:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated) == false then
                    saved.hum:SetStateEnabled(
                        Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,
                        saved.before
                    )
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    stopMotionEffects = function()
        stopDash()
        ;
        stopTilt()
        ;
        stopShift()
        ;
        restoreSeat()
        ;
        yaw = 0
    end
    local function blocked()
        if not context or not sameContext(context) then
            return true
        end
        local hum, root = context.hum, context.root
        if root.Anchored or hum.PlatformStand or hum.Sit or hum.SeatPart then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function airborne()
        if not context then
            return true
        end
        local ok, state = pcall(function()
            return context.hum:GetState()
        end)
        if not ok then
            return true
        end
        return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    end
    local function shiftStep()
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        local pause = not api.shift or blocked() or not camera or camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
        local menu = false
        ;
        pcall(function()
            menu = game:GetService("GuiService").MenuIsOpen
        end)
        if pause or menu then
            stopShift()
            ;
            return 
        end
        if not shiftLedger then
            shiftLedger = {
                hum = context.hum,
                offset = context.hum.CameraOffset or Vector3.zero,
            }
        end
        setOwned(
            UserInputService,
            "MouseBehavior",
            Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        )
        setOwned(
            UserInputService,
            "MouseIconEnabled",
            false
        )
        setOwned(
            context.hum,
            "CameraOffset",
            shiftLedger.offset + Vector3.new(
                1.75,
                0,
                0
            )
        )
        if api.mode == "guest" then
            setOwned(
                context.hum,
                "AutoRotate",
                false
            )
            local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
            ;
            local flat = Vector3.new(
                look.X,
                0,
                look.Z
            )
            if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                context.root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                    context.root.Position,
                    context.root.Position + flat.Unit
                )
            end
        end
    end
    local function tiltStep(dt)
        if api.mode ~= "car" or not api.carTilt or blocked() then
            stopTilt()
            ;
            return 
        end
        local hum, root = context.hum, context.root
        if not tilt then
            local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
            ;
            attachment.Name = "DeathNoteCarTiltAttachment"
            ;
            attachment.Parent = root
            local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
            ;
            align.Name = "DeathNoteCarTilt"
            ;
            align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
            ;
            align.Attachment0 = attachment
            ;
            align.RigidityEnabled = false
            ;
            align.MaxTorque = 9999999
            ;
            align.Responsiveness = 200
            ;
            align.Parent = root
            tilt = {
                attachment = attachment,
                align = align,
                hum = hum,
                pitch = 0,
                side = 0,
            }
            setOwned(
                hum,
                "AutoRotate",
                false
            )
        end
        local move = hum.MoveDirection
        local moving = move.Magnitude > 0.01
        local localMove = moving and root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(move) or Vector3.zero
        local targetSide = moving and -localMove.X * 18 or 0
        local targetPitch = 0
        if moving then
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local predicted = root.Position + velocity * 0.25
            local dy = predicted.Y - root.Position.Y
            if math.abs(dy) > 0.05 then
                local flat = (Vector3.new(predicted.X, 0, predicted.Z) - Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)).Magnitude
                targetPitch = math.atan2(dy, math.max(flat, 0.1)) * 0.1
            end
            targetPitch = targetPitch + localMove.Z * 0.05
        end
        tilt.side = tilt.side + (
            targetSide - tilt.side) * math.min(dt * 15,
            1
        )
        tilt.pitch = tilt.pitch + (
            targetPitch - tilt.pitch) * math.min(dt * 15,
            1
        )
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
        if camera and (api.shift or (camera.CFrame.Position - camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude < 1) then
            look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        elseif moving then
            look = move
        end
        local direction = math.atan2(
            look.X,
            look.Z
        )
        tilt.align.CFrame = CFrame.new(
            root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0,
            direction + math.pi,
            0) * CFrame.Angles(tilt.pitch,
            0,
            math.rad(tilt.side)
        )
    end
    local function startDash()
        if dash or not api.guestDash or blocked() then
            return 
        end
        local root = context.root
        local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
        ;
        attachment.Name = "DeathNotePunchDashAttachment"
        ;
        attachment.Parent = root
        local velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
        ;
        velocity.Name = "DeathNotePunchDash"
        ;
        velocity.Attachment0 = attachment
        ;
        velocity.MaxForce = 99999
        ;
        velocity.VectorVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 78
        ;
        velocity.Parent = root
        dash = {
            attachment = attachment,
            velocity = velocity,
            untilTime = clock + 0.12,
        }
    end
    local function headStep(dt)
        if not api.guestHead or blocked() then
            clearEntry("guest:head")
            ;
            return 
        end
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        ;
        if not camera then
            return 
        end
        local entry = entries["guest:head"]
        if not entry then
            entry = loadOwned(
                "guest:head",
                data.head,
                false,
                Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4,
                0,
                0.2
            )
        end
        if not entry then
            if failed[data.head] and not api.error then
                api.error = "Head-look asset unavailable in this experience"
            end
            return 
        end
        local target = 0
        if not action then
            local localLook = context.root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(camera.CFrame.LookVector)
            target = math.clamp(
                -math.atan2(
                    localLook.X,
                    -localLook.Z
                ),
                -math.rad(75),
                math.rad(75)
            )
        end
        yaw = yaw + (
            target - yaw) * math.min(dt * 5,
            1
        )
        local length = read(entry.track, "Length") or 0
        if length > 0 then
            local mapped = yaw < 0 and yaw + math.pi * 2 or yaw
            pcall(function()
                entry.track.TimePosition = (mapped / (math.pi * 2)) * length
            end)
        end
    end
    local function guestProperties(
        state,
        dt
    )
        local hum = context.hum
        if api.guestSpeed then
            local speed = state == "run" and 28 or state == "walk" and 12 or 16
            if actionKind == "punch" then
                speed = 2
            elseif actionKind == "block" then
                speed = 0.1
            elseif actionKind == "emote" then
                speed = 0
            elseif actionKind == "conga" then
                speed = 8
            end
            setOwned(
                hum,
                "WalkSpeed",
                speed
            )
        end
        if api.guestJumpLock then
            if hum.UseJumpPower == false then
                setOwned(
                    hum,
                    "JumpHeight",
                    0
                )
            else
                setOwned(
                    hum,
                    "JumpPower",
                    0
                )
            end
        end
        if api.guestSeatLock and not seatLedger then
            local ok, value = pcall(function()
                return hum:GetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated)
            end)
            if ok then
                seatLedger = {
                    hum = hum,
                    before = value,
                }
                ;
                pcall(function()
                    hum:SetStateEnabled(
                        Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,
                        false
                    )
                end)
            end
        elseif not api.guestSeatLock and seatLedger then
            restoreSeat()
        end
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        if camera and api.guestFov then
            local target = api.sprint and state == "run" and 80 or 70
            local fov = camera.FieldOfView
            setOwned(
                camera,
                "FieldOfView",
                fov + (
                    target - fov) * math.min(dt * 2,
                    1
                )
            )
        end
    end
    local function guestStep(dt)
        if blocked() then
            clearEntry("guest:gait")
            ;
            clearEntry("guest:head")
            ;
            guestState = nil
            ;
            stopDash()
            ;
            return 
        end
        local hum, root = context.hum, context.root
        local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.03 or Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude > 0.5
        local state = moving and (api.sprint and "run" or "walk") or "idle"
        api.stamina = math.clamp(
            api.stamina + (api.sprint and -12 or 9) * dt,
            0,
            100
        )
        guestProperties(
            state,
            dt
        )
        if action and not entries["guest:action"] then
            action = nil
            ;
            actionKind = nil
        end
        if action then
            local elapsed = clock - actionStarted
            local length = read(action.track, "Length") or 0
            local playing = read(
                action.track,
                "IsPlaying"
            )
            if actionKind == "punch" then
                if (length > 0 or action.loaded) and not action.dashStarted then
                    action.dashStarted = true
                    ;
                    startDash()
                end
                local position = read(action.track, "TimePosition") or 0
                if length > 0 and position >= length or not playing and action.loaded then
                    clearAction()
                end
            elseif actionKind == "block" then
                local position = read(action.track, "TimePosition") or 0
                if length > 0 and position >= length * 0.3 and not action.slowed then
                    action.slowed = true
                    ;
                    pcall(function()
                        action.track:AdjustSpeed(1)
                    end)
                end
                if not playing and action.loaded then
                    clearAction()
                end
            elseif not playing and action.loaded then
                clearAction()
            end
            if actionKind == "conga" and api.guestSpeed then
                hum:Move(
                    root.CFrame.LookVector,
                    false
                )
            end
        end
        if not action and not airborne() then
            local row = data.guest[state][api.guestChoice[state]]
            local id = row.ids[1]
            local entry = entries["guest:gait"]
            if guestState ~= state or not entry or entry.id ~= id then
                clearEntry("guest:gait")
                ;
                guestState = state
                local priority = state == "idle" and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
                local speed = state == "walk" and 1.2 or state == "run" and 2.4 or 1
                local problem
                ;
                entry, problem = loadOwned(
                    "guest:gait",
                    id,
                    true,
                    priority,
                    speed
                )
                if not entry and not api.error then
                    api.error = problem
                end
            end
            if entry then
                api.state = "FORSAKEN / " .. state:upper() .. " / " .. row.name
            end
        else
            clearEntry("guest:gait")
            ;
            guestState = nil
        end
        headStep(dt)
        if dash and clock >= dash.untilTime then
            stopDash()
        end
    end
    local function carStep(dt)
        local entry = entries["car:active"]
        ;
        if not entry then
            return 
        end
        local root = context.root
        local position = root.Position
        local last = carLastPosition or position
        ;
        carLastPosition = position
        local displacement = position - last
        local speed = 0
        if dt > 0 and displacement.Magnitude <= 100 and not blocked() then
            local velocity = displacement / dt
            if velocity.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                local dot = root.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(velocity.Unit)
                local item = data.cars[api.carIndex]
                speed = math.clamp(
                    (velocity.Magnitude / 16) * item.mult * (dot >= 0 and 1 or -1),
                    -12,
                    12
                )
            end
        end
        if math.abs(speed - entry.lastSpeed) > 0.001 then
            pcall(function()
                entry.track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
            end)
            ;
            entry.lastSpeed = speed
        end
        if api.carCamera then
            local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
            local head = context.character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if camera and head then
                setOwned(
                    camera,
                    "CameraSubject",
                    head
                )
            end
        end
        tiltStep(dt)
    end
    motionStep = function(dt)
        if api.mode == "guest" then
            guestStep(dt)
        elseif api.mode == "car" then
            carStep(dt)
        end
        if api.mode == "guest" or api.mode == "car" then
            shiftStep()
        else
            stopShift()
        end
    end
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        api.stop("CLOSED")
        ;
        api.closed = true
        ;
        resumeCar = false
        for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
            api.enabled[kind] = false
            ;
            api.windows[kind].open = false
            ;
            removeTool(kind)
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        disconnect(connections)
        ;
        connections = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        ;
        failed = {
        }
        ;
        ledger = {
        }
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
        resumeCar = api.mode == "car" and api.carAutoResume and api.enabled.car
        removing = character or LocalPlayer.Character
        api.stop("WAITING FOR RESPAWN")
        for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
            api.windows[kind].open = false
            ;
            removeTool(kind)
        end
        publish()
    end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        removing = nil
        ;
        publish(true)
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if processed or api.closed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            return 
        end
        if api.mode == "guest" then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
                api.setSprint(true)
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
                api.punch()
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
                api.block()
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
                api.toggleShift()
            end
        end
        if api.enabled.car and (api.windows.car.open or api.mode == "car") then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K then
                api.setWindow(
                    "car",
                    not api.windows.car.open
                )
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left then
                api.selectCar(api.carIndex - 1)
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right then
                api.selectCar(api.carIndex + 1)
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter then
                api.playCar()
            end
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift and api.mode == "guest" then
            api.setSprint(false)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
        api.sprint = false
        ;
        api.shift = false
        ;
        publish()
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        local delta = math.clamp(
            tonumber(dt) or 0,
            0,
            0.25
        )
        clock = clock + delta
        ;
        maintenance = maintenance + delta
        ;
        uiElapsed = uiElapsed + delta
        local _, hum = characterInfo()
        if hum then
            api.health = hum.Health
            ;
            api.maxHealth = hum.MaxHealth
        end
        if api.mode and not sameContext(context) then
            api.stop("CHARACTER CHANGED / OWNED EFFECTS REMOVED")
        end
        local packs = RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks
        if api.mode == "guest" and packs and packs.selected then
            api.stop(
                "ANIMATION PACK SELECTION TOOK CONTROL",
                true
            )
        end
        local emotes = RedTelemetry.Emotes
        if api.mode and emotes then
            local takesControl = emotes.nowId ~= nil
            if type(emotes.diagnostics) == "function" then
                local ok, diagnostic = pcall(emotes.diagnostics)
                if ok and type(diagnostic) == "table" then
                    takesControl = takesControl or diagnostic.pending or diagnostic.inflight
                end
            end
            if takesControl then
                api.stop("R15 EMOTE SELECTION TOOK CONTROL")
            end
        end
        if motionStep and api.mode then
            local ok, why = pcall(function()
                motionStep(delta)
            end)
            if not ok then
                api.error = tostring(why)
                ;
                api.stop("ANIMATION EFFECT ERROR / OWNED STATE RESTORED")
            end
        end
        local expired = {
        }
        for key, entry in pairs(entries) do
            local ok, length, position = pcall(function()
                return entry.track.Length, entry.track.TimePosition
            end)
            if ok and type(length) == "number" and length > 0 then
                entry.loaded = true
            end
            if not ok or not entry.loaded and clock - entry.started > 12 then
                expired[#expired + 1] = key
                ;
                failed[entry.id] = true
                ;
                api.error = "Asset " .. entry.id .. " did not become playable; game permissions/availability apply"
            end
        end
        for _, key in ipairs(expired) do
            clearEntry(key)
            ;
            if key:sub(1, 3) == "fe:" then
                api.feSelected[tonumber(key:sub(4))] = nil
            end
        end
        if maintenance >= 0.25 then
            maintenance = 0
            for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
                ensureTool(kind)
            end
            if resumeCar and api.enabled.car and not api.mode then
                local live = liveContext()
                ;
                if live then
                    resumeCar = false
                    ;
                    api.playCar()
                end
            end
            if packRestore and not api.mode then
                local live = liveContext()
                ;
                if live then
                    restorePack()
                end
            end
        end
        if uiElapsed >= 0.1 then
            uiElapsed = 0
            ;
            publish()
        end
    end)
    connect(
        MainGui.Destroying,
        api.close
    )
    return api
end)()

    local function clearDynamic(window)
        disconnect(window.dynamicLinks)
        ;
        window.dynamicLinks = {
        }
        if window.content then
            window.content:Destroy()
            ;
            window.content = nil
        end
        window.controls = {
        }
        ;
        window.rowViews = {
        }
        ;
        window.built = ""
    end
    local function stopPreview(window)
        local p = window.preview
        ;
        window.preview = nil
        if not p then
            return 
        end
        if p.connection then
            p.connection:Disconnect()
        end
        if p.track then
            pcall(function()
                p.track:Stop(0)
            end)
            ;
            pcall(function()
                p.track:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        for _, object in ipairs({
            p.animation,
            p.model,
            p.world,
            p.camera,
        }) do
            if object then
                pcall(function()
                    object:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function destroyWindow(kind)
        local w = windows[kind]
        ;
        if not w then
            return 
        end
        stopPreview(w)
        ;
        clearDynamic(w)
        ;
        disconnect(w.confirmLinks)
        ;
        disconnect(w.links)
        ;
        w.links = {
        }
        if w.gui then
            w.gui:Destroy()
        end
        windows[kind] = nil
    end
    local function resize(w)
        local v = viewport()
        local width = math.max(
            270,
            math.min(
                w.fullWidth,
                v.X - 20
            )
        )
        local height = math.max(
            260,
            math.min(
                w.fullHeight,
                v.Y - 24
            )
        )
        local top = w.root.Position.Y.Scale * v.Y + w.root.Position.Y.Offset - w.root.Size.Y.Offset / 2
        if api.windows[w.kind].minimized then
            height = 35
        end
        w.root.Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            width,
            0,
            height
        )
        w.root.Position = UDim2.new(
            w.root.Position.X.Scale,
            w.root.Position.X.Offset,
            0,
            math.clamp(
                top + height / 2,
                height / 2,
                math.max(
                    height / 2,
                    v.Y - height / 2
                )
            )
        )
        w.body.Visible = not api.windows[w.kind].minimized
        w.min.Text = api.windows[w.kind].minimized and "+" or "-"
        w.collapsed = api.windows[w.kind].minimized
    end

            if event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                w.drag = {
                    input = event,
                    start = event.Position,
                    position = root.Position,
                }
            end
        end, w.links)
        connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(event)
            local drag = w.drag
            ;
            if not drag then
                return 
            end
            if event == drag.input or drag.input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local delta = event.Position - drag.start
                ;
                local size = viewport()
                local x = drag.position.X.Scale * size.X + drag.position.X.Offset + delta.X
                local y = drag.position.Y.Scale * size.Y + drag.position.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                local halfX, halfY = root.Size.X.Offset / 2, root.Size.Y.Offset / 2
                root.Position = UDim2.new(
                    0,
                    math.clamp(
                        x,
                        math.min(
                            halfX,
                            size.X / 2
                        ),
                        math.max(
                            halfX,
                            size.X - halfX
                        )
                    ),
                    0,
                    math.clamp(
                        y,
                        math.min(
                            halfY,
                            size.Y / 2
                        ),
                        math.max(
                            halfY,
                            size.Y - halfY
                        )
                    )
                )
            end
        end, w.links)
        connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(event)
            if w.drag and (event == w.drag.input or event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                w.drag = nil
            end
        end, w.links)
        connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
            w.drag = nil
        end, w.links)
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            connect(camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), function()
                resize(w)
            end, w.links)
        end
        resize(w)
        ;
        return w
    end

    local function previewLoad(w)
        local p = w.preview
        ;
        if not p then
            return 
        end
        if p.index == api.carIndex then
            return 
        end
        if p.track then
            pcall(function()
                p.track:Stop(0)
            end)
            ;
            pcall(function()
                p.track:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if p.animation then
            p.animation:Destroy()
        end
        p.track = nil
        ;
        p.animation = nil
        ;
        p.index = api.carIndex
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        ;
        anim.Name = "DeathNoteCarPreviewAnimation"
        ;
        anim.AnimationId = data.cars[api.carIndex].id
        ;
        p.animation = anim
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return p.animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        end)
        if ok and track then
            p.track = track
            ;
            pcall(function()
                track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                ;
                track.Looped = true
                ;
                track:Play(
                    0.1,
                    1,
                    1
                )
            end)
            w.controls.previewStatus.Text = "LOCAL AVATAR PREVIEW"
        else
            w.controls.previewStatus.Text = "PREVIEW ASSET UNAVAILABLE / SELECT STILL AVAILABLE"
        end
    end
    local function buildPreview(w)
        if w.preview or w.previewFailed or not w.controls.viewport then
            return 
        end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        ;
        if not character then
            return 
        end
        local old = character.Archivable
        local model
        local ok, why = pcall(function()
            character.Archivable = true
            ;
            model = character:Clone()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            character.Archivable = old
        end)
        if not ok or not model then
            w.previewFailed = true
            ;
            w.controls.previewStatus.Text = "PREVIEW UNAVAILABLE / RETRY OR SELECT WITHOUT IT"
            ;
            return 
        end
        local world, camera
        local built, problem = pcall(function()
            for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("Script") or object:IsA("LocalScript") or object:IsA("ModuleScript") or object:IsA("Tool") then
                    object:Destroy()
                elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.CanCollide = false
                    ;
                    object.CanTouch = false
                end
            end
            local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            assert(
                root and hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15,
                "R15 preview model required"
            )
            root.Anchored = true
            ;
            root.Transparency = 1
            model:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
            world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
            ;
            world.Name = "DeathNoteCarPreviewWorld"
            ;
            world.Parent = w.controls.viewport
            ;
            model.Parent = world
            camera = Instance.new("Camera")
            ;
            camera.Name = "DeathNoteCarPreviewCamera"
            ;
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            ;
            camera.Parent = w.controls.viewport
            ;
            w.controls.viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
            local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if not animator then
                animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                ;
                animator.Parent = hum
            end
            local center, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
            local radius = math.max(
                5,
                size.Magnitude * 0.65
            )
            local p = {
                world = world,
                model = model,
                camera = camera,
                animator = animator,
                angle = 0,
                index = 0,
                root = root,
                radius = radius,
            }
            w.preview = p
            p.connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                if not model.Parent or not w.gui.Parent or api.windows.car.minimized or not api.windows.car.open then
                    return 
                end
                p.angle = p.angle + math.rad(
                    30) * math.clamp(dt,
                    0,
                    0.1
                )
                local target = root.Position + Vector3.new(
                    0,
                    1.5,
                    0
                )
                camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                    target + Vector3.new(
                        math.sin(p.angle) * p.radius,
                        2.5,
                        math.cos(p.angle) * p.radius
                    ),
                    target
                )
            end)
            previewLoad(w)
        end)
        if not built then
            if w.preview then
                stopPreview(w)
            else
                if model then
                    model:Destroy()
                end
                if world then
                    world:Destroy()
                end
                if camera then
                    camera:Destroy()
                end
            end
            w.previewFailed = true
            ;
            w.controls.previewStatus.Text = "PREVIEW UNAVAILABLE / SELECT STILL AVAILABLE"
        end
    end

    local function refreshWindow(kind)
        local enabled = api.enabled[kind]
        ;
        local state = api.windows[kind]
        if not enabled then
            destroyWindow(kind)
            ;
            return 
        end
        if not state.open then
            local w = windows[kind]
            ;
            if w then
                w.gui.Enabled = false
                ;
                w.drag = nil
                ;
                stopPreview(w)
            end
            return 
        end
        local w = buildWindow(kind)
        ;
        w.gui.Enabled = true
        if w.collapsed ~= state.minimized then
            resize(w)
        end
        w.status.Text = api.error or (api.mode == kind and api.state or "TOOL READY / SELECT AN ANIMATION TO START")
        w.status.TextColor3 = api.error and colors.red or colors.muted
        if state.minimized then
            stopPreview(w)
            ;
            return 
        end
        if kind == "guest" then
            guestPage(w)
        elseif kind == "fe" then
            fePage(w)
        else
            carPage(w)
        end
        if kind == "guest" then
            if w.controls.sprint then
                w.controls.sprint.Text = api.sprint and "SPRINT ON" or "SPRINT OFF"
            end
            if w.controls.shift then
                w.controls.shift.Text = api.shift and "SHIFT LOCK ON" or "SHIFT LOCK OFF"
            end
            if w.controls.healthFill then
                w.controls.healthFill.Size = UDim2.new(
                    math.clamp(
                        api.health / math.max(
                            1,
                            api.maxHealth or 100
                        ),
                        0,
                        1
                    ),
                    0,
                    1,
                    0
                )
            end
            if w.controls.staminaFill then
                w.controls.staminaFill.Size = UDim2.new(
                    api.stamina / 100,
                    0,
                    1,
                    0
                )
            end
            if w.controls.health then
                w.controls.health.Text = "HEALTH / " .. tostring(math.floor(api.health)) .. " / " .. tostring(math.floor(api.maxHealth or 100))
            end
            if w.controls.stamina then
                w.controls.stamina.Text = "LOCAL HUD STAMINA / " .. tostring(math.floor(api.stamina)) .. " / 100"
            end
            if api.guestPage == "CUSTOMIZER" then
                for index, b in pairs(w.rowViews) do
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = index == api.guestChoice[api.guestSlot] and colors.violet or colors.field
                end
            end
        elseif kind == "fe" then
            w.controls.mix.Text = api.mix and "MIX ON / UP TO 25" or "MIX OFF / SINGLE"
            local query = api.feSearch:lower()
            for index, row in pairs(w.rowViews) do
                row.frame.Visible = query == "" or row.key:find(query, 1, true) ~= nil
                row.toggle.Text = api.feSelected[index] and "ON" or "OFF"
                row.toggle.BackgroundColor3 = api.feSelected[index] and colors.red or colors.violet
                if not row.speed:IsFocused() then
                    row.speed.Text = tostring(api.feSpeeds[index] or 1)
                end
            end
        else
            w.controls.name.Text = "ANIMATION " .. tostring(api.carIndex) .. " / 12 / SPEED MULTIPLIER x" .. tostring(data.cars[api.carIndex].mult)
            if w.controls.shift then
                w.controls.shift.Text = api.shift and "SHIFT LOCK ON" or "SHIFT LOCK OFF"
            end
            if api.carPreview then
                buildPreview(w)
                ;
                previewLoad(w)
            else
                stopPreview(w)
                ;
                w.controls.previewStatus.Text = "PREVIEW OFF / NO BACKGROUND DUMMY"
            end
        end
        for key, control in pairs(w.controls) do
            if type(control) == "table" and control.button and control.title then
                control.button.Text = control.title .. (api[key] and " / ON" or " / OFF")
                control.button.BackgroundColor3 = api[key] and accents[kind] or colors.field
            end
        end
    end
    local function refresh()
        if closed then
            return 
        end
        if panelViews then
            for kind, view in pairs(panelViews) do
                view.toggle.Text = api.enabled[kind] and "TOOL ON" or "TOOL OFF"
                view.toggle.BackgroundColor3 = api.enabled[kind] and accents[kind] or colors.field
                view.status.Text = api.mode == kind and api.state or api.enabled[kind] and "TOOL IN INVENTORY / EQUIP TO OPEN" or "OFF / NO TOOL GRANTED"
            end
        end
        for _, kind in ipairs({
            "guest",
            "fe",
            "car",
        }) do
            local ok, why = pcall(function()
                refreshWindow(kind)
            end)
            if not ok then
                destroyWindow(kind)
                ;
                api.windows[kind].open = false
                pcall(function()
                    warn("DeathNote Random window: " .. kind .. " / " .. tostring(why))
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    function ui.mount(parent)
        panel = scroll(
            parent,
            "RandomAnimationsPanel",

-- SHA-256 of the exact downloaded bytes. Runs only after explicit external-launch consent.
-- A changed remote file is rejected rather than silently executing a different payload.
local RandomAddonIntegrity = (function()
    local integrity = {
    }
    local constants = {
        1116352408,
        1899447441,
        3049323471,
        3921009573,
        961987163,
        1508970993,
        2453635748,
        2870763221,
        3624381080,
        310598401,
        607225278,
        1426881987,
        1925078388,
        2162078206,
        2614888103,
        3248222580,
        3835390401,
        4022224774,
        264347078,
        604807628,
        770255983,
        1249150122,
        1555081692,
        1996064986,
        2554220882,
        2821834349,
        2952996808,
        3210313671,
        3336571891,
        3584528711,
        113926993,
        338241895,
        666307205,
        773529912,
        1294757372,
        1396182291,
        1695183700,
        1986661051,
        2177026350,
        2456956037,
        2730485921,
        2820302411,
        3259730800,
        3345764771,
        3516065817,
        3600352804,
        4094571909,
        275423344,
        430227734,
        506948616,
        659060556,
        883997877,
        958139571,
        1322822218,
        1537002063,
        1747873779,
        1955562222,
        2024104815,
        2227730452,
        2361852424,
        2428436474,
        2756734187,
        3204031479,
        3329325298,
    }
    function integrity.digest(text)
        if type(text) ~= "string" then
            return nil, "Expected source bytes"
        end
        if not bit32 then
            return nil, "bit32 is unavailable; external execution refused"
        end
        local bxor, band, bnot, rrotate, rshift = bit32.bxor, bit32.band, bit32.bnot, bit32.rrotate, bit32.rshift
        local function add(...)
            local values = {
                ...,
            }
            ;
            local total = 0
            for i = 1, #values do
                total = total + values[i]
            end
            return total % 4294967296
        end
        local function word(value)
            return string.char(
                math.floor(value / 16777216) % 256,
                math.floor(value / 65536) % 256,
                math.floor(value / 256) % 256,
                value % 256
            )
        end
        local length = #text
        local message = text .. string.char(
            128) .. string.rep(string.char(0),
            (55 - length) % 64) .. word(math.floor(length / 536870912)) .. word((length * 8) % 4294967296
        )
        local hash = {
            1779033703,
            3144134277,
            1013904242,
            2773480762,
            1359893119,
            2600822924,
            528734635,
            1541459225,
        }
        local schedule = {
        }
        for offset = 1, #message, 64 do
            for i = 0, 15 do
                local a, b, c, d = message:byte(
                    offset + i * 4,
                    offset + i * 4 + 3
                )
                schedule[i + 1] = a * 16777216 + b * 65536 + c * 256 + d
            end
            for i = 17, 64 do
                local x, y = schedule[i - 15], schedule[i - 2]
                local s0 = bxor(
                    rrotate(
                        x,
                        7
                    ),
                    rrotate(
                        x,
                        18
                    ),
                    rshift(
                        x,
                        3
                    )
                )
                local s1 = bxor(
                    rrotate(
                        y,
                        17
                    ),
                    rrotate(
                        y,
                        19
                    ),
                    rshift(
                        y,
                        10
                    )
                )
                schedule[i] = add(
                    schedule[i - 16],
                    s0,
                    schedule[i - 7],
                    s1
                )
            end
            local a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h = hash[1], hash[2], hash[3], hash[4], hash[5], hash[6], hash[7], hash[8]
            for i = 1, 64 do
                local s1 = bxor(
                    rrotate(
                        e,
                        6
                    ),
                    rrotate(
                        e,
                        11
                    ),
                    rrotate(
                        e,
                        25
                    )
                )
                local choice = bxor(
                    band(
                        e,
                        f
                    ),
                    band(
                        bnot(e),
                        g
                    )
                )
                local t1 = add(
                    h,
                    s1,
                    choice,
                    constants[i],
                    schedule[i]
                )
                local s0 = bxor(
                    rrotate(
                        a,
                        2
                    ),
                    rrotate(
                        a,
                        13
                    ),
                    rrotate(
                        a,
                        22
                    )
                )
                local majority = bxor(
                    band(
                        a,
                        b
                    ),
                    band(
                        a,
                        c
                    ),
                    band(
                        b,
                        c
                    )
                )
                local t2 = add(
                    s0,
                    majority
                )
                h = g
                ;
                g = f
                ;
                f = e
                ;
                e = add(
                    d,
                    t1
                )
                ;
                d = c
                ;
                c = b
                ;
                b = a
                ;
                a = add(
                    t1,
                    t2
                )
            end
            local values = {
                a,
                b,
                c,
                d,
                e,
                f,
                g,
                h,
            }
            for i = 1, 8 do
                hash[i] = add(
                    hash[i],
                    values[i]
                )
            end
        end
        local result = {
        }
        ;
        for i = 1, 8 do
            result[i] = string.format(
                "%08x",
                hash[i]
            )
