        end
        return table.concat(result)
    end
    function integrity.verify(
        kind,
        source
    )
        local row = RandomAddonData.remote[kind]
        if not row then
            return false, "Unknown external source"
        end
        if type(source) ~= "string" or #source ~= row.bytes then
            return false, "Remote file size changed / execution blocked"
        end
        local digest, why = integrity.digest(source)
        if not digest then
            return false, why
        end
        if digest ~= row.sha256 then
            return false, "Remote file hash changed / execution blocked"
        end
        return true
    end
    return integrity
end)()
-- Scoped reversible profiles. External MoonSec launches are deliberately NOT presented as toggles.
RedTelemetry.RandomAddons = (function()
    local data = RandomAddonData
    local api = {
        closed = false,
        data = data,
        enabled = {
            sonic6 = false,
            monster = false,
            psycho = false,
        },
        windows = {
        },
        settings = {
        },
        active = nil,
        state = "TOOLS OFF",
        error = nil,
        revision = 0,
        sprint = false,
        monsterSet = "MONSTER",
        external = {
        },
        externalConsumed = false,
        launching = false,
    }
    for key, row in pairs(data.profiles) do
        api.windows[key] = {
            open = false,
            minimized = false,
        }
        ;
        api.settings[key] = {
        }
        ;
        for name, value in pairs(row.defaults) do
            api.settings[key][name] = value
        end
    end
    for key in pairs(data.remote) do
        api.external[key] = {
            phase = "NOT RUN",
            used = false,
            error = nil,
        }
    end
    local links, listeners, tools, toolLinks, tracks, sounds, ledger, failed, versions = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local context, removing, packLease, packRestore, consent
    local pendingResume
    local characterLinks = {
    }
    local loading = {
    }
    local locomotion, lastHumanoidState
    local generation, clock, lastUi, nextListener = 0, 0, 0, 0
    local stateSignature = ""
    local profileState, runVelocity, canDoubleJump, doubleUsed, jumpFreezeAt, idleCycle, retroNext, retroFrozen, spawnStarted, spawnDeadline = nil, 0, false, false, 0, 0, 0, false, false, 0
    local hooks = {
    }
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn,
        bucket
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        table.insert(
            bucket or links,
            c
        )
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function disconnect(bucket)
        for _, c in ipairs(bucket or {
        }) do
            pcall(function()
                c:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function read(
        object,
        key
    )
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return object[key]
        end)
        ;
        if ok then
            return value
        end
    end
    local function write(
        object,
        key,
        value
    )
        return pcall(function()
            object[key] = value
        end)
    end
    local function publish(force)
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        local parts = {
            api.state,
            tostring(api.active),
            tostring(api.error),
            tostring(api.sprint),
            api.monsterSet,
            tostring(api.launching),
            tostring(api.externalConsumed),
        }
        for _, key in ipairs(data.order) do
            local w = api.windows[key]
            ;
            local e = api.external[key]
            parts[#parts + 1] = key .. tostring(api.enabled[key]) .. tostring(w and w.open) .. tostring(w and w.minimized) .. (e and e.phase or "")
        end
        local signature = table.concat(
            parts,
            "|"
        )
        if not force and signature == stateSignature then
            return 
        end
        stateSignature = signature
        ;
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, pair in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[pair[1]] == pair[2] then
                pcall(pair[2])
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if api.closed or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        nextListener = nextListener + 1
        ;
        local id = nextListener
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        return {
            Disconnect = function()
                listeners[id] = nil
            end,
        }
    end
    local function own(
        object,
        key,
        value
    )
        if not object then
            return false
        end
        local current = read(
            object,
            key
        )
        if current == nil then
            return false
        end
        local row = ledger[object]
        ;
        if not row then
            row = {
            }
            ;
            ledger[object] = row
        end
        local e = row[key]
        ;
        if not e then
            e = {
                before = current,
                last = current,
            }
            ;
            row[key] = e
        end
        if e.blocked then
            return false
        end
        if current ~= e.last then
            e.blocked = true
            ;
            return false
        end
        if current == value then
            return true
        end
        if not write(object, key, value) then
            return false
        end
        local actual = read(
            object,
            key
        )
        local rounded = type(value) == "number" and type(actual) == "number" and math.abs(actual - value) <= math.max(1, math.abs(value)) * 1e-06
        if actual == value or rounded then
            e.last = actual
            ;
            return true
        end
        e.blocked = true
        ;
        return false
    end
    local function release(
        object,
        key
    )
        local row = ledger[object]
        ;
        local e = row and row[key]
        if not e then
            return 
        end
        if not e.blocked and read(object, key) == e.last then
            write(
                object,
                key,
                e.before
            )
        end
        row[key] = nil
        ;
        if next(row) == nil then
            ledger[object] = nil
        end
    end
    local function releaseAll()
        local objects = {
        }
        ;
        for object in pairs(ledger) do
            objects[#objects + 1] = object
        end
        for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
            local names = {
            }
            ;
            for key in pairs(ledger[object]) do
                names[#names + 1] = key
            end
            ;
            for _, key in ipairs(names) do
                release(
                    object,
                    key
                )
            end
        end
    end
    local function currentCharacter(rig)
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character == removing then
            return nil, "Waiting for a new character"
        end
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return nil, "Waiting for a live character"
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType[rig] then
            return nil, rig .. " required / no rig conversion performed"
        end
        local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not animator or not root then
            return nil, "Waiting for the existing Animator and root"
        end
        return {
            character = character,
            hum = hum,
            animator = animator,
            root = root,
            rig = rig,
        }
    end
    local function same(saved)
        if not saved or api.closed then
            return false
        end
        local live = currentCharacter(saved.rig)
        return live and live.character == saved.character and live.hum == saved.hum and live.animator == saved.animator
    end
    local function dispose(entry)
        if not entry then
            return 
        end
        pcall(function()
            entry.track:Stop(0.12)
        end)
        ;
        drop(entry.track)
        ;
        drop(entry.animation)
    end
    local function clearTrack(key)
        versions[key] = (versions[key] or 0) + 1
        local entry = tracks[key]
        ;
        tracks[key] = nil
        ;
        dispose(entry)
    end
    local function clearTracks()
        local keys = {
        }
        ;
        for key in pairs(tracks) do
            keys[#keys + 1] = key
        end
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            clearTrack(key)
        end
    end
    local function clearSounds()
        for key, sound in pairs(sounds) do
            pcall(function()
                sound:Stop()
            end)
            ;
            drop(sound)
            ;
            sounds[key] = nil
        end
    end
    local function restorePack()
        local wanted = packLease or packRestore
        ;
        packLease = nil
        ;
        packRestore = nil
        local p = RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks
        if wanted and p and not p.closed and not p.selected then
            local ok, selected = pcall(
                p.select,
                wanted
            )
            if not ok or not selected then
                packRestore = wanted
            end
        end
    end
    function api.stop(
        reason,
        keepPack
    )
        generation = generation + 1
        ;
        pendingResume = nil
        disconnect(characterLinks)
        ;
        characterLinks = {
        }
        ;
        loading = {
        }
        clearTracks()
        ;
        clearSounds()
        ;
        releaseAll()
        ;
        context = nil
        ;
        api.active = nil
        ;
        api.sprint = false
        locomotion = nil
        ;
        lastHumanoidState = nil
        profileState = nil
        ;
        runVelocity = 0
        ;
        canDoubleJump = false
        ;
        doubleUsed = false
        ;
        retroFrozen = false
        ;
        spawnStarted = false
        if keepPack then
            packLease = nil
            ;
            packRestore = nil
        else
            restorePack()
        end
        api.state = reason or "STOPPED / ORIGINAL STATE RELEASED"
        ;
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function suspendOthers()
        local old = RedTelemetry.RandomAnimations
        ;
        if old and not old.closed and old.mode then
            old.stop("NEW RANDOM PROFILE TOOK CONTROL")
        end
        local em = RedTelemetry.Emotes
        ;
        if em and not em.closed and type(em.stop) == "function" then
            pcall(em.stop)
        end
        local r6 = RedTelemetry.R6Animations
        ;
        if r6 and not r6.closed and type(r6.stop) == "function" then
            pcall(r6.stop)
        end
        local packs = RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks
        if packs and not packs.closed and packs.selected then
            packLease = packs.selected
            ;
            packs.reset()
        elseif packRestore then
            packLease = packRestore
            ;
            packRestore = nil
        end
    end
    local function loadTrack(
        key,
        id,
        looped,
        speed
    )
        if not same(context) then
            return nil, "Character changed"
        end
        if failed[id] then
            return nil, "Asset failed; choose RETRY to try it again"
        end
        if loading[key] then
            return nil, "Animation is already loading"
        end
        clearTrack(key)
        local saved, token, version = context, generation, versions[key]
        local marker = {
        }
        ;
        loading[key] = marker
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        ;
        animation.Name = "DeathNote_Addon_" .. key
        ;
        animation.AnimationId = id
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return saved.animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        end)
        if loading[key] == marker then
            loading[key] = nil
        end
        if token ~= generation or versions[key] ~= version or not same(saved) then
            if ok and track then
                dispose({
                    track = track,
                    animation = animation,
                })
            else
                drop(animation)
            end
            return nil, "Cancelled late profile animation"
        end
        if not ok or not track then
            failed[id] = true
            ;
            drop(animation)
            ;
            return nil, tostring(track)
        end
        local e = {
            track = track,
            animation = animation,
            id = id,
            started = clock,
            loaded = false,
            speed = speed or 1,
            key = key,
        }
        local played, why = pcall(function()
            -- Explicit Action priority overlays native locomotion without disabling Animate.
            track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            ;
            track.Looped = looped == true
            ;
            track:Play(
                0.12,
                1,
                speed or 1
            )
        end)
        if not played then
            failed[id] = true
            ;
            dispose(e)
            ;
            return nil, tostring(why)
        end
        tracks[key] = e
        ;
        return e
    end
    local function adjust(
        entry,
        speed
    )
        if entry and entry.speed ~= speed then
            local ok = pcall(function()
                entry.track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
            end)
            if ok then
                entry.speed = speed
            end
        end
    end
    local function playOnly(
        slot,
        speed,
        looped
    )
        if profileState == slot and slot and tracks[slot] then
            local entry = tracks[slot]
            adjust(
                entry,
                speed or 1
            )
            -- A bounded watchdog recovers an unexpectedly ended owned loop, but
            -- never chases native/foreign tracks or intentionally frozen poses.
            if looped and entry.loaded and read(entry.track, "IsPlaying") == false and (speed or 1) > 0 then
                if not entry.nextRestart or clock >= entry.nextRestart then
                    entry.restarts = (entry.restarts or 0) + 1
                    entry.nextRestart = clock + 0.75
                    if entry.restarts > 3 then
                        api.error = "The game repeatedly stopped this owned animation loop / no endless replay storm"
                        api.stop("LOOP WATCHDOG STOPPED / ORIGINAL STATE RESTORED")
                        return nil
                    end
                    local ok, why = pcall(function()
                        entry.track:Play(
                            0.12,
                            1,
                            speed or 1
                        )
                    end)
                    if not ok then
                        api.error = tostring(why)
                        api.stop("OWNED LOOP REPLAY FAILED / ORIGINAL STATE RESTORED")
                        return nil
                    end
                end
            end
            return entry
        end
        -- Keep this profile's small owned cache across gait changes, as the clear
        -- sources do. Stop cached entries here; destroy them only on OFF/retry/unload.
        for key, entry in pairs(tracks) do
            if key ~= slot and read(entry.track, "IsPlaying") then
                pcall(function()
                    entry.track:Stop(0.12)
                end)
            end
        end
        local changed = profileState ~= slot
        ;
        profileState = slot
        if not slot then
            return 
        end
        local row = data.profiles[api.active]
        local id = row and row.assets[slot]
        if not id then
            return 
        end
        local entry = tracks[slot]
        if entry then
            if changed then
                local ok, why = pcall(function()
                    entry.track.Looped = looped == true
                    ;
                    entry.track:Play(
                        0.12,
                        1,
                        speed or 1
                    )
                end)
                if not ok then
                    api.error = tostring(why)
                    ;
                    return nil
                end
                entry.speed = speed or 1
            else
                adjust(
                    entry,
                    speed or 1
                )
            end
            return entry
        end
        local why
        entry, why = loadTrack(
            slot,
            id,
            looped,
            speed
        )
        if not entry and why ~= "Animation is already loading" and not api.error then
            api.error = why
        end
        return entry
    end
    local function blocked()
        if not context then
            return true
        end
        local h = context.hum
        ;
        local s = h:GetState()
        return h.Sit or h.PlatformStand or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
    end
    local function groundMoving()
        local direction = (read(context.hum, "MoveDirection") or Vector3.zero).Magnitude > 0.01
        if api.active == "psycho" then
            return direction
        end
        return direction or runVelocity > 0.1
    end
    local function makeSound(
        key,
        id,
        looped
    )
        if sounds[key] then
            return sounds[key]
        end
        if not context then
            return 
        end
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        ;
        s.Name = "DeathNote_Sonic_" .. key
        ;
        s.SoundId = id
        ;
        s.Looped = looped
        ;
        s.Volume = api.settings.sonic6.volume
        ;
        s.Parent = context.root
        ;
        sounds[key] = s
        ;
        return s
    end
    local function audioStep(
        moving,
        air
    )
        local settings = api.settings.sonic6
        if not settings.audio or air or not moving then
            if sounds.foot then
                pcall(function()
                    sounds.foot:Stop()
                end)
            end
            if not settings.audio then
                clearSounds()
            end
            return 
        end
        local sound = makeSound(
            "foot",
            data.profiles.sonic6.sounds.foot,
            true
        )
        if sound then
            pcall(function()
                sound.Volume = settings.volume
                ;
                sound.PlaybackSpeed = api.sprint and 2 or 1
                ;
                if not sound.IsPlaying then
                    sound:Play()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    function api.start(key)
        local row = data.profiles[key]
        if api.closed or not row or not api.enabled[key] then
            return false, "Enable this inventory Tool first"
        end
        if api.launching or api.externalConsumed then
            return false, "External session is not reversible / rejoin before mixing profiles"
        end
        local live, why = currentCharacter(row.rig)
        ;
        if not live then
            api.error = why
            ;
            publish(true)
            ;
            return false, why
        end
        if key == "monster" and api.monsterSet == "ORIGINAL" then
            return false, "ORIGINAL is already restored; select MONSTER SET first"
        end
        if api.active == key then
            return true
        end
        api.stop("SWITCHING RANDOM PROFILE")
        ;
        suspendOthers()
        context = live
        ;
        api.active = key
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        failed = {
        }
        ;
        profileState = nil
        ;
        runVelocity = 0
        connect(live.hum.Running, function(value)
            if context == live then
                runVelocity = math.max(
                    0,
                    tonumber(value) or 0
                )
            end
        end, characterLinks)
        connect(live.hum.StateChanged, function(_, state)
            if context ~= live then
                return 
            end
            if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
                canDoubleJump = false
                ;
                doubleUsed = false
            end
            if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and not doubleUsed then
                canDoubleJump = true
            end
        end, characterLinks)
        api.sprint = false
        ;
        canDoubleJump = false
        ;
        doubleUsed = false
        ;
        retroNext = clock
        ;
        retroFrozen = false
        ;
        idleCycle = clock
        ;
        jumpFreezeAt = clock
        spawnStarted = key == "monster" and api.monsterSet == "MONSTER" and api.settings.monster.spawn
        spawnDeadline = clock + 30
        if spawnStarted then
            local entry, problem = loadTrack(
                "spawn",
                row.assets.spawn,
                false,
                1
            )
            if not entry then
                spawnStarted = false
                ;
                api.error = problem
            end
            profileState = "spawn"
        end
        api.state = row.title .. " / ACTIVE"
        ;
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setSprint(value)
        if api.active ~= "sonic6" then
            return false, "Start Sonic R6 first"
        end
        api.sprint = value == true
        ;
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setMonsterSet(value)
        if value ~= "MONSTER" and value ~= "ORIGINAL" then
            return false, "Unknown Monster set"
        end
        api.monsterSet = value
        if api.active == "monster" then
            api.stop("MONSTER SET CHANGED / OWNED STATE RESTORED")
            ;
            if value == "MONSTER" then
                return api.start("monster")
            end
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setSetting(
        key,
        name,
        value
    )
        local settings = api.settings[key]
        ;
        if not settings or settings[name] == nil then
            return false, "Unknown setting"
        end
        if type(settings[name]) == "boolean" then
            value = value == true
        else
            value = tonumber(value)
            local maximum = name == "volume" and 1 or name == "jumpHeight" and 30 or name == "jumpPower" and 200 or 128
            if not value or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge or value < 0 or value > maximum then
                return false, "Value must be finite and within 0.." .. maximum
            end
        end
        settings[name] = value
        if api.active == key and context then
            if name == "speed" and not value then
                release(
                    context.hum,
                    "WalkSpeed"
                )
            end
            if name == "jump" and not value then
                for _, prop in ipairs({
                    "JumpPower",
                    "JumpHeight",
                    "UseJumpPower",
                }) do
                    release(
                        context.hum,
                        prop
                    )
                end
            end
            if name == "audio" and not value then
                clearSounds()
            end
            if name == "doubleJump" and not value then
                canDoubleJump = false
            end
            if name == "spawnCollision" and not value then
                for _, part in ipairs(context.character:GetChildren()) do
                    release(
                        part,
                        "CanCollide"
                    )
                end
            end
            if name == "retro" and not value then
                for _, entry in pairs(tracks) do
                    adjust(
                        entry,
                        profileState == "idle" and 3 or 1
                    )
                end
                ;
                retroFrozen = false
            end
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.retry()
        failed = {
        }
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        clearTracks()
        ;
        profileState = nil
        if spawnStarted then
            spawnStarted = false
            ;
            if context then
                for _, part in ipairs(context.character:GetChildren()) do
                    release(
                        part,
                        "CanCollide"
                    )
                end
            end
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function removeTool(key)
        disconnect(toolLinks[key])
        ;
        toolLinks[key] = nil
        local t = tools[key]
        ;
        tools[key] = nil
        ;
        drop(t)
    end
    local function ensureTool(key)
        if api.closed or not api.enabled[key] then
            return true
        end
        if tools[key] and tools[key].Parent then
            return true
        end
        removeTool(key)
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if not backpack then
            return false, "Backpack not available yet"
        end
        local t
        local ok, why = pcall(function()
            t = Instance.new("Tool")
            ;
            t.Name = data.profiles[key].tool
            ;
            t.RequiresHandle = false
            ;
            t.CanBeDropped = false
            ;
            t.ToolTip = "Death'Note / equip to open / START is separate"
            ;
            t.Parent = backpack
        end)
        if not ok then
            drop(t)
            ;
            return false, tostring(why)
        end
        tools[key] = t
        ;
        toolLinks[key] = {
        }
        connect(t.Equipped, function()
            if api.closed or not api.enabled[key] then
                return 
            end
            api.setWindow(
                key,
                true
            )
            if t.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character then
                pcall(function()
                    t.Parent = backpack
                end)
            end
        end, toolLinks[key])
        connect(t.Activated, function()
            if not api.closed then
                api.setWindow(
                    key,
                    true
                )
            end
        end, toolLinks[key])
        return true
    end
    function api.setEnabled(
        key,
        value
    )
        if api.closed or not data.profiles[key] then
            return false, "Unknown Tool"
        end
        if value then
            api.enabled[key] = true
            ;
            local ok, why = ensureTool(key)
            if not ok then
                api.enabled[key] = false
                ;
                removeTool(key)
                ;
                api.error = why
                ;
                publish(true)
                ;
                return false, why
            end
        else
            if pendingResume and pendingResume.key == key then
                pendingResume = nil
            end
            api.enabled[key] = false
            ;
            api.windows[key].open = false
            ;
            api.windows[key].minimized = false
            if api.active == key then
                api.stop("TOOL OFF / OWNED EFFECTS RESTORED")
            end
            removeTool(key)
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setWindow(
        key,
        value
    )
        local w = api.windows[key]
        ;
        if not w or api.closed then
            return false, "Unknown Tool window"
        end
        if value and not api.enabled[key] then
            return false, "Enable this Tool first"
        end
        w.open = value == true
        if value then
            w.minimized = false
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.minimize(key)
        local w = api.windows[key]
        ;
        if not w or not w.open then
            return false
        end
        w.minimized = not w.minimized
        ;
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    -- Frame-driven state machines replace the original unbounded coroutine loops.
    local function restoreSpawnCollisions()
        if not context then
            return 
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "UpperTorso",
            "LowerTorso",
        }) do
            local p = context.character:FindFirstChild(name)
            ;
            if p then
                release(
                    p,
                    "CanCollide"
                )
            end
        end
    end
    local function propertyStep()
        if not context then
            return 
        end
        local h = context.hum
        ;
        local settings = api.settings[api.active]
        if settings.speed then
            local speed = api.active == "sonic6" and api.sprint and settings.runSpeed or settings.walkSpeed
            own(
                h,
                "WalkSpeed",
                speed
            )
        else
            release(
                h,
                "WalkSpeed"
            )
        end
        if settings.jump then
            own(
                h,
                "UseJumpPower",
                true
            )
            ;
            own(
                h,
                "JumpPower",
                settings.jumpPower
            )
            if settings.jumpHeight then
                own(
                    h,
                    "JumpHeight",
                    settings.jumpHeight
                )
            end
        else
            release(
                h,
                "UseJumpPower"
            )
            ;
            release(
                h,
                "JumpPower"
            )
            ;
            release(
                h,
                "JumpHeight"
            )
        end
    end
    local function retroStep(
        entry,
        baseSpeed,
        spawn
    )
        if not entry then
            return 
        end
        if not api.settings.monster.retro then
            adjust(
                entry,
                baseSpeed
            )
            ;
            retroFrozen = false
            ;
            return 
        end
        local length = read(entry.track, "Length") or 0
        if length <= 0 then
            return 
        end
        if clock < retroNext then
            return 
        end
        retroFrozen = not retroFrozen
        adjust(
            entry,
            retroFrozen and 0 or baseSpeed
        )
        if retroFrozen then
            retroNext = clock + 0.15
        else
            retroNext = clock + 0.1 + math.random() * (spawn and 0.05 or 0.1)
        end
    end
    local function monsterSpawnStep()
        local entry = tracks.spawn
        if not entry then
            spawnStarted = false
            ;
            restoreSpawnCollisions()
            ;
            profileState = nil
            ;
            return false
        end
        local length = read(entry.track, "Length") or 0
        local playing = read(
            entry.track,
            "IsPlaying"
        )
        if length > 0 then
            entry.loaded = true
        end
        if entry.loaded and not playing or clock >= spawnDeadline then
            clearTrack("spawn")
            ;
            spawnStarted = false
            ;
            restoreSpawnCollisions()
            ;
            profileState = nil
            ;
            retroFrozen = false
            ;
            retroNext = clock
            ;
            return false
        end
        if api.settings.monster.spawnCollision and length > 0 then
            for _, name in ipairs({
                "UpperTorso",
                "LowerTorso",
            }) do
                local part = context.character:FindFirstChild(name)
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    own(
                        part,
                        "CanCollide",
                        true
                    )
                end
            end
        else
            restoreSpawnCollisions()
        end
        retroStep(
            entry,
            1,
            true
        )
        api.state = "MONSTER R15 / SPAWN INTRO / " .. (retroFrozen and "HOLD" or "PLAY")
        return true
    end
    local function sonicStep(
        state,
        moving,
        air
    )
        local settings = api.settings.sonic6
        local factor = (
            api.sprint and settings.runSpeed or settings.walkSpeed) / math.max(1,
            settings.runSpeed
        )
        local slot = air and "jump" or moving and (api.sprint and "run" or "walk") or "idle"
        playOnly(
            slot,
            factor,
            not air
        )
        if not api.active then
            return 
        end
        audioStep(
            moving,
            air
        )
        api.state = "SONIC R6 / " .. slot:upper() .. " / " .. tostring(api.sprint and settings.runSpeed or settings.walkSpeed)
    end
    local function monsterStep(
        state,
        moving,
        air
    )
        local slot = air and "jump" or moving and "walk" or "idle"
        if locomotion ~= slot then
            retroFrozen = false
            ;
            retroNext = clock + 0.1
            if slot == "jump" then
                jumpFreezeAt = clock + 1 / 60
            end
        end
        local entry = playOnly(
            slot,
            slot == "idle" and (retroFrozen and 0 or 3) or slot == "jump" and (clock >= jumpFreezeAt and 0 or 1) or 1,
            true
        )
        if not api.active then
            return 
        end
        if slot == "idle" then
            retroStep(
                entry,
                3,
                false
            )
        elseif slot == "jump" and clock >= jumpFreezeAt then
            adjust(
                entry,
                0
            )
        end
        locomotion = slot
        api.state = "MONSTER R15 / " .. slot:upper() .. (slot == "jump" and " / FROZEN POSE" or slot == "idle" and " / RETRO" or "")
    end
    local function psychoStep(
        state,
        moving,
        air
    )
        local slot, speed, looped
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
            slot = "jump"
            ;
            speed = 1
            ;
            looped = false
        elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            slot = "fall"
            ;
            speed = 1
            ;
            looped = true
        elseif moving then
            slot = "walk"
            ;
            speed = 1
            ;
            looped = true
        else
            if locomotion ~= "idle" then
                idleCycle = clock
            end
            local phase = (clock - idleCycle) % 3.5
            if phase < 0.2 then
                slot = "idle"
                ;
                speed = 100
                ;
                looped = false
            elseif phase >= 1.7 and phase < 2 then
                slot = "idle2"
                ;
                speed = 5
                ;
                looped = false
            else
                slot = nil
            end
        end
        playOnly(
            slot,
            speed,
            looped
        )
        if not api.active then
            return 
        end
        locomotion = air and "air" or moving and "walk" or "idle"
        api.state = "PSYCHO R6 / " .. (slot and slot:upper() or "IDLE GAP")
    end
    local function motionStep(dt)
        if not context then
            return 
        end
        local expired
        for _, entry in pairs(tracks) do
            local length = read(
                entry.track,
                "Length"
            )
            if type(length) == "number" and length > 0 then
                entry.loaded = true
            end
            if not entry.loaded and clock - entry.started > 12 then
                expired = entry.id
                ;
                break
            end
        end
        if expired then
            failed[expired] = true
            ;
            api.error = "Asset " .. expired .. " did not become playable / game permissions apply"
            ;
            api.stop("ASSET TIMEOUT / ORIGINAL STATE RESTORED")
            ;
            return 
        end
        if blocked() then
            if spawnStarted then
                clearTrack("spawn")
                ;
                spawnStarted = false
                ;
                restoreSpawnCollisions()
            end
            clearTracks()
            ;
            profileState = nil
            ;
            locomotion = nil
            ;
            lastHumanoidState = nil
            if sounds.foot then
                pcall(function()
                    sounds.foot:Stop()
                end)
            end
            api.state = data.profiles[api.active].title .. " / PAUSED FOR CHARACTER STATE"
            ;
            return 
        end
        propertyStep()
        local state = context.hum:GetState()
        local air = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
        local moving = groundMoving()
        if state ~= lastHumanoidState then
            if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and not doubleUsed then
                canDoubleJump = true
            end
            if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed or not air then
                canDoubleJump = false
                ;
                doubleUsed = false
            end
            lastHumanoidState = state
        end
        if api.active == "monster" then
            if spawnStarted and monsterSpawnStep() then
                return 
            end
            monsterStep(
                state,
                moving,
                air
            )
        elseif api.active == "sonic6" then
            sonicStep(
                state,
                moving,
                air
            )
        elseif api.active == "psycho" then
            psychoStep(
                state,
                moving,
                air
            )
        end
    end
    -- Opaque source consent is session-local and expires. No source runs at boot, tab open,
    -- Tool grant, respawn, OFF or GUI close. Closing this hub cannot cancel a launched payload.
    local consentSerial = 0
    function api.armExternal(key)
        local row = data.remote[key]
        if api.closed or not row then
            return false, "Unknown external source"
        end
        if api.launching or api.externalConsumed then
            return false, "One external launch already attempted / REJOIN before another"
        end
        local live, why = currentCharacter(row.rig)
        if not live then
            return false, why
        end
        consentSerial = consentSerial + 1
        local token = {
            serial = consentSerial,
            key = key,
            character = live.character,
            expires = clock + 30,
        }
        consent = token
        return true, token
    end
    function api.cancelExternal(token)
        if consent == token then
            consent = nil
            ;
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function externalFail(
        key,
        why
    )
        local e = api.external[key]
        e.error = tostring(why)
        ;
        e.phase = e.used and "RUNTIME ERROR / REJOIN" or "BLOCKED / NOT EXECUTED"
        api.error = e.error
        ;
        api.launching = false
        ;
        api.state = e.phase
        ;
        publish(true)
        return false, e.error
    end
    function api.runExternal(
        key,
        token
    )
        local row = data.remote[key]
        if api.closed or not row then
            return false, "Unknown external source"
        end
        if api.launching or api.externalConsumed then
            return false, "External session is one-shot / REJOIN required"
        end
        if not token or consent ~= token or token.key ~= key or clock > token.expires then
            return false, "Explicit warning confirmation expired or missing"
        end
        consent = nil
        local live, why = currentCharacter(row.rig)
        if not live or live.character ~= token.character then
            return false, why or "Character changed; read the warning again"
        end
        api.launching = true
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        api.external[key].phase = "FETCHING PINNED SOURCE"
        ;
        publish(true)
        local stamp = generation
        task.spawn(function()
            -- HttpGet is attempted only for the two literal user-supplied URLs.
            local ok, body = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(row.url)
            end)
            if not ok then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "Download failed: " .. tostring(body)
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            if api.closed or generation ~= stamp or LocalPlayer.Character ~= token.character then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "Cancelled before execution / session or character changed"
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            api.external[key].phase = "VERIFYING EXACT SHA-256"
            ;
            publish(true)
            local valid, problem = RandomAddonIntegrity.verify(
                key,
                body
            )
            if not valid then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    problem
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "loadstring is unavailable / nothing executed"
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            local compileOk, compiled, compileWhy = pcall(
                loadstring,
                body,
                "DeathNote_ExplicitExternal_" .. key
            )
            if not compileOk then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "Source compile raised: " .. tostring(compiled)
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            if type(compiled) ~= "function" then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "Source compile failed: " .. tostring(compileWhy)
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            if api.closed or generation ~= stamp or LocalPlayer.Character ~= token.character then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "Cancelled before execution"
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            api.stop(
                "EXTERNAL HANDOFF / NO VERIFIED OFF",
                true
            )
            ;
            suspendOthers()
            ;
            packLease = nil
            api.externalConsumed = true
            ;
            api.external[key].used = true
            ;
            api.external[key].phase = "STARTED / NO VERIFIED OFF / REJOIN TO RESET"
            api.launching = false
            ;
            api.state = api.external[key].phase
            ;
            publish(true)
            if api.closed or LocalPlayer.Character ~= token.character then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "Cancelled immediately before execution"
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            local ran, result = pcall(compiled)
            if not ran then
                externalFail(
                    key,
                    "External runtime error; side effects may remain. REJOIN. " .. tostring(result)
                )
                ;
                return 
            end
            -- Returning does not prove the payload stopped; it may have installed callbacks.
            api.external[key].phase = "LAUNCHED / UNKNOWN EFFECTS MAY PERSIST / REJOIN"
            api.state = api.external[key].phase
            ;
            publish(true)
        end)
        return true, "Explicit external launch queued; no OFF guarantee"
    end
    -- Human-readable ownership audit: never scans or deletes unrelated game objects.
    local function describeValue(value)
        if value == nil then
            return "<unavailable>"
        end
        if type(value) == "number" then
            return string.format(
                "%.5g",
                value
            )
        end
        if type(value) == "boolean" then
            return value and "true" or "false"
        end
        local ok, name = pcall(function()
            return value.Name
        end)
        if ok and type(name) == "string" then
            return name
        end
        return tostring(value)
    end
    local function describeObject(object)
        local ok, name = pcall(function()
            return object:GetFullName()
        end)
        if ok and type(name) == "string" then
            return name
        end
        return describeValue(object)
    end
    function api.audit()
        local rows = {
        }
        for object, properties in pairs(ledger) do
            for name, e in pairs(properties) do
                local current = read(
                    object,
                    name
                )
                local status = e.blocked and "GAME OVERRIDE / NOT RESTORED" or current == e.last and "OWNED / RESTORABLE" or "EXTERNAL CHANGE / PRESERVED"
                rows[#rows + 1] = {
                    object = describeObject(object),
                    property = name,
                    before = describeValue(e.before),
                    last = describeValue(e.last),
                    current = describeValue(current),
                    status = status,
                }
            end
        end
        table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
            return a.object .. a.property < b.object .. b.property
        end)
        local assets = {
        }
        for key, e in pairs(tracks) do
            local length = read(
                e.track,
                "Length"
            )
            assets[#assets + 1] = {
                slot = key,
                id = e.id,
                loaded = type(length) == "number" and length > 0 or false,
                length = type(length) == "number" and length or 0,
                position = read(e.track, "TimePosition") or 0,
                speed = e.speed,
                playing = read(e.track, "IsPlaying") == true,
            }
        end
        table.sort(assets, function(a, b)
            return a.slot < b.slot
        end)
        local preview = RedTelemetry.RandomAddonPreview
        local previewInfo = preview and preview.diagnostics() or {
            count = 0,
            connection = 0,
        }
        return {
            active = api.active,
            state = api.state,
            error = api.error,
            properties = rows,
            assets = assets,
            ownedSounds = (function()
                local n = 0
                ;
                for _ in pairs(sounds) do
                    n = n + 1
                end
                ;
                return n
            end)(),
            managedConnections = #links + #characterLinks,
            previewCount = previewInfo.count,
            previewConnections = previewInfo.connection,
            externalUnknown = api.externalConsumed,
            rig = context and context.rig or "NONE",
            nativeAnimateChanged = false,
            foreignTracksDestroyed = false,
        }
    end
    function api.report()
        local audit = api.audit()
        local lines = {
            "Death'Note / RANDOM PROFILE REPORT",
            "PROFILE: " .. tostring(audit.active or "NONE"),
            "STATE: " .. audit.state,
            "RIG: " .. audit.rig,
            "ERROR: " .. tostring(audit.error or "NONE"),
            "NATIVE ANIMATE: NOT DISABLED OR REWRITTEN",
            "FOREIGN TRACKS: NOT DESTROYED",
            "MANAGED CONNECTIONS: " .. audit.managedConnections,
            "OWNED SOUNDS: " .. audit.ownedSounds,
            "ADDON LOCAL PREVIEW: " .. audit.previewCount,
            "EXTERNAL ONE-SHOT USED: " .. tostring(audit.externalUnknown),
        }
        for _, asset in ipairs(audit.assets) do
            lines[#lines + 1] = "TRACK " .. asset.slot .. " / " .. asset.id .. " / LOADED=" .. tostring(asset.loaded) .. " / SPEED=" .. describeValue(asset.speed) .. " / LENGTH=" .. describeValue(asset.length) .. " / POSITION=" .. describeValue(asset.position)
        end
        for _, row in ipairs(audit.properties) do
            lines[#lines + 1] = "PROPERTY " .. row.object .. "." .. row.property .. " / BEFORE=" .. row.before .. " / CURRENT=" .. row.current .. " / " .. row.status
        end
        if audit.externalUnknown then
            lines[#lines + 1] = "EXTERNAL EFFECTS ARE NOT AUDITED OR REVERSIBLE HERE. REJOIN MAY BE REQUIRED."
        end
        lines[#lines + 1] = "This is local diagnostic state, not a live FE replication or FPS guarantee."
        return table.concat(
            lines,
            "\n"
        )
    end
    function api.copyReport()
        local copy = genv and genv.setclipboard or setclipboard
        if type(copy) ~= "function" then
            return false, "Clipboard unavailable; select the report text manually"
        end
        local ok, why = pcall(
            copy,
            api.report()
        )
        return ok, ok and "Report copied by your request" or tostring(why)
    end
    function api.resetDefaults(key)
        local row = data.profiles[key]
        if api.closed or not row then
            return false, "Unknown profile"
        end
        if api.active == key then
            api.stop("SOURCE DEFAULTS RESET / PROFILE STOPPED")
        end
        for name, value in pairs(row.defaults) do
            api.settings[key][name] = value
        end
        if key == "monster" then
            api.monsterSet = "MONSTER"
        end
        api.error = nil
        ;
        failed = {
        }
        ;
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.useAnimationOnly(key)
        if api.closed or not data.profiles[key] then
            return false, "Unknown profile"
        end
        local settings = api.settings[key]
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "speed",
            "jump",
            "audio",
            "doubleJump",
            "spawnCollision",
        }) do
            if settings[name] ~= nil then
                api.setSetting(
                    key,
                    name,
                    false
                )
            end
        end
        api.state = "ANIMATION-ONLY SETTINGS / SOURCE MOVEMENT OVERRIDES DISABLED"
        ;
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    -- Explicit settings transfer only. Configs cannot enable Tools, execute remote code,
    -- change a rig, start animations or preserve external-launch consent.
    local slots = {
    }
    local function settingsDocument()
        local document = {
            kind = "DeathNoteRandomProfiles",
            version = 1,
            profiles = {
            },
            monsterSet = api.monsterSet,
        }
        for key, settings in pairs(api.settings) do
            local copy = {
            }
            ;
            for name, value in pairs(settings) do
                copy[name] = value
            end
            document.profiles[key] = copy
        end
        return document
    end
    local function settingLimit(name)
        if name == "volume" then
            return 1
        end
        if name == "jumpHeight" then
            return 30
        end
        if name == "jumpPower" then
            return 200
        end
        return 128
    end
    function api.validateSettings(document)
        if type(document) ~= "table" then
            return nil, "Expected a settings object"
        end
        if document.kind ~= "DeathNoteRandomProfiles" or document.version ~= 1 then
            return nil, "This is not a supported Death'Note managed-profile config"
        end
        for key in pairs(document) do
            if key ~= "kind" and key ~= "version" and key ~= "profiles" and key ~= "monsterSet" then
                return nil, "Unknown config field / nothing changed: " .. tostring(key)
            end
        end
        if document.monsterSet ~= "MONSTER" and document.monsterSet ~= "ORIGINAL" then
            return nil, "Invalid Monster selection"
        end
        if type(document.profiles) ~= "table" then
            return nil, "Missing profiles"
        end
        for key in pairs(document.profiles) do
            if not data.profiles[key] then
                return nil, "Unknown managed profile: " .. tostring(key)
            end
        end
        local staged = {
        }
        for key, row in pairs(data.profiles) do
            local values = document.profiles[key]
            if type(values) ~= "table" then
                return nil, "Missing managed settings: " .. key
            end
            for name in pairs(values) do
                if row.defaults[name] == nil then
                    return nil, "Unknown setting: " .. key .. "." .. tostring(name)
                end
            end
            local copy = {
            }
            for name, default in pairs(row.defaults) do
                local value = values[name]
                if type(value) ~= type(default) then
                    return nil, "Invalid or missing type: " .. key .. "." .. name
                end
                if type(value) == "number" and (value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge or value < 0 or value > settingLimit(name)) then
                    return nil, "Out-of-range setting: " .. key .. "." .. name
                end
                copy[name] = value
            end
            staged[key] = copy
        end
        return {
            profiles = staged,
            monsterSet = document.monsterSet,
        }
    end
    function api.exportSettings()
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Controller is closed"
        end
        local service = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local ok, json = pcall(function()
            return service:JSONEncode(settingsDocument())
        end)
        if not ok or type(json) ~= "string" then
            return false, "Settings encoding failed: " .. tostring(json)
        end
        return true, json
    end
    function api.applySettings(document)
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Controller is closed"
        end
        if api.externalConsumed or api.launching then
            return false, "Rejoin before importing managed settings into an external session"
        end
        local staged, why = api.validateSettings(document)
        if not staged then
            return false, why
        end
        api.stop("IMPORTED SETTINGS / PROFILE STOPPED")
        for key, values in pairs(staged.profiles) do
            for name, value in pairs(values) do
                api.settings[key][name] = value
            end
        end
        api.monsterSet = staged.monsterSet
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        failed = {
        }
        api.state = "SETTINGS IMPORTED / NO TOOLS ENABLED / PRESS START MANUALLY"
        ;
        publish(true)
        return true, "Managed settings imported; no profile was started"
    end
    function api.importSettings(json)
        if type(json) ~= "string" or #json == 0 or #json > 32768 then
            return false, "Paste a managed config between 1 and 32768 bytes"
        end
        local service = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local ok, document = pcall(function()
            return service:JSONDecode(json)
        end)
        if not ok then
            return false, "Invalid JSON / nothing changed"
        end
        return api.applySettings(document)
    end
    function api.copySettings()
        local ok, json = api.exportSettings()
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, json
        end
        local copy = genv and genv.setclipboard or setclipboard
        if type(copy) ~= "function" then
            return false, "Clipboard unavailable; export and select the config text manually"
        end
        local copied, why = pcall(
            copy,
            json
        )
        return copied, copied and "Managed settings copied" or tostring(why)
    end
    local function validSlot(index)
        return type(index) == "number" and index == math.floor(index) and index >= 1 and index <= 3
    end
    function api.saveSlot(index)
        if not validSlot(index) then
            return false, "Choose session slot 1, 2 or 3"
        end
        local ok, json = api.exportSettings()
        ;
        if not ok then
            return false, json
        end
        slots[index] = {
            json = json,
            bytes = #json,
            saved = clock,
        }
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true, "Saved managed settings to session slot " .. index
    end
    function api.loadSlot(index)
        if not validSlot(index) or not slots[index] then
            return false, "This session slot is empty"
        end
        return api.importSettings(slots[index].json)
    end
    function api.clearSlot(index)
        if not validSlot(index) then
            return false, "Choose session slot 1, 2 or 3"
        end
        slots[index] = nil
        ;
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.slotInfo()
        local result = {
        }
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local slot = slots[i]
            ;
            result[i] = {
                filled = slot ~= nil,
                bytes = slot and slot.bytes or 0,
                saved = slot and slot.saved or nil,
            }
        end
        return result
    end
    -- The bridge is reversible too: restore wrappers only if nobody replaced them.
    local old = RedTelemetry.RandomAnimations
    if old then
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "startGuest",
            "punch",
            "block",
            "guestEmote",
            "toggleFE",
            "playCar",
        }) do
            local original = old[name]
            if type(original) == "function" then
                local wrapped = function(...)
                    if api.externalConsumed or api.launching then
                        return false, "External session active / rejoin before mixing controllers"
                    end
                    if api.active then
                        api.stop("PREVIOUS RANDOM TOOL TOOK CONTROL")
                    end
                    return original(...)
                end
                old[name] = wrapped
                ;
                hooks[#hooks + 1] = {
                    target = old,
                    key = name,
                    original = original,
                    wrapper = wrapped,
                }
            end
        end
    end
    function api.characterStatus()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local h = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not h or character == removing then
            return "WAITING", false
        end
        local rig = "UNKNOWN"
        if h.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            rig = "R6"
        elseif h.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            rig = "R15"
        end
        if h.Health <= 0 then
            return rig .. " / DEAD", false
        end
        if not h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") then
            return rig .. " / WAITING FOR ANIMATOR", false
        end
        if not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            return rig .. " / WAITING FOR ROOT", false
        end
        return rig, true
    end
    function api.diagnostics()
        local count, toolCount, soundCount, properties, listenerCount = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
        for _ in pairs(tracks) do
            count = count + 1
        end
        for _ in pairs(tools) do
            toolCount = toolCount + 1
        end
        for _ in pairs(sounds) do
            soundCount = soundCount + 1
        end
        for _, row in pairs(ledger) do
            for _ in pairs(row) do
                properties = properties + 1
            end
        end
        for _ in pairs(listeners) do
            listenerCount = listenerCount + 1
        end
        return {
            trackCount = count,
            tracks = tracks,
            tools = tools,
            toolCount = toolCount,
            sounds = sounds,
            soundCount = soundCount,
            properties = properties,
            connections = #links,
            listeners = listenerCount,
            packLease = packLease,
            packRestore = packRestore,
            pendingResume = pendingResume,
            context = context,
            profileState = profileState,
            canDoubleJump = canDoubleJump,
            doubleUsed = doubleUsed,
            remoteConsumed = api.externalConsumed,
            failed = failed,
            integrity = RandomAddonIntegrity,
        }
    end
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        consent = nil
        ;
        api.stop("HUB CLOSED / MANAGED PROFILES REMOVED")
        for key in pairs(data.profiles) do
            api.enabled[key] = false
            ;
            api.windows[key].open = false
            ;
            removeTool(key)
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        api.closed = true
        ;
        generation = generation + 1
        disconnect(links)
        ;
        links = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        for _, hook in ipairs(hooks) do
            if hook.target[hook.key] == hook.wrapper then
                hook.target[hook.key] = hook.original
            end
        end
        hooks = {
        }
        ;
        slots = {
        }
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
        local resumeKey = api.active and api.settings[api.active].resumeOnRespawn and api.active
        removing = character
        ;
        consent = nil
        ;
        api.stop("RESPAWN / MANAGED PROFILE STOPPED")
        if resumeKey and not api.externalConsumed then
            pendingResume = {
                key = resumeKey,
                expires = clock + 30,
            }
            ;
            api.state = "RESPAWN / EXPLICIT AUTO-RESUME WAITING"
            ;
            publish(true)
        end
    end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        removing = nil
        ;
        api.state = "CHARACTER READY / PRESS START"
        ;
        publish(true)
    end)
    connect(
        MainGui.Destroying,
        api.close
    )
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if processed or api.closed or api.active ~= "sonic6" then
            return 
        end
        if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            return 
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
            api.setSprint(true)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift and api.active == "sonic6" then
            api.setSprint(false)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
        if api.sprint then
            api.setSprint(false)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.JumpRequest, function()
        if api.active ~= "sonic6" or not context or blocked() then
            return 
        end
        if not api.settings.sonic6.doubleJump or not canDoubleJump or doubleUsed then
            return 
        end
        if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            return 
        end
        canDoubleJump = false
        ;
        doubleUsed = true
        pcall(function()
            context.hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end)
        if api.settings.sonic6.audio then
            local s = makeSound(
                "jump",
                data.profiles.sonic6.sounds.jump,
                false
            )
            ;
            if s then
                pcall(function()
                    s:Play()
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
    local maintenance = 0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        local delta = math.clamp(
            tonumber(dt) or 0,
            0,
            0.25
        )
        clock = clock + delta
        ;
        maintenance = maintenance + delta
        ;
        lastUi = lastUi + delta
        if consent and clock > consent.expires then
            consent = nil
        end
        if api.active and not same(context) then
            api.stop("CHARACTER / ANIMATOR CHANGED")
        end
        if api.active then
            local packs = RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks
            local r6 = RedTelemetry.R6Animations
            local em = RedTelemetry.Emotes
            local emPending = false
            if em and type(em.diagnostics) == "function" then
                local ok, d = pcall(em.diagnostics)
                ;
                emPending = ok and type(d) == "table" and (d.pending or d.inflight)
            end
            if packs and packs.selected or r6 and r6.selected or em and em.nowId or emPending then
                api.stop(
                    "ANOTHER ANIMATION SELECTION TOOK CONTROL",
                    true
                )
            end
        end
        if api.active then
            local ok, why = pcall(function()
                motionStep(delta)
            end)
            if not ok then
                api.error = tostring(why)
                ;
                api.stop("PROFILE ERROR / OWNED STATE RESTORED")
            end
        end
        if maintenance >= 0.5 then
            maintenance = 0
            ;
            for key in pairs(data.profiles) do
                ensureTool(key)
            end
            if pendingResume and not api.active and not api.launching and not api.externalConsumed then
                local queued = pendingResume
                if not api.enabled[queued.key] or clock > queued.expires then
                    pendingResume = nil
                    ;
                    api.state = "AUTO-RESUME CANCELLED / PRESS START"
                else
                    local live = currentCharacter(data.profiles[queued.key].rig)
                    if live then
                        pendingResume = nil
                        ;
                        api.start(queued.key)
                    end
                end
            end
            if packRestore and not api.active then
                local packs = RedTelemetry.AnimationPacks
                if packs and packs.selected then
                    packRestore = nil
                elseif currentCharacter("R15") then
                    restorePack()
                end
            end
        end
        if lastUi >= 0.1 then
            lastUi = 0
            ;
            publish()
        end
    end)
    return api
end)()
-- One optional local preview shared across the new managed-profile windows.
-- No workspace dummy, rig conversion, Sound playback or remote source execution.
RedTelemetry.RandomAddonPreview = (function()
    local api = RedTelemetry.RandomAddons
    local data = api.data
    local preview = {
        closed = false,
        owner = nil,
        slot = nil,
        speed = 1,
        paused = false,
        orbit = true,
        zoom = 1,
        state = "PREVIEW OFF",
        error = nil,
    }
    local current, render
    local generation = 0
    local time = 0
    local accumulator = 0
    local angle = 0
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function disposeTrack(p)
        if p and p.track then
            pcall(function()
                p.track:Stop(0)
            end)
            ;
            drop(p.track)
            ;
            p.track = nil
        end
        if p and p.animation then
            drop(p.animation)
            ;
            p.animation = nil
        end
    end
    local function stopRender()
        if render then
            render:Disconnect()
            ;
            render = nil
        end
    end
    function preview.stop(reason)
        generation = generation + 1
        ;
        stopRender()
        local p = current
        ;
        current = nil
        if p then
            disposeTrack(p)
            ;
            drop(p.model)
            ;
            drop(p.world)
            ;
            drop(p.camera)
            ;
            if p.viewport then
                pcall(function()
                    p.viewport.CurrentCamera = nil
                end)
            end
        end
        preview.owner = nil
        ;
        preview.slot = nil
        ;
        preview.paused = false
        ;
        preview.error = nil
        ;
        preview.state = reason or "PREVIEW OFF"
    end
    local function valid(p)
        return not preview.closed and current == p and p.viewport and p.viewport.Parent and p.world and p.world.Parent and p.model and p.model.Parent
    end
    local function updateCamera(p)
        if not valid(p) then
            return 
        end
        local distance = math.max(4, p.height * 1.45) * preview.zoom
        local center = Vector3.new(
            0,
            p.center,
            0
        )
        local position = center + Vector3.new(
            math.sin(angle) * distance,
            p.height * 0.13,
            math.cos(angle) * distance
        )
        pcall(function()
            p.camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                position,
                center
            )
            ;
            p.camera.Focus = CFrame.new(center)
        end)
    end
    function preview.setSpeed(value)
        value = tonumber(value)
        if not value or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge or value < 0 or value > 4 then
            return false, "Preview speed must be 0..4"
        end
        preview.speed = value
        if current and current.track then
            pcall(function()
                current.track:AdjustSpeed(preview.paused and 0 or value)
            end)
        end
        return true
    end
    function preview.pause(value)
        preview.paused = value == true
        if current and current.track then
            pcall(function()
                current.track:AdjustSpeed(preview.paused and 0 or preview.speed)
            end)
        end
        return true
    end
    function preview.setOrbit(value)
        preview.orbit = value == true
        ;
        return true
    end
    function preview.setZoom(value)
        value = tonumber(value)
        if not value or value ~= value or value < 0.5 or value > 2 then
            return false, "Preview zoom must be 0.5..2"
        end
        preview.zoom = value
        ;
        if current then
            updateCamera(current)
        end
        ;
        return true
    end
    function preview.resetCamera()
        preview.zoom = 1
        ;
        angle = 0
        ;
        if current then
            updateCamera(current)
        end
        ;
        return true
    end
    function preview.select(slot)
        local p = current
        if not valid(p) then
            return false, "Open a matching-rig local preview first"
        end
        local row = data.profiles[preview.owner]
        local id = row and row.assets[slot]
        if not id then
            return false, "This profile does not contain that source slot"
        end
        generation = generation + 1
        ;
        local token = generation
        disposeTrack(p)
        ;
        preview.slot = slot
        ;
        preview.error = nil
        ;
        preview.state = "LOADING PREVIEW / " .. slot:upper()
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        ;
        animation.Name = "DeathNote_LocalPreview_" .. slot
        ;
        animation.AnimationId = id
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return p.animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        end)
        if token ~= generation or not valid(p) then
            if ok and track then
                pcall(function()
                    track:Stop(0)
                end)
                ;
                drop(track)
            end
            ;
            drop(animation)
            ;
            return false, "Preview request cancelled"
        end
        if not ok or not track then
            drop(animation)
            ;
            preview.error = tostring(track)
            ;
            preview.state = "PREVIEW ASSET UNAVAILABLE"
            ;
            return false, preview.error
        end
        p.animation = animation
        ;
        p.track = track
        ;
        p.started = time
        ;
        p.loaded = false
        ;
        p.id = id
        local played, why = pcall(function()
            track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            ;
            track.Looped = true
            ;
            track:Play(
                0.1,
                1,
                preview.paused and 0 or preview.speed
            )
        end)
        if not played then
            disposeTrack(p)
            ;
            preview.error = tostring(why)
            ;
            preview.state = "PREVIEW PLAY FAILED"
            ;
            return false, preview.error
        end
        return true
    end
    function preview.navigate(direction)
        if not preview.owner then
            return false, "Open a preview first"
        end
        local assets = data.profiles[preview.owner].assets
        local slots = {
        }
        for _, slot in ipairs({
            "idle",
            "idle2",
            "walk",
            "run",
            "jump",
            "fall",
            "spawn",
        }) do
            if assets[slot] then
                slots[#slots + 1] = slot
            end
        end
        local index = 1
        ;
        for i, slot in ipairs(slots) do
            if slot == preview.slot then
                index = i
                ;
                break
            end
        end
        index = ((index - 1 + (direction < 0 and -1 or 1)) % #slots) + 1
        return preview.select(slots[index])
    end
    function preview.open(
        key,
        viewport
    )
        if preview.closed or not data.profiles[key] then
            return false, "Unknown preview profile"
        end
        if not viewport or not viewport.Parent then
            return false, "Preview viewport is not mounted"
        end
        if current and preview.owner == key and current.viewport == viewport then
            return true
        end
        preview.stop("SWITCHING LOCAL PREVIEW")
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local rig = data.profiles[key].rig
        if not hum or hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType[rig] then
            preview.error = "Preview needs an actual " .. rig .. " avatar; no rig conversion was attempted"
            ;
            preview.state = "PREVIEW RIG MISMATCH"
            ;
            return false, preview.error
        end
        local archivable = character.Archivable
        local clone
        local cloned, why = pcall(function()
            character.Archivable = true
            ;
            clone = character:Clone()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if character.Archivable == true then
                character.Archivable = archivable
            end
        end)
        if not cloned or not clone then
            drop(clone)
            ;
            preview.error = tostring(why or "Avatar cannot be cloned")
            ;
            preview.state = "PREVIEW CLONE UNAVAILABLE"
            ;
            return false, preview.error
        end
        local p = {
            viewport = viewport,
            model = clone,
            height = 6,
            center = 0,
            source = character,
        }
        current = p
        ;
        preview.owner = key
        ;
        preview.speed = 1
        ;
        preview.paused = false
        ;
        angle = 0
        local ready, problem = pcall(function()
            clone.Name = "DeathNote_LocalPreviewAvatar"
            for _, object in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("Script") or object:IsA("LocalScript") or object:IsA("ModuleScript") or object:IsA("Tool") or object:IsA("Sound") then
                    object:Destroy()
                elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.CanCollide = false
                    ;
                    object.CanTouch = false
                    ;
                    object.CanQuery = false
                    ;
                    object.Anchored = object.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
                end
            end
            local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
            ;
            world.Name = "DeathNote_ProfilePreviewWorld"
            ;
            world.Parent = viewport
            ;
            p.world = world
