            clone.Parent = world
            ;
            clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))
            local previewHum = clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not previewHum then
                error("Cloned avatar has no Humanoid")
            end
            previewHum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            p.animator = previewHum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if not p.animator then
                p.animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                ;
                p.animator.Parent = previewHum
            end
            local center, size = clone:GetBoundingBox()
            ;
            p.height = math.max(
                3,
                size.Y
            )
            ;
            p.center = center.Position.Y
            local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
            ;
            camera.Name = "DeathNote_ProfilePreviewCamera"
            ;
            camera.FieldOfView = 42
            ;
            camera.Parent = viewport
            ;
            p.camera = camera
            ;
            viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
            viewport.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(
                170,
                170,
                180
            )
            ;
            viewport.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(
                255,
                241,
                229
            )
            ;
            viewport.LightDirection = Vector3.new(
                -1,
                -1,
                -2
            )
            updateCamera(p)
        end)
        if not ready then
            preview.stop("PREVIEW SETUP FAILED")
            ;
            preview.error = tostring(problem)
            ;
            return false, preview.error
        end
        render = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not valid(p) then
                preview.stop("PREVIEW WINDOW REMOVED")
                ;
                return 
            end
            local w = api.windows[key]
            if api.closed or not api.enabled[key] or not w or not w.open or w.minimized or LocalPlayer.Character ~= p.source then
                preview.stop("PREVIEW HIDDEN / RELEASED")
                ;
                return 
            end
            local delta = math.clamp(
                tonumber(dt) or 0,
                0,
                0.25
            )
            ;
            time = time + delta
            ;
            accumulator = accumulator + delta
            if accumulator < 1 / 15 then
                return 
            end
            local elapsed = accumulator
            ;
            accumulator = 0
            if preview.orbit and not preview.paused then
                angle = angle + elapsed * 0.35
                ;
                updateCamera(p)
            end
            if p.track then
                local ok, length = pcall(function()
                    return p.track.Length
                end)
                if ok and type(length) == "number" and length > 0 then
                    p.loaded = true
                end
                if not ok or not p.loaded and time - p.started > 12 then
                    disposeTrack(p)
                    ;
                    preview.error = "Local preview asset did not load / game permissions apply"
                    ;
                    preview.state = "PREVIEW ASSET UNAVAILABLE"
                elseif p.loaded then
                    preview.state = "LOCAL " .. preview.slot:upper() .. " / " .. tostring(preview.speed) .. "x" .. (preview.paused and " / PAUSED" or "")
                end
            end
        end)
        local played, playWhy = preview.select("idle")
        if not played then
            return false, playWhy
        end
        return true
    end
    function preview.diagnostics()
        local p = current
        return {
            owner = preview.owner,
            slot = preview.slot,
            model = p and p.model,
            world = p and p.world,
            track = p and p.track,
            connection = render and 1 or 0,
            count = p and 1 or 0,
            loaded = p and p.loaded or false,
            state = preview.state,
            error = preview.error,
            localOnly = true,
        }
    end
    function preview.close()
        if preview.closed then
            return 
        end
        preview.stop("PREVIEW CLOSED")
        ;
        preview.closed = true
    end
    return preview
end)()
-- Death'Note Addon Studio: compact, touch-friendly windows and explicit one-way warnings.
RedTelemetry.RandomAddonsUI = (function()
    local api = RedTelemetry.RandomAddons
    local data = api.data
    local preview = RedTelemetry.RandomAddonPreview
    local ui = {
    }
    local links, windows, cards = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local panel, section, dialog
    local closed = false
    local timer = 0
    local palette = {
        background = Color3.fromRGB(
            9,
            9,
            16
        ),
        panel = Color3.fromRGB(
            18,
            18,
            30
        ),
        field = Color3.fromRGB(
            25,
            25,
            42
        ),
        white = Color3.fromRGB(
            249,
            245,
            255
        ),
        muted = Color3.fromRGB(
            173,
            173,
            197
        ),
        red = Color3.fromRGB(
            244,
            56,
            91
        ),
        green = Color3.fromRGB(
            76,
            231,
            165
        ),
        amber = Color3.fromRGB(
            255,
            190,
            64
        ),
    }
    local function accent(key)
        local r = data.profiles[key] or data.remote[key]
        ;
        return Color3.fromRGB(
            r.accent[1],
            r.accent[2],
            r.accent[3]
        )
    end
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn,
        bucket
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        table.insert(
            bucket or links,
            c
        )
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function disconnect(bucket)
        for _, c in ipairs(bucket or {
        }) do
            pcall(function()
                c:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function round(
        object,
        radius
    )
        RedUI.Corner(
            object,
            radius or 9
        )
    end
    local function outline(
        object,
        color,
        width
    )
        return RedUI.Stroke(
            object,
            color or palette.field,
            width or 1
        )
    end
    local function gradient(
        parent,
        color
    )
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        ;
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
                0,
                color
            ),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
                1,
                Color3.fromRGB(
                    25,
                    18,
                    43
                )
            ),
        })
        ;
        g.Rotation = 17
        ;
        g.Parent = parent
        ;
        return g
    end
    local function frame(
        parent,
        name,
        size,
        position,
        color
    )
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        ;
        f.Name = name
        ;
        f.Size = size
        ;
        f.Position = position or UDim2.new()
        ;
        f.BackgroundColor3 = color or palette.panel
        ;
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ;
        f.Parent = parent
        ;
        return f
    end
    local function text(
        parent,
        name,
        value,
        size,
        position,
        fontSize,
        color
    )
        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        ;
        t.Name = name
        ;
        t.Size = size
        ;
        t.Position = position or UDim2.new()
        ;
        t.Text = value
        ;
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ;
        t.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ;
        t.TextColor3 = color or palette.white
        ;
        t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        ;
        t.TextSize = fontSize or 12
        ;
        t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        ;
        t.Parent = parent
        ;
        return t
    end
    local function toast(
        ok,
        why
    )
        if not ok then
            pcall(function()
                ShowToast(
                    "Death'Note / Random",
                    tostring(why or "Operation unavailable"),
                    "Info"
                )
            end)
        end
    end
    local function button(
        parent,
        name,
        value,
        size,
        position,
        fn,
        color,
        bucket
    )
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        ;
        b.Name = name
        ;
        b.Size = size
        ;
        b.Position = position or UDim2.new()
        ;
        b.Text = value
        ;
        b.BackgroundColor3 = color or palette.field
        ;
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ;
        b.TextColor3 = palette.white
        ;
        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        ;
        b.TextSize = 11
        ;
        b.AutoButtonColor = true
        ;
        b.Parent = parent
        ;
        round(
            b,
            7
        )
        ;
        outline(
            b,
            color or palette.field,
            1
        )
        connect(
            b.Activated,
            fn,
            bucket
        )
        ;
        return b
    end
    local function input(
        parent,
        name,
        value,
        size,
        position
    )
        local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
        ;
        box.Name = name
        ;
        box.Text = value
        ;
        box.Size = size
        ;
        box.Position = position or UDim2.new()
        ;
        box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        ;
        box.BackgroundColor3 = palette.background
        ;
        box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ;
        box.TextColor3 = palette.white
        ;
        box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        ;
        box.TextSize = 12
        ;
        box.Parent = parent
        ;
        round(
            box,
            6
        )
        ;
        return box
    end
    local function layout(
        parent,
        padding
    )
        local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        ;
        l.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        ;
        l.Padding = UDim.new(
            0,
            padding or 8
        )
        ;
        l.Parent = parent
        ;
        return l
    end
    local function scroll(
        parent,
        name,
        size,
        position
    )
        local s = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        ;
        s.Name = name
        ;
        s.Size = size
        ;
        s.Position = position or UDim2.new()
        ;
        s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ;
        s.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ;
        s.ScrollBarThickness = 3
        ;
        s.ScrollBarImageColor3 = palette.red
        ;
        s.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        ;
        s.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
        ;
        s.Parent = parent
        ;
        layout(
            s,
            8
        )
        ;
        return s
    end
    local function viewport()
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        return camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(
            800,
            650
        )
    end
    local function closeDialog()
        local d = dialog
        ;
        dialog = nil
        if not d then
            return 
        end
        if d.token then
            api.cancelExternal(d.token)
        end
        disconnect(d.links)
        ;
        drop(d.gui)
    end
    local function resizeWindow(w)
        local v = viewport()
        ;
        local minimized = api.windows[w.key].minimized
        local oldWidth = w.root.Size.X.Offset
        ;
        local oldHeight = w.root.Size.Y.Offset
        local x = w.root.Position.X.Scale * v.X + w.root.Position.X.Offset
        local y = w.root.Position.Y.Scale * v.Y + w.root.Position.Y.Offset
        local top = y - oldHeight / 2
        local width = math.max(
            250,
            math.min(
                420,
                v.X - 18
            )
        )
        local height = minimized and 35 or math.max(
            250,
            math.min(
                450,
                v.Y - 24
            )
        )
        w.root.Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            width,
            0,
            height
        )
        w.root.Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            math.clamp(
                x,
                width / 2,
                math.max(
                    width / 2,
                    v.X - width / 2
                )
            ),
            0,
            math.clamp(
                top + height / 2,
                height / 2,
                math.max(
                    height / 2,
                    v.Y - height / 2
                )
            )
        )
        w.body.Visible = not minimized
        ;
        w.min.Text = minimized and "+" or "-"
        ;
        w.width = width
        ;
        w.height = height
        ;
        w.lastX = v.X
        ;
        w.lastY = v.Y
    end
    local function destroyWindow(key)
        local w = windows[key]
        ;
        windows[key] = nil
        if not w then
            return 
        end
        if preview.owner == key then
            preview.stop("PREVIEW WINDOW CLOSED")
        end
        disconnect(w.links)
        ;
        drop(w.gui)
        if dialog and dialog.profile == key then
            closeDialog()
        end
    end
    local function popup(
        name,
        title,
        height
    )
        closeDialog()
        local v = viewport()
        local d = {
            links = {
            },
        }
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        ;
        gui.Name = name
        ;
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        ;
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        ;
        gui.DisplayOrder = 115
        ;
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        ;
        gui.Parent = MainGui.Parent
        ;
        d.gui = gui
        local shade = frame(
            gui,
            "WarningShade",
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                0,
                1,
                0
            ),
            UDim2.new(),
            palette.background
        )
        ;
        shade.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
        ;
        shade.Active = true
        local width = math.max(
            265,
            math.min(
                470,
                v.X - 20
            )
        )
        ;
        local h = math.max(
            250,
            math.min(
                height,
                v.Y - 20
            )
        )
        local root = frame(

    local function numberSetting(
        w,
        name,
        title,
        step,
        maximum
    )
        local key = w.key
        local row = frame(
            w.content,
            "NumberRow_" .. name,
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                -7,
                0,
                43
            ),
            UDim2.new(),
            palette.panel
        )
        ;
        round(
            row,
            7
        )
        ;
        row.LayoutOrder = w.order
        ;
        w.order = w.order + 1
        text(
            row,
            "NumberTitle",
            title,
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                -156,
                1,
                0
            ),
            UDim2.new(
                0,
                10,
                0,
                0
            ),
            10
        )
        local box = input(
            row,
            "AddonNumber_" .. key .. "_" .. name,
            tostring(api.settings[key][name]),
            UDim2.new(
                0,
                63,
                0,
                27
            ),
            UDim2.new(
                1,
                -106,
                0,
                8
            )
        )
        ;
        w.numbers[name] = box
        local function set(value)
            local numeric = tonumber(value)
            if not numeric or numeric ~= numeric or numeric < 0 or numeric > maximum then
                toast(
                    false,
                    "Use a finite value within 0.." .. maximum
                )
                ;
                box.Text = tostring(api.settings[key][name])
                ;
                return 
            end
            toast(api.setSetting(key, name, numeric))
            ;
            box.Text = tostring(api.settings[key][name])
        end
        button(row, "NumberMinus_" .. key .. "_" .. name, "-", UDim2.new(0, 27, 0, 27), UDim2.new(1, -138, 0, 8), function()
            set(math.max(0, api.settings[key][name] - step))
        end, palette.field, w.links)
        button(row, "NumberPlus_" .. key .. "_" .. name, "+", UDim2.new(0, 27, 0, 27), UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 8), function()
            set(math.min(maximum, api.settings[key][name] + step))
        end, palette.field, w.links)
        connect(box.FocusLost, function()
            set(box.Text)
        end, w.links)
    end

    local function assetInspector(w)
        local row = data.profiles[w.key]
        windowInfo(

            "fall",

        }) do
            local id = row.assets[slot]
            if id then
                local sourceSlot = slot
                local line = frame(
                    w.content,

                        1,
                        -7,
                        0,
                        34
                    ),

                )

                w.order = w.order + 1

                round(
                    line,
                    7
                )
                text(

                    "AssetID",
                    slot:upper() .. " / " .. id,
                    UDim2.new(
                        1,
                        -65,
                        1,
                        0
                    ),
                    UDim2.new(
                        0,
                        7,
                        0,
                        0
                    ),
                    8,
                    palette.muted
                )
                button(line, "PreviewSlot_" .. w.key .. "_" .. slot, "VIEW", UDim2.new(0, 47, 0, 23), UDim2.new(1, -55, 0, 5), function()
                    w.previewBox.Visible = true
                    ;
                    w.previewBox.Size = UDim2.new(
                        1,
                        -7,
                        0,
                        268
                    )
                    if preview.owner ~= w.key then
                        local ok, why = preview.open(
                            w.key,
                            w.viewport
                        )
                        ;
                        if not ok then
                            toast(
                                false,
                                why
                            )
                            ;
                            w.previewStatus.Text = why
                            ;
                            return 
                        end
                    end
                    toast(preview.select(sourceSlot))
                end, palette.field, w.links).TextSize = 8
            end
        end
        if row.sounds then
            for _, slot in ipairs({
                "foot",
                "jump",
            }) do
                windowInfo(
                    w,
                    "SoundSlot_" .. slot,
                    "SOUND " .. slot:upper() .. "  /  " .. row.sounds[slot],
                    23,
                    palette.muted

            end

        windowInfo(
            w,
            "AssetPermissionNotice",

            66,
            palette.muted
        )
    end
    local function selectPage(
        w,
        page
    )
        if not w.groups[page] then
            return 
        end
        w.page = page
        for name, group in pairs(w.groups) do
            group.Visible = name == page
        end
        for name, b in pairs(w.pageButtons) do
            b.BackgroundColor3 = name == page and accent(w.key) or palette.field
        end
        w.outer.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
            0,
            0
        )
        if page ~= "PREVIEW" and preview.owner == w.key then
            preview.stop("PREVIEW PAGE HIDDEN / RELEASED")
            ;
            w.previewBox.Visible = false
            ;
            w.previewBox.Size = UDim2.new(
                1,
                -7,
                0,
                0
            )
        end
    end

    local function applyAppearance(
        w,
        theme,
        offset
    )
        if theme ~= "VIVID" and theme ~= "DARK" and theme ~= "CONTRAST" then
            return 
        end
        w.theme = theme
        ;
        w.fontOffset = math.clamp(
            offset or 0,
            -1,
            3
        )
        if not w.appearanceBase then
            w.appearanceBase = {
            }
            local objects = {
                w.root,
            }
            ;
            for _, object in ipairs(w.root:GetDescendants()) do
                objects[#objects + 1] = object
            end
            for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
                local base = {
                }
                if object:IsA("Frame") or object:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                    base.background = object.BackgroundColor3
                end
                if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
                    base.size = object.TextSize
                    ;
                    base.text = object.TextColor3
                end
                if object:IsA("UIGradient") then
                    base.gradient = object.Enabled
                end
                if next(base) then
                    w.appearanceBase[object] = base
                end
            end
        end
        for object, base in pairs(w.appearanceBase) do
            if object.Parent then
                if base.background then
                    local color = base.background
                    if theme == "DARK" then
                        color = Color3.fromRGB(
                            17,
                            17,
                            22
                        )
                    elseif theme == "CONTRAST" then
                        color = Color3.fromRGB(
                            0,
                            0,
                            0
                        )
                    end
                    object.BackgroundColor3 = color
                end
                if base.size then
                    object.TextSize = math.clamp(
                        base.size + w.fontOffset,
                        8,
                        24
                    )
                    if theme == "CONTRAST" then
                        object.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                            255,
                            255,
                            255
                        )
                    else
                        object.TextColor3 = base.text
                    end
                end
                if base.gradient ~= nil then
                    object.Enabled = theme == "VIVID" and base.gradient or false
                end
            end
        end
        for name, b in pairs(w.themeButtons or {
        }) do
            b.BackgroundColor3 = name == theme and accent(w.key) or palette.field
        end
        if w.fontLabel then
            w.fontLabel.Text = "TEXT SIZE OFFSET / " .. (w.fontOffset >= 0 and "+" or "") .. w.fontOffset
        end
    end

                    position = root.Position,

        connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(event)
            if not w.drag then
                return 
            end
            if event.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and event ~= w.drag.input then
                return 
            end
            local dx = event.Position.X - w.drag.start.X
            ;
            local dy = event.Position.Y - w.drag.start.Y
            root.Position = UDim2.new(
                w.drag.position.X.Scale,
                w.drag.position.X.Offset + dx,
                w.drag.position.Y.Scale,
                w.drag.position.Y.Offset + dy
            )
            ;
            resizeWindow(w)
        end, w.links)
        connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(event)
            if w.drag and (event == w.drag.input or event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                w.drag = nil
            end
        end, w.links)
        resizeWindow(w)
        ;
        return w
    end
    local function refreshWindow(
        key,
        diagnostic
    )
        local state = api.windows[key]
        if not state.open or not api.enabled[key] then
            destroyWindow(key)
            ;
            return 
        end
        local w = buildWindow(key)
        if w.lastMin ~= state.minimized then
            resizeWindow(w)
            ;
            w.lastMin = state.minimized
            if state.minimized and preview.owner == key then
                preview.stop("PREVIEW MINIMIZED / RELEASED")
                ;
                w.previewBox.Visible = false
                ;
                w.previewBox.Size = UDim2.new(
                    1,
                    -7,
                    0,
                    0
                )
            end
        end
        w.status.Text = api.error or api.active == key and api.state or "READY / START THIS PROFILE"
        w.status.TextColor3 = api.error and palette.red or api.active == key and accent(key) or palette.muted
        w.resources.Text = "OWNED: " .. diagnostic.trackCount .. " TRACKS / " .. diagnostic.soundCount .. " SOUNDS / " .. diagnostic.properties .. " PROPERTIES / NO FOREIGN-TRACK DESTROY"
        w.start.Text = api.active == key and "PROFILE ACTIVE" or "START PROFILE"
        for name, b in pairs(w.toggles) do
            b.Text = api.settings[key][name] and "ON" or "OFF"
            ;
            b.BackgroundColor3 = api.settings[key][name] and accent(key) or palette.field
        end
        for name, box in pairs(w.numbers) do
            if not box:IsFocused() then
                box.Text = tostring(api.settings[key][name])
            end
        end
        if w.sprint then
            w.sprint.Text = api.sprint and "SPRINT / ON" or "SPRINT / OFF"
            ;
            w.sprint.BackgroundColor3 = api.sprint and accent(key) or palette.field
        end
        if w.slotLabels then
            local info = api.slotInfo()
            ;
            for index, label in ipairs(w.slotLabels) do
                label.Text = "SLOT " .. index .. (info[index].filled and " / " .. info[index].bytes .. " B" or " / EMPTY")
            end
        end
        if w.monster then
            w.monster.BackgroundColor3 = api.monsterSet == "MONSTER" and accent(key) or palette.field
            ;
            w.original.BackgroundColor3 = api.monsterSet == "ORIGINAL" and accent(key) or palette.field
        end
    end
    local function refresh()
        if closed then
            return 
        end
        local currentRig, ready = api.characterStatus()
        for key, view in pairs(cards) do
            local remote = data.remote[key]
            if remote then
                view.status.Text = api.external[key].error or api.external[key].phase
                view.action.Text = api.externalConsumed and "REJOIN REQUIRED / NO OFF" or api.launching and "EXTERNAL REQUEST IN PROGRESS" or "READ WARNING / RUN ONCE"
            else
                view.toggle.Text = api.enabled[key] and "TOOL ON" or "TOOL OFF"
                view.toggle.BackgroundColor3 = api.enabled[key] and accent(key) or palette.field
                view.status.Text = api.active == key and api.state or api.enabled[key] and "TOOL IN INVENTORY / EQUIP TO OPEN" or "OFF / NO TOOL GRANTED"
                if not ready or currentRig ~= data.profiles[key].rig then
                    view.status.Text = currentRig .. " / " .. data.profiles[key].rig .. " REQUIRED / NO CONVERSION"
                end
            end
        end
        local diagnostic = api.diagnostics()
        for key in pairs(data.profiles) do
            local ok, why = pcall(function()
                refreshWindow(
                    key,
                    diagnostic
                )
            end)
            if not ok then
                destroyWindow(key)
                ;
                api.windows[key].open = false
                ;
                pcall(function()
                    warn("DeathNote profile window: " .. tostring(why))
                end)
            end
        end
    end
